LECTURE 01

优化模型与全局结构Models and global structure

01 · 把实际问题写成优化模型01 · Turn a decision into an optimization model

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.4-11 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.1 · HW1 背景

学完应能：区分变量、目标、约束、与最优值；用拟合和投资例子建模。Learning goal: explain turn a decision into an optimization model and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

优化模型由变量、目标函数和约束组成。可行点满足全部约束；最优点的目标值不大于任何可行点的目标值。An optimization model specifies variables, an objective and constraints. A satisfies every constraint; an optimal point has objective value no greater than any feasible point.

了解Understand

假设你要购买两种食品，数量分别为 x₁、x₂。它们的价格为 3 元和 2 元，每份提供的蛋白质量为 2 和 1。若至少需要 4 单位蛋白质，目标是把费用 3x₁+2x₂ 降到最低，约束是 2x₁+x₂≥4、x₁≥0、x₂≥0。数量是我们能决定的变量，价格与营养含量是已知数据。连续模型允许购买分数份；若必须整份购买，要另加整数约束。Suppose quantities x₁ and x₂ of two foods cost three and two per serving and provide two and one units of protein. Meeting at least four units at minimum cost means minimizing 3x₁+2x₂ subject to 2x₁+x₂≥4 and nonnegative quantities. Quantities are decisions; prices and nutritional coefficients are data. A continuous model permits fractional servings. Whole servings require additional integer constraints.

检查一个点时，应先检查可行性，再计算费用。(2,0) 可行，费用为 6；(0,4) 可行，费用为 8；(1,1) 费用为 5，却只提供 3 单位蛋白质，因此不能拿它与可行方案比较优劣。通常记为 p*，最优点为 x*。一个数与一个向量扮演不同角色。Check feasibility before evaluating cost. The point (2,0) is feasible and costs six; (0,4) is feasible and costs eight. The cheaper point (1,1) costs five but supplies only three protein units, so it cannot compete as a feasible solution. We write p* for the and x* for an optimal vector. These objects have different roles.

模型能表达“最佳”，却还不能保证最优点存在。比如在 x>0 上最小化 x，下确界为 0，但没有可行点取到 0。可行集为空称不可行；目标沿可行方向降到 −∞ 称无下界。建模时把这些情形与存在一个最优解区分开。A model expresses what best means without guaranteeing attainment. Minimizing x over x>0 has infimum zero, but no feasible point attains it. An empty feasible set is infeasible; a feasible objective descending to −∞ is unbounded below. These cases differ from having an optimal solution.

拟合与投资也能按同一模板建模。拟合时 x 是模型参数，观测误差 ‖Ax−b‖² 是目标，参数范围是约束。投资时 xᵢ 是投入第 i 项资产的资金比例，可要求 x≥0、Σxᵢ=1、rᵀx≥ρ，其中 r 是预期收益率、ρ 是最低收益。若 Σ 为半正定矩阵，最小化 xᵀΣx 表示在收益约束下减小风险。例如两资产收益率为 2%、6%，最低收益 4%，则第二项比例至少 1/2；最佳比例还取决于风险矩阵。Fitting and investing use the same template. In fitting, x contains parameters, ‖Ax−b‖² measures error, and parameter limits are constraints. In investing, xᵢ is an asset share, with x≥0, Σxᵢ=1 and rᵀx≥ρ for expected returns r and minimum return ρ. A PSD Σ makes xᵀΣx a risk objective. For returns 2% and 6% with required 4%, the second share must be at least one half; the optimal allocation also depends on the risk matrix.

掌握Mastery

食品例子的最优性可以直接证明：3x₁+2x₂ = 1.5(2x₁+x₂)+0.5x₂≥6，其中先使用营养约束，再用非负性。点 (2,0) 的费用恰好为 6，于是下界被取到，p*=6。仅比较两个候选点通常不够；这里的下界覆盖了全部可行点。For the food example, 3x₁+2x₂ = 1.5(2x₁+x₂)+0.5x₂≥6, using the nutrient constraint and nonnegativity. The point (2,0) attains six, so p*=6. Comparing two candidates usually does not establish optimality; this lower bound covers every feasible point.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

把“至少 4 单位蛋白质”改成“恰好 4 单位”，(0,5) 还可行吗？上述最优点会改变吗？Replace at least four protein units by exactly four. Is (0,5) still feasible? Does the optimizer change?

展开核对Check the answer

(0,5) 不满足等式。原下界证明仍适用，(2,0) 仍可行并取得 6，因此最优值和最优点不变。The point (0,5) violates the equality. The same lower bound applies, and (2,0) remains feasible and attains six, so the optimal value and optimizer stay the same.

深入In depth

同一个实际任务可以有多个等价模型。后面用辅助变量把绝对值、和分式改写时，要证明新旧模型给出相同的决策与最优值。建模语言的选择会影响我们能使用的算法。One task can admit several equivalent models. When auxiliary variables rewrite absolute values, maxima or ratios later, we must show that decisions and optimal values correspond. The formulation affects which algorithms become available.

核对原课件 · 4-11Check original slides · 4-11

02 · 最小二乘：怎样选出一个最佳预测02 · Least squares: how to choose one best prediction

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.13-17 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.2.1 · HW1 4(b)

学完应能：解释为什么用残差平方计分，用配方证明最佳常数，并把同一计算翻译成矩阵记号。Learning goal: explain squared-residual scoring, prove the best constant by completing the square, and translate that same calculation into matrix notation.

了解Understand

假设同一次测量任务得到了三个读数：1、2、6。现在要用一个数概括这三个读数，作为以后统一采用的预测值。选哪个数比较合适？先不用任何公式：选 1 会贴近第一个读数，却离 6 很远；选 6 又会远离前两个。我们需要一种明确的比较办法，才能解释为什么一个选择比另一个好。这里暂且把三个读数看得同样重要，也允许预测值是小数。Suppose one measurement task gives readings 1, 2 and 6. We want a single number to summarize them and use as a common prediction. Which number should we choose? Without formulas, one fits the first reading but misses six badly; six misses the earlier readings. We need an explicit comparison rule to justify preferring one choice. For now, each reading counts equally and fractional predictions are allowed.

把准备选择的数叫作 x。只要选定 x，就相当于对三个读数都预测同一个数。例如选 x=3，三项“预测值减观测值”分别为 3−1=2、3−2=1、3−6=−3。这里正数表示预测偏高，负数表示偏低；这样的差叫残差。残差的符号告诉我们偏向哪一边，绝对值告诉我们相差多少。Call the candidate number x. Choosing it predicts the same number for all three readings. For x=3, the three prediction-minus-observation differences are 3−1=2, 3−2=1 and 3−6=−3. Positive means overprediction and negative means underprediction. Such a difference is a residual: its sign gives direction and its magnitude gives the size of the discrepancy.

既然已经有了三个差，能不能直接把它们相加，当作这个选择的总误差？在 x=3 时，相加得到 2+1−3=0。可是三个读数都没有被准确预测，最后一个还差了 3。因此这个和为零，只能说明偏高与偏低抵消了。若用它判断预测是否准确，就会把仍然存在的偏差藏起来。我们需要让偏高与偏低都计入代价。Could we add the three differences to measure total error? At x=3 their sum is 2+1−3=0, although none of the readings is predicted exactly and the last misses by three. Zero here means overprediction cancels underprediction. Using that signed sum as an accuracy measure hides existing discrepancies. Both signs need to contribute to the cost.

一个办法是先取绝对值再相加；另一个办法是先平方再相加。本节选择第二种，这就确定了我们要学习的模型。“二乘”指平方，“最小”指让平方的总和尽可能小。平方以后，2 与 −2 都贡献 4，不会相互抵消；偏差从 1 增加到 3 时，代价从 1 增加到 9，所以较大的偏差受到更重的惩罚。这是模型采用的计分规则；换用绝对值总和会形成另一个优化问题。We could sum absolute values, or sum squares. Choosing the latter defines the least-squares model studied here: minimize the total of squared residuals. Squaring makes both two and minus two contribute four, preventing cancellation. Increasing discrepancy from one to three increases cost from one to nine, so large misses receive heavier penalties. This is a modeling choice; absolute-error minimization is a different problem.

现在按这个规则比较几个候选值。x=1 时，平方总和为 0²+(−1)²+(−5)²=26；x=2 时为 1²+0²+(−4)²=17；x=3 时为 2²+1²+(−3)²=14；x=4 时为 3²+2²+(−2)²=17。因此，3 比这几个候选值更好。Apply that rule to several candidates. At x=1 the total is 0²+(−1)²+(−5)²=26; at x=2 it is 1²+0²+(−4)²=17; at x=3 it is 2²+1²+(−3)²=14; at x=4 it is 3²+2²+(−2)²=17. Three beats these particular candidates.

比较到这里，还不能断定 3 是所有选择中最好的，因为我们只试了四个数，尚未排除 2.9 或其他小数更好。要覆盖所有允许的 x，就需要把同一个计分过程写成一个随 x 变化的函数。记它为 F(x)，则 F(x)=(x−1)²+(x−2)²+(x−6)²。这个式子的三项分别对应三个读数，括号中的 x 都是同一个待选预测值。我们的任务现在明确为：找出让 F(x) 最小的实数 x。This comparison does not yet prove three beats every possible choice. We have tested only four numbers, leaving 2.9 and every other fraction unchecked. To cover all allowed x, express the same scoring procedure as a function F(x)=(x−1)²+(x−2)²+(x−6)². Its three terms correspond to the readings and use the same candidate x. The task is now precise: find the real x minimizing F(x).

要证明一个候选值最好，可以先找出全部分数都不可能低于的界，再检查哪个候选值真正取得这个界。平方永远非负，所以把 F(x) 整理成“非负的平方项加一个常数”，就能看出这个界；再令平方项为零，就能找到取得它的 x。把二次式整理成这种形式的过程叫配方。把三项分别展开，相加得到 F(x)=3x²−18x+41。再把前两项写成平方，得到 F(x)=3(x−3)²+14。你可以反向展开核对：3(x−3)²+14=3x²−18x+27+14，确实回到原式。这样改写没有改变任何候选值的分数，只是把最低分显示得更清楚。To prove a candidate is best, first find a bound no score can fall below, then find a candidate attaining it. Since squares are nonnegative, writing F(x) as a nonnegative squared term plus a constant exposes such a bound. Making the squared term zero then identifies an attaining x. This rewriting is called completing the square. Expanding the three terms gives F(x)=3x²−18x+41, which rewrites as 3(x−3)²+14. Check by expanding back: 3(x−3)²+14=3x²−18x+27+14. The rewrite changes no candidate’s score; it makes the lower bound visible.

对任意实数 x，平方 (x−3)² 都不小于零，因此 F(x) 不会低于 14。选 x=3 时，平方恰好为零，F(3)=14，确实取得这个下界。只要 x≠3，平方就为正，分数会高于 14。这才证明 3 是唯一最佳选择，14 是最低的平方误差总和。最佳选择与最低分是两个不同的对象：前者回答选哪个数，后者回答这个规则下剩下多少误差。For every real x, (x−3)²≥0, so F(x) cannot fall below fourteen. Choosing three makes the square zero and attains fourteen. Any other x makes it positive. This proves uniqueness, rather than merely comparing samples. The optimizer three and minimum score fourteen answer different questions: which number to select, and how much squared discrepancy remains.

算出最佳预测以后，还需要解释它的分数。14 大于零，说明采用最佳预测时还有误差：三个不同读数无法同时等于同一个预测值。最小二乘只要求在已经选定的计分规则下把总分降到最低，并不保证预测完全准确，也不保证选出的数就是未知的真实值。回头看开头的问题，我们已经获得一个可以解释的答案：若三个读数同等重要，并采用平方误差规则，就应统一预测为 3。After finding the best prediction, interpret its score. Fourteen is positive, so discrepancies remain even at the optimum: three different readings cannot all equal one prediction. Least squares minimizes the chosen score; it promises neither perfect prediction nor recovery of an unknown true value. We can now answer the opening question with its assumptions: equally weighting these readings and using squared-error cost selects the common prediction three.

为了把刚才的计算与具体的预测对应起来，我们用左右两幅图分别呈现数据和分数。左图使用这三个读数，横轴 i=1、2、3 只表示观测编号，纵轴表示读数。蓝点是 1、2、6，红色水平线是统一预测 3，竖直线段表示各次预测与读数之间的距离。图的右侧横轴才是可选择的预测值 x，纵轴是分数 F(x)，红点位于 (3,14)。左图让你看到还剩哪些偏差，右图让你看到为什么其他预测值会得到更高总分。To connect the calculation with actual predictions, use two panels showing the data and the scores separately. The left panel keeps the same data: horizontal i=1,2,3 indexes observations, while the vertical axis gives readings. Blue points are 1,2,6, the red horizontal line is prediction three, and vertical segments show discrepancies. Only the right panel uses candidate x on its horizontal axis, with score F(x) vertically and red point (3,14). Left shows remaining discrepancies; right compares total scores.

我们已经解决了三个读数的问题，不过写法还依赖逐项列出括号。若观测增加到一千次，同一套规则就需要写一千个残差平方。为了把这些重复运算统一表示，我们把观测与预测分别排成列，再用矩阵记号写出整个平方和。我们先只翻译眼前的三个读数：b=(1,2,6)ᵀ 把已知观测竖着排好，A=(1,1,1)ᵀ 是一个三行一列的矩阵。x 仍是刚才那个待选数，Ax=(x,x,x)ᵀ 表示三个预测。右上角 T 只表示把横着列出的分量转成列向量。The three-reading problem is solved, but our notation lists each squared residual separately. A thousand observations would require a thousand such terms. To express that repeated operation compactly, stack observations and predictions in columns and write their total score using matrix notation. Translate this example first: b=(1,2,6)ᵀ stacks known readings, and A=(1,1,1)ᵀ is a three-row, one-column matrix. The unknown x is still the same number; Ax=(x,x,x)ᵀ stacks its predictions. The superscript T turns the horizontally listed entries into a column.

于是 Ax−b=(x−1,x−2,x−6)ᵀ，恰好把前面的三个残差收集在一起。符号 ‖r‖₂ 表示向量 r 的欧氏长度：各分量平方相加后开平方；外面的平方把这个根号消去。因此 ‖Ax−b‖₂² 就等于我们刚才逐项计算的平方和 F(x)。矩阵式没有改变问题或答案，只把三次重复计算收进统一记号。Thus Ax−b=(x−1,x−2,x−6)ᵀ collects the three residuals. Euclidean norm ‖r‖₂ takes the square root of the sum of squared components; squaring that norm cancels the root. Therefore ‖Ax−b‖₂² is exactly F(x). Matrix notation changes neither task nor answer; it packages repeated calculations.

掌握Mastery

当读数改变或观测次数增加时，我们还希望有一个通用的计算办法，而不必每次重新试数并配方。本节的答案 3 恰好是三个读数的平均值，下面检验这个关系是否对任意一组读数都成立。设共有 m 个观测 b₁,…,bₘ，每个仍用同一个 x 预测。m 是观测个数。记平均值为 b̄=(b₁+⋯+bₘ)/m，假设 m≥1，所以可以除以 m。记号 Σᵢ 表示把下标 i 从 1 到 m 的各项相加，例如 Σᵢbᵢ=b₁+⋯+bₘ。我们要证明：在同样的平方误差规则下，最佳常数总是这个平均值。When readings change or their number grows, we want a general calculation rule instead of trying candidates and completing a new square each time. Three happens to be the mean of our observations; we now test whether that relationship holds for arbitrary data. Let m≥1 readings be b₁,…,bₘ, all predicted by one x, and let b̄=(b₁+⋯+bₘ)/m. The positive observation count permits division. The symbol Σᵢ adds terms over i from one through m, so Σᵢbᵢ=b₁+⋯+bₘ. We will prove that their mean is always the best constant under squared-error cost.

把每个残差分成 x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ)，平方后求和得到 Σᵢ(x−bᵢ)²=m(x−b̄)²+2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)²。展开式中，交叉项 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ) 同时含有候选值与数据，暂时还看不出怎样比较。先计算它所包含的和：Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0，因为平均值满足 mb̄=Σᵢbᵢ。于是整个交叉项消失。最后一项 Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)² 只含数据，不随 x 改变，因此比较候选分数时只需关注第一项 m(x−b̄)²。Split each residual as x−bᵢ=(x−b̄)+(b̄−bᵢ), square and sum. The result is m(x−b̄)²+2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)+Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)². The cross term 2(x−b̄)Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ) mixes candidate and data and initially obscures the comparison. Its sum is Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)=mb̄−Σᵢbᵢ=0 because the mean satisfies mb̄=Σᵢbᵢ, so the entire cross term vanishes. The final sum Σᵢ(b̄−bᵢ)² contains only data. Comparing candidates therefore reduces to the first term m(x−b̄)².

所以全部候选分数都等于“固定的数据项”加 m(x−b̄)²。m>0 保证第二项非负，且只有 x=b̄ 时为零，这就证明最佳常数唯一等于均值。代入本节数据，b̄=9/3=3，固定项为 (3−1)²+(3−2)²+(3−6)²=14，和前面的配方结果一致。Every score therefore equals a fixed data term plus m(x−b̄)². Positivity of m makes the latter nonnegative and zero only at x=b̄, proving unique optimality. Our data give b̄=9/3=3 and fixed term fourteen, agreeing with the earlier calculation.

如果你已经学过一元求导，还可以核对另一条路线。每项 (x−bᵢ)² 的导数为 2(x−bᵢ)，故总导数为 2(mx−Σᵢbᵢ)。令其等于零得到相同均值。这里令导数为零只是求候选点；它确实最优的理由，已经由上面的非负平方证明补全。不会求导也不妨碍完成本节前面的论证。If you know scalar differentiation, each squared residual has derivative 2(x−bᵢ), yielding total derivative 2(mx−Σᵢbᵢ). Setting it to zero gives the same mean. This only identifies a candidate; the nonnegative-square argument above establishes optimality. Differentiation is optional for the preceding proof.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

用同样方法处理观测 0、2、4：先比较候选值 1、2、3，再把平方和配方。写清最佳选择和最低分各是什么。For readings 0,2,4, compare candidate constants 1,2,3, then complete the square. Distinguish the best constant from the minimum score.

展开核对Check the answer

候选值 1、2、3 的平方和分别为 11、8、11。全部候选的分数为 x²+(x−2)²+(x−4)²=3(x−2)²+8，因此最佳常数为 2，最低平方误差总和为 8。比较候选只提供线索，配方给出对所有实数 x 的证明。The candidate scores are eleven, eight and eleven. For every real x, x²+(x−2)²+(x−4)²=3(x−2)²+8. Thus the best constant is two and minimum score eight. Candidate comparisons suggest the result; completion of squares proves it for all real x.

深入In depth

多参数拟合允许不同观测使用不同预测值。例如线性模型把参数收集成向量 x，由数据矩阵 A 给出预测 Ax，再用相同的平方和规则比较 Ax 与 b。学习、矩阵乘法和梯度后，可以推出 Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0，这组条件叫正规方程。它表达最佳预测处残差与所有可调预测方向正交。对本节的常数模型，A 的唯一一列全为 1，所以 Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0 就是残差之和为零，即 3x−9=0。这解释了正规方程与我们算出的 3 有什么关系。一般模型的解可能不唯一：若非零 h 满足 Ah=0，参数 x 和 x+h 会给出完全相同的预测；当 A 满列秩时没有这种方向，最小二乘解唯一。先在第 6、13、15–17 节建立这些知识，再读一般矩阵推导。Multiple-parameter fitting permits different predictions across observations: data matrix A maps parameter vector x to Ax, compared with b using the same squared-error score. After learning s, matrix multiplication and gradients, derive the normal equations Aᵀ(Ax−b)=0. They say residuals at the best fit are orthogonal to every adjustable prediction direction. For our constant model the only column of A consists of ones, so the equation simply sums residuals to zero: 3x−9=0, recovering three. General parameters need not be unique: if nonzero h satisfies Ah=0, x and x+h predict identically. Full column rank excludes those directions and gives uniqueness. Sections 6,13,15–17 supply the prerequisites for the general derivation.

速通Quick

最小二乘先把每项预测误差平方，再把这些平方相加，选择使总和最小的参数。本节三次观测为 1、2、6，用同一个数 x 预测时，总分为 3(x−3)²+14，所以最佳 x=3。Least squares squares each prediction error, adds those squares, and chooses parameters minimizing the total. For observations 1, 2 and 6 predicted by one constant x, the total is 3(x−3)²+14, so the best constant is three.

03 · 线性规划与等价改写03 · Linear programming and equivalent formulations

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.19-21 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.2.2 · HW1 背景

学完应能：识别线性目标和约束；用辅助变量处理绝对值。Learning goal: explain and equivalent formulations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

使用仿射目标与仿射约束。绝对值和最大值可借助辅助变量改写为线性不等式。Linear programs use affine objectives and constraints. Auxiliary variables can convert absolute values and maxima into linear inequalities.

了解Understand

“仿射”允许常数项，例如 2x+3；“线性映射”要求原点映到原点。线性规划这一名称习惯上包含仿射式。可行集由半空间和的交组成，二维时常画成多边形。目标 cᵀx 的等值线互相平行，我们把它向费用降低的方向移动，最后接触可行集的位置就是候选最优点。Affine expressions allow constants, such as 2x+3; linear maps send zero to zero. The conventional name linear programming includes affine expressions. Its feasible set is an intersection of halfspaces and s, often a polygon in two dimensions. Parallel objective level lines move toward lower cost until they reach an optimal face.

若目标是最小化 max(2x+1,−x+4)，引入 t，求 min t，约束 t≥2x+1 和 t≥−x+4。对固定 x，可行的最小 t 恰好是两式的最大值。两条直线在 x=1 相交，t=3；x<1 时第二式超过 3，x>1 时第一式超过 3，因此这是全局最优解。To minimize max(2x+1,−x+4), introduce t and minimize t subject to t≥2x+1 and t≥−x+4. For fixed x, the smallest feasible t equals that . The lines intersect at x=1, t=3. For x<1 the second expression exceeds three; for x>1 the first does. This establishes global optimality.

同理，|u|≤t 等价于 −t≤u≤t。例如最小化 ‖Ax−b‖∞，可以给每一个残差同时加上正负两侧的约束，再最小化 t。表达式表面上出现范数，也可能有线性规划结构；学会改写能让问题进入成熟求解器的适用范围。Likewise |u|≤t is equivalent to −t≤u≤t. Minimizing ‖Ax−b‖∞ can therefore bound both signs of every residual and minimize t. An expression containing a norm may still have linear-program structure; reformulation makes established solvers applicable.

掌握Mastery

等价性需验证两个方向。旧模型任一 x 都可配 t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ)，新模型获得相同费用。新模型任一可行 (x,t) 满足 maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ)≤t，故它不会得到比旧模型更低的最优值。结合两向比较，最优值相等；在取得最优值时可取 t 等于最大项。Verify both directions: each original x can be extended with t=maxᵢ(aᵢᵀx+bᵢ) at the same cost. Conversely any feasible (x,t) has that maximum at most t, so the reformulation cannot beat the original optimum. Both comparisons establish equality of optimal values; at an optimum t can equal the maximum term.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

把 minₓ |x−2|+|x+1| 写成线性规划，并找最优值。Write minₓ |x−2|+|x+1| as a linear program and find its value.

展开核对Check the answer

引入 u、v，最小化 u+v，约束 u≥±(x−2)、v≥±(x+1)。三角不等式给目标≥3；x∈[−1,2] 都达到 3。Introduce u and v, minimize u+v and impose u≥±(x−2), v≥±(x+1). The triangle inequality bounds the objective below by three, attained throughout [−1,2].

深入In depth

历史旁注：资源配置是线性规划早期的重要动力。1975 年 Kantorovich 与 Koopmans 因最优资源配置理论获得经济学奖；这一背景说明为什么“约束下选最优产量”成为优化的典型问题。资料见文末 Nobel 官方公告。Historical note: resource allocation was an important early motivation for linear programming. Kantorovich and Koopmans received the 1975 economics prize for optimal resource allocation theory. This helps explain the prominence of choosing production levels under constraints. See the official Nobel announcement in Sources.

04 · 凸优化与灯光设计04 · Why convex optimization is useful

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.23-34 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.3 · HW1 背景

学完应能：解释凸性带来的全局性质；逐步检查灯光模型的目标和。Learning goal: explain why convex optimization is useful and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸问题要求可行集凸、目标函数凸。标准写法使用凸不等式与仿射等式；同时是全局极小点。Convex problems have a convex feasible set and objective. Standard form uses convex inequalities and affine equalities; a local minimum is global.

了解Understand

设 x、y 是两种可行方案，θ 是 0 到 1 的混合比例。如果混合方案仍可行，集合具有凸性；若混合费用不超过两项费用的加权平均，函数具有凸性。这个定义限制了“中间突然冒出更高山峰”的行为，因而我们能把局部信息连接到全局结论。后面第 3、4 讲分别把集合与函数的定义展开。Let x and y be feasible plans and θ∈[0,1] their mixing weight. Feasibility of the mixture expresses convexity of the set; a mixture cost no greater than the weighted average expresses convexity of the function. This rules out an intervening rise above the chord and connects local information to global conclusions. Lectures 3 and 4 develop these two definitions.

课件的照明问题中，pⱼ 是第 j 盏灯的非负功率，Aᵢⱼ 表示它对位置 i 的照明贡献，亮度为 Iᵢ=ΣⱼAᵢⱼpⱼ。若每处亮度要靠近 1，可以惩罚 max(Iᵢ,1/Iᵢ)，并把最坏位置的惩罚最小化。在 Iᵢ>0 上，Iᵢ 是仿射函数，1/Iᵢ 是凸函数，因此最大值目标是凸的。功率上下界也保持凸可行性。In the lighting model, pⱼ is nonnegative lamp power and Aᵢⱼ its contribution to location i, giving intensity Iᵢ=ΣⱼAᵢⱼpⱼ. To keep intensities near one, penalize max(Iᵢ,1/Iᵢ) and minimize the worst location penalty. On Iᵢ>0, intensity is affine and reciprocal intensity is convex, so the maximum objective is convex. Power bounds preserve convex feasibility.

仅看函数长得复杂，难以判断模型是否凸。要按“定义域—每项函数—组合规则—约束方向”的顺序检查。比如凸函数 f(x)≤0 定义凸区域，f(x)≥0 一般没有这种保证；等式 f(x)=0 也一般需要额外结构。照明中的正亮度条件必须保留，否则倒数没有意义。Complex appearance does not decide convexity. Check , individual functions, composition rules and constraint direction in order. A convex f(x)≤0 gives a convex region; f(x)≥0 generally does not, and equality needs additional structure. Positive intensity must be retained because its reciprocal is otherwise undefined.

课件原目标是最小化最坏的相对对数偏差 maxᵢ|log Iᵢ−log Ides|，Ides>0 为目标亮度。令 uᵢ=Iᵢ/Ides，|log u|=log max(u,1/u)，而 log 严格递增，所以最小化原目标等价于最小化 maxᵢmax(uᵢ,1/uᵢ)，两者最优决策相同，但最优值相差一个对数变换。前面的 Ides=1 是归一化的例子。例如实际亮度为目标的两倍或一半，都会给偏差 log2，体现相对惩罚的对称性。The slide objective minimizes the worst relative log deviation maxᵢ|log Iᵢ−log Ides|, with positive target Ides. Set uᵢ=Iᵢ/Ides. Since |log u|=log max(u,1/u) and log is strictly increasing, minimizing the original objective is equivalent to minimizing maxᵢmax(uᵢ,1/uᵢ). Optimizing decisions coincide, while optimal values differ by a logarithm. The preceding Ides=1 example is normalized. Double and half the target both incur deviation log2.

课件比较的几种方法会改变模型：统一灯功率限制了决策范围；最小二乘改成惩罚平方误差；求解后把功率截到上下界，可能改变原先的拟合质量；最坏绝对误差能写成线性规划，却也不同于相对对数误差。凸改写的价值在于保留原目标的最优决策，并直接满足功率界。实际计算时间还依赖变量规模、导数计算成本与稀疏结构，课件中的粗略时间估计不应当作对每个问题的固定保证。The compared methods alter the model: equal lamp powers restrict decisions; changes the error penalty; clipping solved powers to their bounds can degrade the fit. Worst absolute error admits an LP but differs from relative log error. The convex reformulation preserves the original optimizing decisions while respecting power bounds directly. Runtime also depends on dimension, derivative evaluation and sparsity; the slide’s rough estimate is not a universal fixed guarantee.

掌握Mastery

若局部极小点 x 有一个更好的可行点 y，则对任意很小的 θ>0，点 x+θ(y−x) 可行，并由凸性有 f(x+θ(y−x))≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)<f(x)。它能任意接近 x，却比 x 更好，和局部极小矛盾。所以局部极小点必是全局极小点。If a x had a better feasible point y, then for any small θ>0 the feasible point x+θ(y−x) would satisfy f(x+θ(y−x))≤(1−θ)f(x)+θf(y)<f(x). Such points approach x and contradict local minimality. Hence every local minimizer is global.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

x²≤1、x²≥1 和 x²=1 分别定义什么集合？哪些是凸的？Which sets do x²≤1, x²≥1 and x²=1 define, and which are convex?

展开核对Check the answer

分别为 [−1,1]、两条外侧射线、{−1,1}。后两者含 −1、1 却不含中点 0，只有第一个集合凸。They are [−1,1], two outer rays and {−1,1}. The latter two contain −1 and 1 but exclude midpoint zero. Only the first is convex.

深入In depth

历史旁注：Boyd 的课程资料把凸分析理论的发展、1947 年单纯形法和 1980 年代法分别列出。理论中的好性质需要算法进步才能广泛用于工程；“能识别凸结构”因此是一项实际建模能力。历史来源链接放在文末，算法细节留待后续课程。Historical note: Boyd’s slides distinguish the development of convex analysis, the 1947 algorithm and interior-point advances in the 1980s. Favorable theory became widely useful in engineering alongside algorithmic progress. Recognizing convex structure is therefore a practical modeling skill. Sources are linked at the end; algorithm details belong to later lectures.

05 · 局部、全局与非凸问题中的凸优化05 · Local and global behavior in nonlinear problems

Lecture 1 · PDF pp.36-41 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §1.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分局部与全局最优；理解松弛、下界和启发式方法的作用。Learning goal: explain local and global behavior in nonlinear problems and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

一般非凸问题可能有多个局部极小点。为零只是内点可微问题的一阶必要条件。Nonconvex problems may have several local minima. A zero is only a first-order necessary condition for an interior differentiable optimum.

了解Understand

把目标想成地形，下降方法通常只利用附近的坡度。走到一处谷底后，附近没有更低的位置，却可能在远处另有更深的谷。全局最优需要与全部可行点比较；局部最优只与某个邻域内的可行点比较。两者的量词不同，直接影响算法给出的保证。Think of the objective as terrain. A descent method typically uses nearby slopes. At one valley, no neighboring feasible point improves the objective, yet a deeper valley may exist far away. Global optimality compares against every feasible point; local optimality compares within some neighborhood. The different quantifiers determine what an algorithm can guarantee.

例子 f(x)=(x²−1)² 有两个全局极小点 ±1，值都是 0。导数 4x(x²−1) 在 −1、0、1 为零，但 0 的函数值是 1，附近往两侧走都会降低目标。于是“驻点”这个词只表示导数为零，不能单独说明极小性。给这个函数加很小的线性倾斜后，两处谷底的高度通常也会不同。For f(x)=(x²−1)², ±1 are global minima with value zero. The derivative 4x(x²−1) vanishes at −1, 0 and 1, but f(0)=1 and moving slightly either way lowers the value. A stationary point simply has zero derivative. A small linear tilt typically also makes the two valley depths different.

实际问题中常采用局部优化、凸松弛或穷举离散结构。凸松弛扩大最小化问题的可行集，因此给出原问题最优值的下界；松弛解还必须检查是否满足原约束。前五讲训练的凸性识别，就是为了知道什么时候局部结论足够、什么时候仍缺全局证明。Practical approaches include local optimization, convex relaxation and enumeration of discrete structures. Enlarging the feasible set of a minimization problem gives a lower bound on its optimum. A relaxed solution must still be checked against the original constraints. Convexity recognition tells us when local conclusions suffice and when a global argument remains missing.

掌握Mastery

对 f(x)=(x²−1)²，二阶导数是 12x²−4。在 ±1 处等于 8>0，局部曲率向上；在 0 处等于 −4<0，局部曲率向下。又因为平方恒非负且 ±1 取零，所以这两个局部极小点同时全局最优。二阶检验与非负下界分别解决局部和全局问题。Here f″(x)=12x²−4: it equals eight at ±1 and −4 at zero, showing upward and downward local curvature respectively. Nonnegativity of the square and attainment of zero establish global optimality at ±1. The second-derivative check and the lower bound answer local and global questions separately.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x³ 在 x=0 的导数为零。它是局部极小点吗？The derivative of f(x)=x³ vanishes at zero. Is zero a local minimum?

展开核对Check the answer

任意小的负 x 都有 x³<0，因此 0 不是局部极小点。Arbitrarily small negative x satisfy x³<0, so zero is not a local minimum.

深入In depth

非凸不等于所有实例都难解；特殊结构可能提供显式答案。凸性也不自动保证存在最优点或数值条件良好。要把结构保证、存在性和算法精度分开记录。Nonconvexity does not make every instance difficult; special structure may yield an explicit answer. Convexity alone guarantees neither attainment nor good numerical conditioning. Record structural guarantees, existence and numerical accuracy separately.

LECTURE 02

数学背景Mathematical background

06 · 向量与矩阵的内积06 · Inner products and directional response

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.4-5 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.1 · HW1 1(a),2

学完应能：算内积和迹；检查维数，解释线性泛函 zᵀx。Learning goal: explain inner products and directional response and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

标准内积是对应分量的乘积之和；它衡量两个向量的方向一致程度。The standard inner product sums products of matching components and measures directional alignment.

了解Understand

x、y 均为 n 维列向量，xᵀ 是转置后的行向量，所以 xᵀy 是一个数。以 x=(3,4)、y=(1,0) 为例，内积为 3，表示 x 在第一坐标方向的分量。若 y=(0,1)，结果为 4。把方向 y 归一化后，xᵀy 就是 x 沿这个单位方向的有符号投影长度。Both x and y are n-dimensional columns; xᵀ is a row, so xᵀy is a scalar. For x=(3,4) and y=(1,0), the inner product is three, extracting the first coordinate. With y=(0,1) it is four. For a normalized direction y, xᵀy is the signed projection length of x in that direction.

当内积为零且两个向量非零时，它们正交。例如 (3,4) 与 (4,−3) 的内积为 12−12=0。正内积表示夹角小于直角，负内积表示超过直角。零向量与所有向量的内积都为零，但不为它定义夹角。Two nonzero vectors with zero inner product are orthogonal. For (3,4) and (4,−3), the value is 12−12=0. Positive and negative inner products correspond to angles below and above a right angle. Zero has zero inner product with every vector but no defined angle.

为什么优化反复出现内积？线性目标 cᵀx 是内积，方向导数 ∇f(x)ᵀh 也是内积。前者比较决策与费用系数，后者比较移动方向与局部变化系数。把这两个向量的角色认清，后面理解和支撑超平面会更直接。Why do inner products recur in optimization? Linear cost cᵀx and directional derivative ∇f(x)ᵀh both have this form. The former pairs decisions with prices; the latter pairs movement with local change coefficients. Distinguishing the vector roles prepares us for s and supporting hyperplanes.

掌握Mastery

可由平方非负证明。y≠0 时取 t=(xᵀy)/‖y‖²，展开 0≤‖x−ty‖²=‖x‖²−(xᵀy)²/‖y‖²，整理得 |xᵀy|≤‖x‖‖y‖。y=0 时两边都为零。非零向量取等当且仅当 x 是 y 的倍数。For y≠0, set t=(xᵀy)/‖y‖² and expand 0≤‖x−ty‖²=‖x‖²−(xᵀy)²/‖y‖² to obtain Cauchy–Schwarz. If y=0 both sides vanish. For nonzero vectors, equality holds exactly when they are linearly dependent.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

求 (1,2,−1) 和 (2,−1,0) 的内积，解释结果。Find the inner product of (1,2,−1) and (2,−1,0), and interpret it.

展开核对Check the answer

内积是 2−2+0=0，两个非零向量正交。The value is 2−2+0=0, so the nonzero vectors are orthogonal.

深入In depth

矩阵可用迹内积 tr(XᵀY)=ΣᵢⱼXᵢⱼYᵢⱼ；它将矩阵视为一组排列好的实数。随后 PSD 锥的对偶也在这个内积下定义。For matrices, tr(XᵀY)=ΣᵢⱼXᵢⱼYᵢⱼ treats entries as coordinates. The dual of the PSD cone will be defined with this inner product.

07 · 范数、单位球与二次范数07 · Norms, unit balls and weighted length

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.6-9 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.2–A.1.3 · HW1 1(a),3(b),5

学完应能：检查范数公理；画三种；用正定矩阵定义椭圆度量。Learning goal: explain norms, s and weighted length and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

范数满足正定性、绝对齐次性与三角不等式； P 定义二次范数 √(xᵀPx)。A norm satisfies definiteness, absolute homogeneity and the triangle inequality. A positive definite P defines √(xᵀPx).

了解Understand

不同任务对误差的计费方式不同：绝对误差总和对应 ℓ₁，平方和的根对应 ℓ₂，最坏分量对应 ℓ∞。对 x=(3,−4)，它们分别为 7、5、4。三个量都能当作长度，但表达的是不同资源预算，不能在证明中随意替换。Tasks charge errors differently: total absolute error uses ℓ₁, the root of squared errors uses ℓ₂, and the worst component uses ℓ∞. At x=(3,−4), these are seven, five and four. Each measures length under a different budget and cannot be substituted arbitrarily in proofs.

单位球 B={x:‖x‖≤1} 把预算画出来。二维 ℓ₁ 球为菱形、ℓ₂ 球为圆盘、ℓ∞ 球为正方形。图中都包含边界与内部。取一个方向，沿射线走到边界，边界越远，就表示该方向在同样预算下可允许更大坐标幅度。The unit ball B={x:‖x‖≤1} visualizes the budget. In two dimensions the ℓ₁, ℓ₂ and ℓ∞ balls are a diamond, disk and square, including their boundaries and interiors. Along a ray, a more distant boundary permits greater coordinate magnitude under the same budget.

若不同方向的误差重要性不同，可用 P=diag(4,1)，得到 ‖x‖P=√(4x₁²+x₂²)。第一方向被计入更大权重，单位球在该方向半径只有 1/2。P 必须对称正定；若 P=diag(1,0)，(0,1) 的长度为零，会违反范数的正定性。For unequal directional importance, P=diag(4,1) gives ‖x‖P=√(4x₁²+x₂²). The first direction is more expensive, and the unit ball radius there is one half. P must be symmetric positive definite. With diag(1,0), the nonzero vector (0,1) has zero length, violating definiteness.

掌握Mastery

把正定 P 分解为 P=(P½)ᵀP½，则 ‖x‖P=‖P½x‖₂。P½ 可逆，故只有 x=0 时长度为零；绝对齐次性由欧氏范数得到；三角不等式由 ‖P½(x+y)‖₂≤‖P½x‖₂+‖P½y‖₂ 得到。这样把三个范数公理都转移到已经熟悉的欧氏长度上。Write P=(P½)ᵀP½, giving ‖x‖P=‖P½x‖₂. Invertibility gives definiteness. Euclidean homogeneity gives absolute homogeneity, and its triangle inequality applied to P½x and P½y gives the third axiom. All three properties transfer from Euclidean length.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

‖x‖₀ 常表示非零分量数。它满足范数的绝对齐次性吗？The notation ‖x‖₀ often counts nonzero entries. Does it satisfy absolute homogeneity?

展开核对Check the answer

不满足：x=(1,0) 的计数为 1，2x 的计数仍为 1，并不等于 2。No. Both (1,0) and (2,0) have count one, rather than a factor of two.

深入In depth

范数平方通常不是范数，因为缩放系数变成 |α|²。半正定二次型给出半范数；它仍有三角不等式，却可能无法区分某些非零向量与零向量。A squared norm is generally not a norm: scaling uses |α|². A PSD quadratic form gives a seminorm, which retains the triangle inequality but may assign zero length to nonzero vectors.

核对原课件 · 6-9Check original slides · 6-9

08 · 有限维范数的等价性08 · Equivalence of norms

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.10 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分等价与数值相等；解释长度比较与收敛一致性。Learning goal: explain equivalence of norms and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

有限维空间中的任意两个范数互相有正常数界；它们给出相同的收敛与开放性。Any two norms on a finite-dimensional space bound each other by positive constants and induce the same convergence and openness.

了解Understand

“等价”表示两种长度之间有统一比例界，常数不能随着 x 变化。它没有宣称长度数值相等。比如在二维，(1,1) 的 ℓ∞ 长度为 1，ℓ₂ 长度为 √2；但任意二维 x 都满足 ‖x‖∞≤‖x‖₂≤√2‖x‖∞。Equivalent means uniformly comparable lengths, with constants independent of x. Numerical lengths need not match: (1,1) has ℓ∞ length one and ℓ₂ length √2, yet every two-dimensional x satisfies ‖x‖∞≤‖x‖₂≤√2‖x‖∞.

如果一个向量序列在 ℓ₂ 中趋于零，上面的下界使 ℓ∞ 也趋于零；反过来，上界使 ℓ₂ 趋于零。因此有限维里用哪一种范数定义极限，不会改变“收敛到同一点”这个判断。实际优化的误差阈值却会受到常数和维数影响。If a sequence tends to zero in ℓ₂, the lower comparison makes it tend to zero in ℓ∞; the upper comparison proves the converse. In finite dimensions, changing norm does not change convergence to a given point. Numerical tolerances still depend on comparison constants and dimension.

掌握Mastery

最大分量的平方不超过平方和，给出 ‖x‖∞≤‖x‖₂；每项平方不超过 ‖x‖∞²，共 n 项，给出 ‖x‖₂≤√n‖x‖∞。再对向量 (|x₁|,…,|xₙ|) 与全 1 向量使用 Cauchy–Schwarz，得 ‖x‖₁≤√n‖x‖₂。The largest squared entry is no greater than the sum, giving ‖x‖∞≤‖x‖₂. Each entry is bounded by ‖x‖∞ and there are n entries, giving the reverse bound with √n. Cauchy–Schwarz with the all-ones vector gives ‖x‖₁≤√n‖x‖₂.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

给出使 ‖x‖₂=√n‖x‖∞ 取等的非零向量。Give a nonzero vector attaining ‖x‖₂=√n‖x‖∞.

展开核对Check the answer

取所有分量绝对值相等，例如 x=(1,…,1)。Take all entries with equal magnitude, for example (1,…,1).

深入In depth

一般等价性可在一个范数的单位球面上，对另一个连续范数取正的最小值和有限最大值，再用齐次性缩放。关键是有限维球面紧致；无限维中不能直接沿用这一论证。General equivalence follows by taking the positive minimum and finite maximum of one continuous norm on the unit sphere of another, then scaling. Compactness of finite-dimensional spheres is essential; the argument cannot simply be transferred to infinite dimensions.

09 · 诱导矩阵范数09 · Induced matrix norms

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.11-12 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.5 · HW1 1(b),1(c)

学完应能：推导最大行和、最大列和与；证明次乘性。Learning goal: explain induced matrix norms and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

是线性映射的最大长度放大率；输入、输出的向量范数必须先指定。An is the largest length amplification of a linear map, relative to specified input and output norms.

了解Understand

A 是 m×n 矩阵。我们把输入 x 归一化到单位预算，再问输出 Ax 最大能有多长。这个问题把矩阵理解为“变换”，因此诱导范数也叫算子范数。对 diag(3,2)，欧氏单位圆映成轴半径 3、2 的椭圆，最大放大率为 3。For an m×n A, normalize the input budget to one and ask how long Ax can become. This treats A as a transformation, hence the name operator norm. The map diag(3,2) sends the Euclidean unit circle to an ellipse with radii three and two, so its greatest amplification is three.

若输入输出都用 ℓ∞，每个 |xⱼ|≤1。第 i 行输出的绝对值至多 Σⱼ|aᵢⱼ|。因此诱导 ℓ∞ 范数是最大绝对行和。例如 A=[[1,−2],[3,1]] 的两行绝对和为 3、4，所以范数为 4。选 x=(1,1)，第二行输出为 4，确实达到上界。With ℓ∞ on both spaces, every |xⱼ|≤1. Output entry i is bounded by Σⱼ|aᵢⱼ|, giving the maximum absolute row sum. For A=[[1,−2],[3,1]], row sums are three and four. The input (1,1) makes the second output four, attaining the bound.

谱范数、和逐元素 ℓ₁ 范数是不同概念。谱范数等于最大奇异值，Frobenius 范数把所有元素平方求和再开根号。diag(3,2) 的这两者分别为 3 和 √13。看到 ‖A‖₂ 时要从课程约定辨认它指的是哪一种。Spectral, Frobenius and entrywise ℓ₁ norms differ. Spectral norm is the largest singular value; is the root of the sum of squared entries. For diag(3,2) these are three and √13. Interpret ‖A‖₂ using the course convention.

诱导 ℓ₁ 范数对应最大绝对列和。因为 ‖Ax‖₁≤ΣᵢΣⱼ|aᵢⱼ||xⱼ|=Σⱼ(Σᵢ|aᵢⱼ|)|xⱼ|≤(最大列和)‖x‖₁，单位输入给出上界。选最大列和对应的坐标单位向量 eⱼ，输出就是那一列，长度恰好达到上界。例子 [[1,−2],[3,1]] 的列和为 4、3，诱导 ℓ₁ 范数也为 4，取输入 (1,0) 达到；这个数碰巧和其诱导 ℓ∞ 相同，一般矩阵不会相同。The induced ℓ₁ norm is the maximum absolute column sum. Summing the rowwise triangle bounds gives ‖Ax‖₁≤Σⱼ(Σᵢ|aᵢⱼ|)|xⱼ|≤(maximum column sum)‖x‖₁. Choose the coordinate unit vector for a maximizing column; its output is that column and attains the bound. For [[1,−2],[3,1]], column sums are four and three, giving norm four at input (1,0). It happens to equal this matrix’s induced ℓ∞ norm; equality is not general.

掌握Mastery

作业 1(b)：上界已经由每行的三角不等式得到。选达到最大绝对行和的一行 k，令 xⱼ=sgn(aₖⱼ)，零元素处取 0。于是 ‖x‖∞≤1，(Ax)ₖ=Σⱼ|aₖⱼ|，得下界等于上界。作业 1(c)：若 B 将空间 X 映到 Y，A 将 Y 映到 Z，依次用长度界得到 ‖ABx‖Z≤‖A‖Y→Z‖B‖X→Y‖x‖X，再取单位球上的。中间的 Y 范数必须一致。For HW1 1(b), the rowwise triangle inequality gives the upper bound. Choose a maximizing row k and xⱼ=sgn(aₖⱼ), with zero at zero entries. Then ‖x‖∞≤1 and (Ax)ₖ=Σⱼ|aₖⱼ|, attaining it. For 1(c), if B maps X to Y and A maps Y to Z, apply the length bound twice and take the over the X unit ball. The intermediate Y norm must match.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

A=[[2,−1],[−4,3]] 的诱导 ℓ∞ 范数是多少？构造单位输入取到它。Find the induced ℓ∞ norm of A=[[2,−1],[−4,3]] and an attaining unit input.

展开核对Check the answer

行绝对和为 3、7。取 x=(−1,1)，输出为 (−3,7)，所以范数为 7。Absolute row sums are three and seven. Input (−1,1) gives output (−3,7), attaining seven.

深入In depth

输入用 ℓ₁、输出用 ℓ∞ 时，诱导范数等于最大元素绝对值。混合范数也合法，关键是名称中说明空间与范数；次乘性仍按相容的映射链使用。From ℓ₁ input to ℓ∞ output, the induced norm is the largest absolute entry. Mixed norms are valid when spaces and norms are specified; submultiplicativity follows a compatible chain of maps.

10 · 对偶范数：上界与取等10 · Dual norms: measure a linear response

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.13-16 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.1.6；A.1.3 · HW1 1(a)

学完应能：求常见对偶；用换元与取等向量求的对偶。Learning goal: explain dual norms: measure a linear response and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

为什么需要一个“对偶”长度Why introduce a dual measure of length 当前层新增Added at this level

已知向量长度并不足以直接比较线性响应：同一向量在不同预算球里能取得的内积上限不同。对偶范数把预算约束转成一个精确系数。例如误差 h 满足 ‖h‖≤ε，则线性预测误差 |zᵀh|≤ε‖z‖*；对非线性函数，令 z=∇f(x) 可控制一阶变化。下面保留经过修订的完整讲解，从预算、几何一路推到二次范数。A vector length alone does not directly quantify linear response: different budget balls give different achievable inner-product bounds. A dual norm converts the budget into an exact coefficient. If error h satisfies ‖h‖≤ε, then |zᵀh|≤ε‖z‖*. For nonlinear functions, z=∇f(x) controls first-order change. The full revised explanation below proceeds from budgets and geometry to s.

01 · 长度、内积与单位球01 · Length, inner product and unit ball

Lecture 2 · pp.4–8 / textbook A.1.1–A.1.3

学完应能：读懂 x 和 z 的角色，计算三种长度，并判断一个向量是否满足单位球约束。After studying: identify the roles of x and z, compute three lengths and check membership of a unit ball.

速通Quick

x 和 z 都是实数列向量，n 是它们的坐标个数。z 在每次优化中固定，x 是可以选择的向量。记为 ；记为 ；是所有满足 的向量。Both x and z are real column vectors, and n is their number of coordinates. During each optimization z is fixed and x is chosen. A is written , the is written , and the contains all vectors satisfying .

了解Understand

把 x=(x₁,x₂)ᵀ 看成平面上的一个点，或从原点指向这个点的箭头。下标 1、2 标记坐标；右上角 T 表示转置，把列向量变成行向量。固定 z=(3,−2)ᵀ 后，zᵀx 是行向量乘列向量，结果只有一个数。Think of x=(x₁,x₂)ᵀ as a point in the plane or as an arrow from the origin. Subscripts 1 and 2 label coordinates. The superscript T denotes transpose, turning a column into a row. With z=(3,−2)ᵀ fixed, zᵀx multiplies a row by a column and produces one real number.

例如 x=(1,−1)ᵀ 时，内积为 3×1+(−2)×(−1)=5。若把 x₁ 加大，第一项会增加；若把 x₂ 变得更负，第二项也会增加。没有约束时，两种做法都能让目标无限增大。为了得到一个有限的最大响应，我们接下来限制 x 的长度。For x=(1,−1)ᵀ, the inner product is 3×1+(−2)×(−1)=5. Increasing x₁ raises the first term; making x₂ more negative raises the second. Without a constraint, either action can make the objective arbitrarily large. To obtain a finite largest response, we next limit the length of x.

为什么“长度”可以有不同规则Why length can follow different rules

范数是一个长度函数。对同一向量，它可以把各坐标的绝对值加起来，也可以按勾股定理计算，还可以只看绝对值最大的坐标。二维中常用的三个规则如下。符号 ℓ 读作小写字母 ell；下标指明所选规则，∞ 表示无穷。A norm is a length function. It may add the absolute coordinate values, use the Pythagorean rule or take the largest coordinate magnitude. The three standard two-dimensional rules are given below. The symbol ℓ is the lowercase letter ell; its subscript identifies the rule, and ∞ denotes infinity.

对 x=(3,−2)ᵀ，这三个长度分别为 5、√13、3。它们都非负，并且只有 x=0 时长度为零；把 x 乘以 t，长度就乘以 |t|；把两个向量相加，所得长度不超过两个长度之和。最后一条叫三角不等式，与走直达路线不比绕路更长的直觉相同。这些性质使它们都能称为范数。For x=(3,−2)ᵀ, the three lengths are five, √13 and three. They are nonnegative and vanish only at x=0. Multiplying x by t multiplies its length by |t|. The length of a sum is at most the sum of the two lengths. This last property is the triangle inequality, expressing that a direct route is no longer than a route through an intermediate point. These properties make all three functions norms.

单位球包含边界，也包含内部The unit ball includes its boundary and interior

单位球就是“长度最多为 1”的全部选择。ℓ₁ 约束要求 |x₁|+|x₂|≤1，所以两个坐标共享一个总预算；ℓ∞ 约束要求 |x₁|≤1 且 |x₂|≤1，所以每个坐标都可以独立使用自己的预算；ℓ₂ 约束是 x₁²+x₂²≤1。三条约束在二维里分别给出菱形、正方形和圆盘。The unit ball consists of all choices with length at most one. Under ℓ₁, the constraint |x₁|+|x₂|≤1 gives the coordinates a shared budget. Under ℓ∞, each of |x₁| and |x₂| is at most one, so each coordinate has its own budget. Under ℓ₂, the constraint is x₁²+x₂²≤1. In two dimensions these give a diamond, square and disk respectively.

看图时先找坐标轴方向的顶点：三种球都包含 (1,0) 和 (0,1)。再检查 (1,1)：它的 ℓ₁ 长度为 2、ℓ₂ 长度为 √2、ℓ∞ 长度为 1，所以只有正方形允许这个点。后面同一个目标出现三个不同最大值，原因就藏在这些不同的可行选择里。First identify the axis points in the diagrams: all three balls contain (1,0) and (0,1). Then test (1,1). Its ℓ₁, ℓ₂ and ℓ∞ lengths are two, √2 and one, so only the square admits this point. The different feasible choices will explain why the same objective has three different maximum values.

02 · 为什么要定义对偶范数02 · Why define a dual norm?

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6 · printed pp.636–637 / PDF pp.650–651

学完应能：说明固定什么、选择什么、约束什么，并用支撑直线解释最后的最大值。After studying: state what is fixed, chosen and constrained, and interpret the maximum using a supporting line.

速通Quick

固定原范数和 z，让 x 遍历原范数的单位球，对所有 zᵀx 取上确界，得到 。星号 * 标记相对于当前原范数的对偶；原范数一旦改变，右侧允许的 x 也会改变。Fix a primal norm and z. Let x over the primal unit ball and take the supremum of zᵀx. The result is the . The star is relative to the current primal norm. Changing that norm changes the allowed vectors on the right.

了解Understand

先问一个具体问题：一个长度预算最多为 1 的向量，能对系数 z 产生多大的内积？为了回答它，我们把每个可行 x 代入 zᵀx，再比较得到的数。例如以 ℓ∞ 为长度规则、z=(3,−2)ᵀ 时，x=(0,0) 给 0，x=(1,0) 给 3，x=(1,−1) 给 5。这些只是候选值；还需要说明能否找到比 5 更大的可行值。Start with a concrete question: how large an inner product with z can a vector produce when its length budget is at most one? Evaluate zᵀx at feasible vectors and compare the numbers. With primal norm ℓ∞ and z=(3,−2)ᵀ, the choices (0,0), (1,0) and (1,−1) give zero, three and five. These are candidate values; we must still decide whether a feasible vector can do better than five.

符号 让定义也能用于“越来越接近某个数，却没有点达到它”的情形。比如只允许 0<x<1，最大化 x：0.9、0.99、0.999 都可取到，但 1 不可取到。所有值都不超过 1，任何小于 1 的数又挡不住全部可取值，因此上确界是 1。这里没有 。The notation also handles values that approach a number without attaining it. If 0<x<1 and we maximize x, the values 0.9, 0.99 and 0.999 are allowed, while one is not. One bounds all values, but no smaller number does, so the supremum is one. There is no in this example.

有限维空间可以先理解为只有固定个数坐标的空间。集合有界表示其中的向量长度被某个固定数限制，不能无限增大；集合闭表示集合中的一串点收敛后，极限仍留在集合中。连续函数则表示点的小幅移动不会让函数值突然跳变。有限维中的极值定理说明：在非空的闭有界集合上，连续实值函数能取到最大值和最小值。A finite-dimensional space has a fixed finite number of coordinates. A bounded set has a uniform bound on the lengths of its vectors; a retains the limit of any convergent sequence from the set. Continuity means that small changes in the point cannot produce sudden jumps in the function value. The finite-dimensional extreme value theorem states that a continuous real-valued function attains both a maximum and a minimum on a nonempty closed bounded set.

本章的情况更好：单位球包括边界，而且在有限维空间里是闭且有界的。线性函数 zᵀx 连续，因此最大值实际能在单位球中取到。这里 sup 可以写成 max。教材保留 sup 的定义，计算时我们仍然要找出一个真正达到上界的 x。Our situation is better: the unit ball includes its boundary and is closed and bounded in a finite-dimensional space. Since zᵀx is continuous, it attains a maximum on that ball. Thus sup can be replaced by max here. The textbook retains sup in the definition, and our calculations will explicitly construct a vector attaining the bound.

固定的 z 与得到的数，各是什么What z and the resulting number represent

定义中的 z 是一个向量，‖z‖* 是一个数。z 决定怎样给 x 的各坐标加权，‖z‖* 记录在单位长度约束下这些权重能产生的最大响应。若把 z 乘以 2，每个内积也乘以 2，最大响应因此翻倍；若 z=0，每个内积都为零，对偶范数就是零。The input z is a vector, while ‖z‖* is a number. The vector specifies weights for the coordinates of x, and the dual norm records the largest response under the unit-length constraint. Doubling z doubles every inner product and therefore doubles the largest response. If z=0, every inner product is zero and so is the dual norm.

把内积相等的点画成直线Draw the points with the same inner product

二维中，zᵀx=c 表示目标值恰好为 c 的所有点。以 z=(1,0)ᵀ 为例，方程变成 x₁=c，所以得到一条竖直直线。c 增大时，直线向右移动。在单位圆盘里，c=0 的直线穿过中心，c=1 的直线恰好接触最右端，c>1 时就找不到可行点。因此这个方向的最大内积是 1。In two dimensions, zᵀx=c is the set of points with objective value c. For z=(1,0)ᵀ it becomes x₁=c, a vertical line. Increasing c moves the line to the right. On the unit disk, c=0 passes through its center, c=1 touches its rightmost point, and c>1 admits no feasible point. The maximum inner product in this direction is therefore one.

一般非零 z 决定直线的法向方向，也就是垂直于直线的方向。增大 c 会让直线沿 z 向外平移。最后一条还能接触单位球的直线叫支撑直线，它对应的 c 就是 ‖z‖*。给定集合和方向后这样求最大内积的函数，称为 ；对偶范数就是单位球的。A general nonzero z specifies the normal direction, perpendicular to the line. Increasing c translates the line outward along z. The last line still touching the unit ball is a supporting line, and its c value is ‖z‖*. The function that maximizes an inner product over a set in a specified direction is its . The dual norm is the of the unit ball.

跟着图做一次Try this with the diagram

先选择 ℓ₂，把方向调到 0°，把直线位置从 0 调到 1，再调到 1.1。你应看到直线从圆盘中心移到最右侧，再离开圆盘。保持方向不变切到 ℓ₁ 和 ℓ∞：三个球在横轴上的最远点都是 (1,0)，所以此时对偶值都为 1。最后把方向改成 45°，再切换球形状，比较数值怎样变化。Choose ℓ₂, set the direction to 0°, then move the line position from zero to one and to 1.1. It moves from the disk’s center to its rightmost point and then outside. Keep the direction fixed and switch to ℓ₁ and ℓ∞: all three balls reach (1,0) along this axis, so all three dual values are one. Finally use 45° and compare the values as you switch shapes.

图中 z 的欧氏长度固定为 1，方向滑块只改变方向。蓝箭头表示 z，红点表示一个，灰绿色实线表示当前位置，红色虚线表示最优支撑线。“直线位置”是 c 与最优值的比：调到 1 表示到达最优值，调到 1.1 表示试图超过它 10%。图中的 z 与上一段手算用的 (3,−2) 长度不同，数值比较时要留意这个约定。In the experiment z has Euclidean length one, and the direction slider only changes its direction. The blue arrow shows z, the red point a , the gray-green solid line the current line and the red dashed line the optimal supporting line. The position slider is c divided by the optimum: one reaches it, and 1.1 attempts a value ten percent larger. This normalized z differs in length from the vector (3,−2) used in our calculation.

为什么没有在目标外面加绝对值Why the objective needs no absolute value

任何范数都满足 ‖−x‖=‖x‖，所以单位球里的 x 和 −x 总是成对出现。如果某个 x 给出负内积，就换成 −x，得到同样大小的正内积。因此最大化 zᵀx 与最大化 |zᵀx| 的结果相同。这个结论来自可行集的对称性；如果换成不对称的集合，不能直接照用。Every norm satisfies ‖−x‖=‖x‖, so x and −x occur as a pair in its unit ball. If x gives a negative inner product, −x gives a positive one of the same magnitude. Maximizing zᵀx therefore gives the same result as maximizing |zᵀx|. This uses symmetry of the feasible set and cannot automatically be transferred to an asymmetric set.

掌握Mastery

定义给出的函数也满足第 1 节的范数性质。先看非负性：x=0 总在单位球中，目标为 0，所以上确界至少为 0。若 z=0，目标处处为 0，对偶范数为 0。若 z≠0，选 x=z/‖z‖，这里分母是原范数；它原长度为 1，而且 zᵀx=zᵀz/‖z‖>0，所以只有零向量的对偶范数为零。The defined function satisfies the norm properties from Section 1. It is nonnegative because x=0 is feasible and gives zero. When z=0, every value is zero. For z≠0 choose x=z/‖z‖, using the primal norm in the denominator. Its primal length is one and zᵀx=zᵀz/‖z‖>0. Thus the dual norm vanishes only at zero.

对缩放 t≥0，目标中的 t 可以直接从上确界提出，因此 ‖tz‖*=t‖z‖*。若 t<0，先用单位球对称性得到 ‖−z‖*=‖z‖*，再提出 |t|，所以一般有 ‖tz‖*=|t|‖z‖*。For t≥0, the factor t can be taken outside the supremum, giving ‖tz‖*=t‖z‖*. For t<0, symmetry first gives ‖−z‖*=‖z‖*, and then the factor |t| can be taken outside. Hence ‖tz‖*=|t|‖z‖* in general.

最后检查三角不等式。对任意单位球内的 x，(z+w)ᵀx=zᵀx+wᵀx，而两项分别不超过 ‖z‖*、‖w‖*。因此每个可行 x 都有 (z+w)ᵀx≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*，再对左侧取上确界，得到 ‖z+w‖*≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*。有限性由前面有限维闭有界单位球上的最大值存在保证。For the triangle inequality, every x in the unit ball satisfies (z+w)ᵀx=zᵀx+wᵀx, with the terms bounded by ‖z‖* and ‖w‖* respectively. Taking the supremum on the left gives ‖z+w‖*≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*. Finiteness follows from the maximum-existence result on the finite-dimensional closed bounded unit ball.

03 · 把三个常用对偶算出来03 · Calculate the three standard duals

Lecture 2 · pp.14–16 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：用同一个 z 比较三种约束，说明为什么结果不同，并给出达到最大值的向量。After studying: compare three constraints for the same z, explain their different values and give attaining vectors.

速通Quick

原范数Primal norm对应对偶范数Associated dual normz=(3,−2) 的对偶值Dual value at z=(3,−2)
ℓ₁ℓ∞3
ℓ₂ℓ₂√13
ℓ∞ℓ₁5

表格第一列决定定义中 x 的约束，第二列决定怎样计算 z 的对偶值。称“ℓ₂ 自对偶”，是说它的对偶仍由 ℓ₂ 长度计算。The first column determines the constraint on x in the definition; the second tells us how to compute the dual value of z. Saying that ℓ₂ is self-dual means that its dual is also calculated using the ℓ₂ length.

了解Understand

原范数 ℓ∞：每个坐标都可使用自己的预算Primal norm ℓ∞: a separate budget for each coordinate

约束 ‖x‖∞≤1 等价于 |x₁|≤1、|x₂|≤1。为了提高 3x₁−2x₂，第一项应选 x₁=1，第二项应选 x₂=−1。这两种选择可以同时满足，所以目标达到 3+2=5。任何可行 x 都有 3x₁≤3、−2x₂≤2，故它们的和不会超过 5。我们同时找到了上界 5 和达到这个值的向量 (1,−1)ᵀ。The constraint ‖x‖∞≤1 means |x₁|≤1 and |x₂|≤1. To improve 3x₁−2x₂, choose x₁=1 for the first term and x₂=−1 for the second. Both choices are feasible at once, giving 3+2=5. Every feasible x satisfies 3x₁≤3 and −2x₂≤2, so their sum cannot exceed five. We have found both the bound and the attaining vector (1,−1)ᵀ.

原范数 ℓ₁：两个坐标共享总预算Primal norm ℓ₁: the coordinates share a total budget

现在约束变成 |x₁|+|x₂|≤1。前面的 (1,−1) 用掉预算 2，已经不可行。第一坐标每用一单位预算能产生 3 的响应，第二坐标最多产生 2；要提高总响应，就把预算全部给第一坐标，选 x=(1,0)ᵀ，得到 3。若把一半预算给每个坐标，选 x=(1/2,−1/2)ᵀ，只得到 3/2+1=2.5。Now the constraint is |x₁|+|x₂|≤1. The previous vector (1,−1) uses a budget of two and is infeasible. A unit of budget in the first coordinate gives a response of three, while the second gives at most two. Allocate the entire budget to the first coordinate: x=(1,0)ᵀ gives three. Splitting it evenly, using (1/2,−1/2)ᵀ, gives only 3/2+1=2.5.

怎样排除别的分配更好？对每个可行 x，3x₁−2x₂≤3|x₁|+2|x₂|≤3(|x₁|+|x₂|)≤3。第二步把较小的系数 2 放大为 3，从而把两种预算合并估计。这个上界刚好由 (1,0)ᵀ 达到，因此最大值为 3。How do we rule out a better allocation? Every feasible x satisfies 3x₁−2x₂≤3|x₁|+2|x₂|≤3(|x₁|+|x₂|)≤3. The second step replaces the smaller coefficient two with three, allowing a bound in terms of the combined budget. The vector (1,0)ᵀ attains this bound, so the maximum is three.

原范数 ℓ₂：沿着 z 的方向走到圆周Primal norm ℓ₂: follow z to the circle

欧氏长度满足 ：内积不超过两个欧氏长度的乘积。这里 ‖z‖₂=√(3²+(−2)²)=√13，且 ‖x‖₂≤1，所以 zᵀx≤√13。要达到上界，让 x 与 z 同向，并把 x 缩放到长度 1，即 x=(3,−2)ᵀ/√13。The bounds an inner product by the product of the Euclidean lengths. Here ‖z‖₂=√(3²+(−2)²)=√13 and ‖x‖₂≤1, giving zᵀx≤√13. To attain it, make x point in the same direction as z and rescale its length to one: x=(3,−2)ᵀ/√13.

这两次代入各回答一个问题：第一式说明选择的 x 确实在单位球里；第二式说明它达到我们算出的上界。找到一个数值很大的向量还不够，它必须满足原约束。The two substitutions answer different questions. The first verifies that the chosen vector belongs to the unit ball; the second shows that it attains our bound. A vector with a large objective value is useful only if it satisfies the original constraint.

读完三个例子，应能分清：原范数限制 x，目标是 zᵀx，最大化点 x* 是向量，对偶值 ‖z‖* 是数。证明最大值时，先找所有可行点都无法超过的上界，再找一个可行点达到它。After these examples, distinguish the constraint on x, the objective zᵀx, the vector x* that maximizes it and the number ‖z‖*. To establish a maximum, bound every feasible value and then exhibit a feasible point attaining the bound.

掌握Mastery

ℓ₂ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ₂

第一个不等式允许内积为负；第二个是 Cauchy–Schwarz；第三个使用单位球约束。z≠0 时选 x*=z/‖z‖₂，它长度为 1，且 zᵀx*=‖z‖₂。z=0 时所有目标值为零，选 x=0 即可，因此对所有 z 都有 ‖z‖*=‖z‖₂。The first inequality allows a negative inner product, the second is Cauchy–Schwarz and the third uses the unit-ball constraint. For z≠0 choose x*=z/‖z‖₂, which has length one and gives zᵀx*=‖z‖₂. For z=0 all objective values vanish, so choose x=0. Thus ‖z‖*=‖z‖₂ for every z.

ℓ∞ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ∞

约束 ‖x‖∞≤1 给每个 |xᵢ|≤1，因此可以逐项作估计。要取等，选 xᵢ*=sgn(zᵢ)，其中 对正、负、零分别返回 1、−1、0。这样每个坐标都满足约束，并且 zᵢxᵢ*=|zᵢ|，相加后恰好得到上界。The constraint ‖x‖∞≤1 gives |xᵢ|≤1 for every coordinate, allowing termwise bounds. To attain them, choose xᵢ*=sgn(zᵢ), where the returns one, minus one or zero for positive, negative or zero inputs. Every coordinate is feasible and satisfies zᵢxᵢ*=|zᵢ|, so their sum reaches the bound.

ℓ₁ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ₁

令 k 是某个满足 |zₖ|=maxᵢ|zᵢ| 的坐标。若 z≠0，选 x*=sgn(zₖ)eₖ，其中 只在第 k 个坐标为 1。于是 x* 的 ℓ₁ 长度为 1，且 zᵀx*=|zₖ|=‖z‖∞。若几个坐标并列最大，可以任选其中一个，最大化点也可能不唯一。若 z=0，直接取 x=0。Choose a coordinate k with |zₖ|=maxᵢ|zᵢ|. For z≠0, take x*=sgn(zₖ)eₖ, where the has one only in position k. This vector has ℓ₁ length one and gives zᵀx*=|zₖ|=‖z‖∞. If several coordinates tie, any one can be used and the maximizer may not be unique. For z=0 choose x=0.

04 · 为什么能约束任意长度的内积04 · Why the bound works for any length

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：把一个任意非零向量缩到单位球，再解释怎样乘回原长度。After studying: rescale a nonzero vector into the unit ball and explain how to recover its original length.

速通Quick

‖x‖ 是选定的原范数，‖z‖* 是它对应的对偶范数。这条不等式对任意 x,z 都成立；x 无需先满足单位球约束。The norm of x is the chosen primal norm, and the norm of z is its associated dual. This inequality holds for every x and z; x need not initially satisfy a unit-ball constraint.

了解Understand

对偶范数的定义只直接约束单位球里的向量，但任意非零向量都可以按比例缩进去。设原长度 r=‖x‖>0，令 u=x/r。范数的齐次性给 ‖u‖=‖x‖/r=1，所以 u 属于单位球。由定义及单位球的对称性，|zᵀu|≤‖z‖*。The definition of the dual norm directly controls vectors in the unit ball, but any nonzero vector can be rescaled into it. Let its length be r=‖x‖>0 and set u=x/r. Homogeneity gives ‖u‖=‖x‖/r=1, so u belongs to the unit ball. The definition and symmetry of the ball then give |zᵀu|≤‖z‖*.

现在把 x 写回 r u。内积对缩放是线性的，因此 zᵀx=r zᵀu；取绝对值时 r>0 不会变号。把刚才的单位长度上界乘以 r，就得到任意长度的上界。若 x=0，两个内积都为零，根本无需做除法。Now write x=r u. The inner product is linear in this scaling, so zᵀx=r zᵀu. Since r>0, taking the absolute value gives |zᵀx|=r|zᵀu|. Multiplying the unit-length bound by r gives the general bound. If x=0, both inner products are zero and no division is needed.

例如原范数是 ℓ∞，取 z=(3,−2)ᵀ、x=(2,−2)ᵀ。x 的原长度为 2，z 的对偶范数为 ‖z‖₁=5，于是上界为 2×5=10。直接计算 zᵀx=3×2+(−2)×(−2)=10，恰好取等。若仍用相同 z，但 x=(2,0)ᵀ，目标只有 6，依然满足上界 10；上界不要求每个 x 都取等。For primal norm ℓ∞, take z=(3,−2)ᵀ and x=(2,−2)ᵀ. The primal length of x is two and the dual norm of z is ‖z‖₁=5, giving a bound of ten. Direct calculation gives zᵀx=3×2+(−2)×(−2)=10, attaining it. With x=(2,0)ᵀ instead, the value is six and still obeys the bound of ten. A bound need not be attained by every vector.

掌握Mastery

证明最后补上 x=0 的情形：左侧为 0，右侧也为 0。不要在未知 x 是否为零时直接写 x/‖x‖。上式中的 v 是上确界内部使用的临时变量，它不改变原来固定的 z，也与已经选出的 u 没有额外约束关系。Finish by treating x=0: both sides are zero. Do not write x/‖x‖ before checking that x is nonzero. The symbol v is a temporary variable inside the supremum; it does not change the fixed z and imposes no additional relation on the already selected u.

05 · 二次范数：从椭圆换到圆05 · Quadratic norms: change an ellipse into a circle

Lecture 2 · p.8, pp.13–16 / textbook A.1.3, A.1.6, A.5.2 / HW1 · 1(a)

学完应能：解释矩阵 P 如何规定长度，理解逆矩阵出现的原因，并验证取等向量。After studying: explain how P defines length, why its inverse appears and how an attaining vector is verified.

速通Quick

设 P 为实对称 。它定义的 及其在标准内积下的对偶为：Let P be a real symmetric . Its and its dual under the standard inner product are:

P,* 下标表示“以 P-二次范数为原范数时的对偶”。对 z≠0，一个达到上界的向量是下式；z=0 时取 x=0，最大值为 0。The subscript P,* means the dual associated with the P-quadratic primal norm. For z≠0 an attaining vector is given below. For z=0, use x=0 and the maximum is zero.

了解Understand

P 给不同方向规定不同的长度代价P assigns different length costs to different directions

先取 P=diag(4,1)。 表示主对角线是 4、1，其余元素为零的方阵。把矩阵乘法展开，xᵀPx=4x₁²+x₂²，所以沿第一轴走一单位的长度为 2，沿第二轴走一单位的长度为 1。第一方向的位移在这个长度规则里更贵。Start with P=diag(4,1). The means a square matrix with four and one on the diagonal and zero elsewhere. Expanding the multiplication gives xᵀPx=4x₁²+x₂². A unit displacement along the first axis has length two, whereas a unit displacement along the second has length one. Motion in the first direction is more costly under this length rule.

单位球的第一轴半径为 1/2：x₂=0 时，4x₁²≤1 给 |x₁|≤1/2。第二轴半径为 1：x₁=0 时，x₂²≤1 给 |x₂|≤1。因此单位球是一个横向压窄的椭圆及其内部。若目标只想增加 x₁，最多只能走到 1/2；若只想增加 x₂，则可以走到 1。这让“较大的原权重对应较小的对偶响应”有了具体含义。The first-axis radius is 1/2: with x₂=0, the inequality 4x₁²≤1 gives |x₁|≤1/2. The second-axis radius is one: with x₁=0, we get |x₂|≤1. The unit ball is therefore an ellipse compressed horizontally, including its interior. An objective depending only on increasing x₁ can reach 1/2, while one depending only on increasing x₂ can reach one. This explains concretely why a larger primal weight reduces the dual response.

换坐标后，可以使用已经会算的圆球Change coordinates to use the Euclidean ball we already know

对这个椭圆，令 u₁=2x₁、u₂=x₂。约束立刻变成 u₁²+u₂²≤1，正好是欧氏单位圆盘。反过来，x₁=u₁/2、x₂=u₂，所以原目标 z₁x₁+z₂x₂ 变成 (z₁/2)u₁+z₂u₂。约束变成圆的同时，第一项的目标系数也减半了。For this ellipse, set u₁=2x₁ and u₂=x₂. The constraint becomes u₁²+u₂²≤1, the Euclidean unit disk. Conversely, x₁=u₁/2 and x₂=u₂, so z₁x₁+z₂x₂ becomes (z₁/2)u₁+z₂u₂. Turning the constraint into a circle also halves the first objective coefficient.

最后一步用第 3 节已经证明的欧氏对偶结果：圆球上的最大内积等于系数向量 (z₁/2,z₂) 的欧氏长度。平方以后第一项带 1/4，这正是 P⁻¹ 的第一对角元素。一般矩阵也按同一思路换元；逆矩阵出现的原因是原坐标要从变换后的坐标反解回来。The final step uses the Euclidean dual result proved in Section 3: on the disk, the maximum is the Euclidean length of the coefficient vector (z₁/2,z₂). Squaring introduces 1/4, the first diagonal entry of P⁻¹. A general matrix follows the same change-of-variables idea. An inverse appears because the original coordinates must be recovered from the transformed ones.

把最优点也换回原坐标Transform the maximizing point back as well

再取 z=(2,1)ᵀ。变换后目标为 u₁+u₂，系数是 (1,1)，所以最大值为 √2，圆球中的最优点为 u*=(1/√2,1/√2)ᵀ。把第一坐标除以 2，得到原椭圆中的 x*=(1/(2√2),1/√2)ᵀ。代回原约束得 4×1/8+1/2=1，代回原目标得 2/(2√2)+1/√2=√2。Now take z=(2,1)ᵀ. The transformed objective is u₁+u₂ with coefficients (1,1), so the maximum is √2 and the maximizing disk point is u*=(1/√2,1/√2)ᵀ. Divide its first coordinate by two to obtain x*=(1/(2√2),1/√2)ᵀ on the original ellipse. The constraint evaluates to 4×1/8+1/2=1 and the objective to 2/(2√2)+1/√2=√2.

注意这个 x* 与 z 并不同向。第 3 节“沿 z 走”使用了圆球的形状；椭圆先要换到圆球中，再沿变换后的系数方向走。若直接取 z/‖z‖₂=(2,1)ᵀ/√5，原约束会变成 17/5>1，这个向量不可行。Notice that x* is not parallel to z. The instruction to follow z in Section 3 relied on the circular ball. For an ellipse, first change to a circle and follow the transformed coefficient vector. Directly using z/‖z‖₂=(2,1)ᵀ/√5 would make the primal constraint 17/5>1, so that vector is infeasible.

跟着图做一次Try this with the diagram

先把 p₁=p₂=1，方向选 45°：球是圆，z 和 x* 同向。接着保持 p₂=1，只把 p₁ 增大到 4。椭圆横向变窄，红色最优向量转向第二轴，两个箭头不再同向。读出图下的 x*ᵀPx*，它应始终约为 1；再比较 zᵀx* 与“对偶值”，二者应相同。Set p₁=p₂=1 and choose 45°: the ball is circular and z and x* point in the same direction. Keep p₂=1 and increase only p₁ to four. The ellipse narrows horizontally and the red maximizing vector turns toward the second axis. Check that x*ᵀPx* remains approximately one and that zᵀx* matches the reported dual value.

这个实验使用正对角权重，且 z 的欧氏长度固定为 1，所以展示的是不同方向的变化；上一段的手算例子使用 z=(2,1)，长度不同。蓝箭头是目标系数 z，红箭头是原坐标的最优点 x*，虚线是法向为 z 的支撑线。权重滑块始终大于零，因此图中 P 一直正定。The experiment uses positive diagonal weights and a z of Euclidean length one to show directional changes. The worked vector (2,1) has a different length. The blue arrow is the objective coefficient z, the red arrow is the optimizer x* in the original coordinates, and the dashed line is a supporting line with normal z. Both weights stay positive, so P remains positive definite.

掌握Mastery

第 1 步：说明换元为什么存在Step 1: explain why the transformation exists

作业给定 P∈Sⁿ 且 P≻0。Sⁿ 表示 n×n 实对称矩阵的集合，P≻0 表示所有非零 x 都有 xᵀPx>0。正定条件保证 P 的全为正，所以可以求逆，也存在唯一正定 P½。这里只需要用到 P½ 对称、P½P½=P、P⁻½P½=I；I 是单位矩阵。The homework assumes P∈Sⁿ and P≻0. The set Sⁿ consists of real symmetric n×n matrices, and P≻0 means xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero x. All s are positive, ensuring invertibility and the unique positive definite P½. We use its symmetry and the identities P½P½=P and P⁻½P½=I, where I is the identity matrix.

为看懂下一句，先回忆特征值：若非零 v 满足 Pv=λv，P 作用后 v 的方向保持在同一直线上，只缩放 λ 倍，就称 λ 为特征值、v 为特征向量。实对称矩阵能够选取一组彼此正交、欧氏长度为 1 的特征向量作为坐标轴；正定性保证对应 λ 都严格大于零。Recall the meaning of an eigenvalue: if a nonzero vector v satisfies Pv=λv, the action of P leaves it on the same line and scales it by λ. We call λ an eigenvalue and v an eigenvector. A real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors: each has Euclidean length one, and distinct basis vectors are perpendicular. Positive definiteness makes the associated eigenvalues strictly positive.

对 diag(4,1)，P½=diag(2,1)，P⁻½=diag(1/2,1)。一般 P 的正交特征分解写成 P=QΛQᵀ，其中 QᵀQ=I，Λ 的对角元素是正特征值。取 P½=QΛ½Qᵀ 就可以得到所需平方根；这是对特征值开平方，不能对矩阵每个元素直接开平方。For diag(4,1), P½=diag(2,1) and P⁻½=diag(1/2,1). For a general P, write its orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition P=QΛQᵀ, where QᵀQ=I and Λ contains the positive eigenvalues. The matrix QΛ½Qᵀ is the required square root. This takes square roots of eigenvalues, not of individual entries.

第 2 步：同时改写约束和目标Step 2: transform both constraint and objective

令 u=P½x，则 x=P⁻½u。变换可逆，所以原中的每个 x 都对应圆球中的一个 u，反过来也成立；没有丢掉或增加可行选择。利用平方根对称性，分别改写：Set u=P½x, giving x=P⁻½u. The change is invertible, so every x in the corresponds to exactly one u in the Euclidean ball and conversely. No feasible choices are lost or added. Symmetry of the square root gives:

因此原约束 xᵀPx≤1 等价于 ‖u‖₂≤1。目标里新的固定系数向量是 w=P⁻½z。它与 z 维数相同，但各方向的权重经过了变换。Thus xᵀPx≤1 is equivalent to ‖u‖₂≤1. The transformed objective has fixed coefficient vector w=P⁻½z. It has the same dimension as z, but its directional weights have changed.

第 3 步：为所有可行点找上界Step 3: bound every feasible value

第一次估计使用 Cauchy–Schwarz，第二次使用 ‖u‖₂≤1。最后一步使用 P⁻½ 对称，且 P⁻½P⁻½=P⁻¹。至此只证明每个可行目标值都不超过 d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)，还需要展示这个上界可以达到。The first bound is Cauchy–Schwarz and the second uses ‖u‖₂≤1. The final equality uses symmetry of P⁻½ and P⁻½P⁻½=P⁻¹. We have shown that every feasible value is at most d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z); we must still show that this bound can be attained.

第 4 步：构造达到上界的向量Step 4: construct an attaining vector

当 z≠0 时，可逆性保证 w=P⁻½z≠0，所以 d=‖w‖₂>0。圆球中应选 u*=w/‖w‖₂=w/d，使 u* 同向且长度为 1。把它换回原坐标，得到：For z≠0, invertibility gives w=P⁻½z≠0 and hence d=‖w‖₂>0. In the Euclidean ball choose u*=w/‖w‖₂=w/d, aligned with w and of length one. Transforming back gives:

下面直接代回作业原式。因为 P⁻¹ 对称，转置后仍是 P⁻¹；矩阵乘积中的 P⁻¹P 可以消去为 I。第一项验证可行，第二项验证达到上界：Substitute this vector into the original problem. Symmetry of P⁻¹ means its transpose is unchanged, and P⁻¹P cancels to I. The first calculation checks feasibility; the second checks attainment:

第 5 步：补上 z=0，并写出结论Step 5: handle z=0 and conclude

若 z=0，所有 zᵀx 都为零，所以最大值为零，x=0 是一个可行最大化点。此时不能使用 x*=P⁻¹z/d，因为 d=0。两种情形合在一起，才得到对每个 z 都成立的对偶公式。If z=0, every inner product is zero, so the maximum is zero and x=0 is a feasible maximizer. Do not use x*=P⁻¹z/d in this case because d=0. Combining the zero and nonzero cases establishes the dual formula for every z.

回到作业 1(a) 时，请把证明写成完整论证：说明 P≻0 的作用，给出可逆换元，为所有可行 x 找上界，构造取等点并验证，最后处理零向量。仅写最终根号没有解释为什么它就是上确界。For HW1 1(a), write a complete argument: explain the role of P≻0, give the invertible transformation, bound every feasible value, construct and verify an attaining point, then handle zero. The final square root alone does not establish the supremum.

深入In depth

取 P=diag(1,0)，它是 ：xᵀPx=x₁²≥0。但非零向量 (0,1) 的“长度”为零，所以这个函数不满足范数的正定性。约束只要求 |x₁|≤1，x₂ 可以任意大，因此可行集是无限延伸的条带。Take P=diag(1,0), a , because xᵀPx=x₁²≥0. Its “length” vanishes at the nonzero vector (0,1), so it fails definiteness of a norm. The constraint only requires |x₁|≤1, with x₂ unrestricted, producing an unbounded strip.

若 z=(0,1)，目标 zᵀx=x₂ 可随着 x₂→+∞ 无限增大，上确界为 +∞。P⁻¹ 也不存在，于是前面的可逆换元和对偶范数结论都失去了前提。若 z=(1,0)，目标只看受限制的 x₁，最大值仍为 1。这两个例子说明：半正定情形要检查目标是否沿无代价方向增长，不能机械使用正定公式。For z=(0,1), the objective is x₂, which can grow without bound, giving supremum +∞. The inverse P⁻¹ also does not exist, invalidating the earlier invertible substitution. For z=(1,0), the objective only sees the constrained coordinate and its maximum is one. The semidefinite case therefore requires checking whether the objective grows in a zero-cost direction.

06 · 检查你能否独立完成06 · Check independent understanding

Self-authored exercises supporting HW1 · 1(a)

学完应能：自己识别原约束，构造取等点，并说明证明每一步的依据。After studying: identify the primal constraint, construct an attaining point and explain each proof step.

了解Understand

先检查概念。问题 1：同一个 z=(3,−2)，为什么原范数换成 ℓ₁ 后最大响应由 5 变成 3？问题 2：找到了目标值为 3 的可行向量，能立刻断定最大值就是 3 吗？先用自己的话回答，再展开下面的核对。Check the concepts first. Question 1: why does the largest response for z=(3,−2) drop from five to three when the primal norm changes from ℓ∞ to ℓ₁? Question 2: if a feasible vector gives objective value three, may we immediately conclude that three is the maximum? Answer in your own words before opening the checks.

展开概念核对Open the conceptual check

问题 1：ℓ∞ 允许两个坐标同时使用一单位预算，ℓ₁ 只给两个坐标合计一单位预算；原来的 (1,−1) 不再可行。问题 2：还需要证明所有可行向量的目标都不超过 3。一个可行向量只能证明“最大值至少为 3”，上界才能排除更大的值。For Question 1, ℓ∞ gives each coordinate a full unit budget, whereas ℓ₁ gives both together only one unit. The previous vector (1,−1) becomes infeasible. For Question 2, we must prove that all feasible values are at most three. One feasible vector only proves that the maximum is at least three; an upper bound rules out larger values.

掌握Mastery

题 A：原范数为 ℓ₁，z=(−2,5)ᵀ。求对偶范数，并给出一个可行向量实际达到它。证明应包括一个适用于所有可行 x 的不等式。Exercise A: the primal norm is ℓ₁ and z=(−2,5)ᵀ. Find the dual norm and a feasible vector attaining it. Include an inequality valid for every feasible x.

提示：先比较系数的绝对值Hint: compare coefficient magnitudes

第二坐标的系数绝对值 5 大于第一坐标的 2。先将 −2x₁+5x₂ 上界为 5(|x₁|+|x₂|)，再考虑把预算全部给第二坐标，并使乘积为正。The second coefficient magnitude five exceeds the first magnitude two. Bound −2x₁+5x₂ by 5(|x₁|+|x₂|), then allocate all the budget to the second coordinate with a positive product.

展开题 A 的完整核对Open the complete check for A

选 x*=(0,1)ᵀ，它的 ℓ₁ 长度是 1，目标为 −2×0+5×1=5。上界 5 被实际达到，所以对偶范数为 5。Choose x*=(0,1)ᵀ. Its ℓ₁ length is one and its objective is −2×0+5×1=5. The bound is attained, so the dual norm is five.

题 B：P=diag(9,4)，z=(3,4)ᵀ。计算二次范数的对偶值，找取等向量，并检查原约束与原目标。先自己写出 P⁻¹ 和 d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)，再尝试构造 x*。Exercise B: P=diag(9,4) and z=(3,4)ᵀ. Compute the quadratic dual value, construct an attaining vector and check the original constraint and objective. First write P⁻¹ and d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z) yourself, then construct x*.

提示 1：对角矩阵如何求逆Hint 1: invert the diagonal matrix

这里 P 的非零对角元素是 9、4，因此 P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4)。把 z 左右代入，得到 zᵀP⁻¹z=3²/9+4²/4。The nonzero diagonal entries are nine and four, giving P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4). Substitute z on both sides to obtain zᵀP⁻¹z=3²/9+4²/4.

提示 2：先修正方向，再归一化Hint 2: adjust the direction, then normalize

先计算 P⁻¹z=(1/3,1)ᵀ，再除以 d。原约束是 9x₁²+4x₂²≤1，不能用欧氏长度代替。First compute P⁻¹z=(1/3,1)ᵀ, then divide by d. The original constraint is 9x₁²+4x₂²≤1; do not replace it with Euclidean length.

展开题 B 的完整核对Open the complete check for B

第 5 节的通用上界说明所有可行目标不超过 √5；这里的向量满足原约束，并取得 √5，因此完成了“上界＋取等”的两部分。The general bound in Section 5 says that every feasible objective is at most √5. This vector satisfies the original constraint and attains √5, completing both parts of the argument.

题 C：P≻0 且 z=0。写出上确界的值，并解释为什么不能直接使用含 d 的取等公式。Exercise C: suppose P≻0 and z=0. State the supremum and explain why the attaining formula with denominator d cannot be used directly.

展开题 C 的核对Open the check for C

上确界是 0，因为每个目标 zᵀx 都等于 0。此时 d=0，分母公式没有定义；x=0 满足约束且取得目标 0。The supremum is zero because every objective zᵀx is zero. Here d=0, so the quotient formula is undefined. The feasible vector x=0 attains the value zero.

做完后合上答案，把题 B 重新写成一份连贯的证明。每次使用不等式或换元，都写一句依据。若某一步只能照抄公式而解释不出原因，回到第 5 节对应步骤再读一次。After finishing, close the answers and rewrite B as a connected proof. Add a reason whenever you use an inequality or substitution. If you can copy a step but cannot explain it, return to the corresponding step in Section 5.

07 · 进一步理解对偶的联系07 · Further connections of duality

Lecture 2 · pp.15–16; Lecture 3 · pp.60–65; Lecture 5 · p.11 / textbook A.1.6, 2.6.1, 3.3.1

学完应能：理解一般 ℓp 的取等构造，并区分范数、锥和函数的三种对偶对象。After studying: understand attainment for ℓp norms and distinguish dual objects for norms, cones and functions.

本节在“深入”层展开。This section opens at In depth depth.

深入In depth

对 1<p<∞，ℓp 长度定义为 (Σ|xᵢ|ᵖ)¹⁄ᵖ。选 q=p/(p−1)，就有 1/p+1/q=1。例如 p=3 对应 q=3/2，p=2 对应 q=2。这两个指数叫共轭指数；说明 ，所以在 ‖x‖p≤1 下，目标不会超过 ‖z‖q。For 1<p<∞, the ℓp length is (Σ|xᵢ|ᵖ)¹⁄ᵖ. Choose q=p/(p−1), so 1/p+1/q=1. For example p=3 pairs with q=3/2, while p=2 pairs with q=2. These are conjugate exponents. The gives , so the objective under ‖x‖p≤1 is bounded by ‖z‖q.

还要让这个上界实际取到。对 z≠0，给第 i 个坐标分配与 |zᵢ|ᑫ⁻¹ 成正比的大小，并用使乘积为正；分母用于把总 ℓp 长度归一化为 1。具体选择是：We still need to attain the bound. For z≠0, allocate a magnitude proportional to |zᵢ|ᑫ⁻¹ to coordinate i and use its sign to make the product positive. The denominator normalizes the total ℓp length to one:

为什么这个幂指数正确？由 q=p/(p−1) 可算出 (q−1)p=q。所以计算每个 |xᵢ*|ᵖ 后，分子变成 |zᵢ|ᑫ；相加后正好与分母相同。检查约束与目标分别得到：Why does the exponent work? The relation q=p/(p−1) implies (q−1)p=q. Raising |xᵢ*| to p therefore produces |zᵢ|ᑫ in the numerator. Summing gives the same value as the denominator. The constraint and objective checks are:

因此 ℓp 的对偶是 ℓq。z=0 时另取 x=0；端点 p=1、p=∞ 使用第 3 节的构造，它们分别对应 q=∞、q=1。含无穷指数时，上面的有限幂表达式不适合直接代入。Thus the dual of ℓp is ℓq. For z=0 choose x=0 separately. The endpoint cases p=1 and p=∞ pair with q=∞ and q=1 and use the constructions from Section 3. The finite-power formula above should not be used by directly substituting an infinite exponent.

深入In depth

把矩阵 Z、X 的对应元素相乘再相加，就得到矩阵内积 。其中 是主对角线元素之和。用这个内积，我们同样可以固定 Z，约束 X 的长度，再问最大的响应是多少。Multiplying corresponding entries of matrices Z and X and summing gives the matrix inner product . The is the sum of diagonal entries. With this inner product, we may again fix Z, constrain the length of X and ask for the largest response.

先分清三个矩阵范数。看矩阵对欧氏向量的最大放大倍数，它等于最大奇异值。把全部奇异值相加。把全部矩阵元素的平方相加，再开平方。对 Z=diag(3,2)，这三个数分别为 3、5、√13，所以它们不能混用。Distinguish three matrix norms. The measures the largest Euclidean amplification of a vector and equals the largest singular value. The adds all singular values. The takes the square root of the sum of squared entries. For Z=diag(3,2), their values are three, five and √13 respectively, so these definitions cannot be interchanged.

课件中的矩阵 ‖X‖₂ 指谱范数。它在迹内积下的对偶是。先看 Z=diag(3,2)：在 ‖X‖₂≤1 下选 X=I，迹内积为 3+2=5，而 X=I 的谱范数恰好是 1。这已经展示了对偶值至少为 5；一般证明还要说明没有更大的值。In the slide, matrix ‖X‖₂ denotes the . Its dual under the trace inner product is the nuclear norm. For Z=diag(3,2), choose X=I under ‖X‖₂≤1. The inner product is 3+2=5, and I has spectral norm one. This exhibits a dual value of at least five; the general proof must also exclude larger values.

单位向量是欧氏长度为 1 的向量；两向量正交表示内积为零。奇异值可以理解为矩阵在一组特别选择的输入方向上的放大倍数：分解会同时选出对应的输出方向。它们是非负数，作用效果为零的方向对应零奇异值。A unit vector has Euclidean length one, and two vectors are orthogonal when their inner product is zero. Singular values can be understood as amplification factors along specially chosen input directions, with the decomposition also supplying the corresponding output directions. They are nonnegative, and directions mapped to zero correspond to zero singular values.

用 写成 Z=Σᵢσᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ，其中 σᵢ 是正奇异值，uᵢ、vᵢ 是两组单位正交向量。薄分解只保留非零奇异值对应的列。对任何谱范数不超过 1 的 X，向量 Xvᵢ 的欧氏长度不超过 1，因此 Cauchy–Schwarz 给 |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1。Use the to write Z=Σᵢσᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ, where σᵢ are positive singular values and uᵢ and vᵢ form two orthonormal collections. A thin decomposition retains the columns for nonzero singular values. If ‖X‖₂≤1, the Euclidean length of Xvᵢ is at most one, and Cauchy–Schwarz gives |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1.

取 X=UVᵀ，U、V 由上述单位向量作为列组成。它把每个 vᵢ 送到对应的 uᵢ，其他正交方向送到零，所以谱范数为 1，且每个 uᵢᵀXvᵢ=1，上界被取到。Z=0 时取 X=0 即可。Frobenius 范数则把矩阵当成元素组成的欧氏向量，因此它的对偶仍是 Frobenius 范数。Choose X=UVᵀ, with the indicated vectors as columns of U and V. It maps each vᵢ to uᵢ and every direction orthogonal to the columns of V to zero, so its spectral norm is one and each uᵢᵀXvᵢ=1. The bound is attained. For Z=0 take X=0. The Frobenius norm treats the entries as a Euclidean vector, so it is self-dual.

深入In depth

一个向量 z 属于对偶单位球，意思是 ‖z‖*≤1。把定义代入，就是原单位球中每个 x 都满足 zᵀx≤1。因此对偶单位球可以写成下面这个集合，称为 B 的 ：A vector z belongs to the dual unit ball when ‖z‖*≤1. Substituting the definition says that every x in the primal unit ball satisfies zᵀx≤1. The dual ball is therefore the following set, called the of B:

把原来的长度限制换成一组内积限制。再对这个新球做相同操作，就是取双重对偶。凸集合要求任意两点之间的整条线段都在集合内。有限维的闭凸集合 B 包含原点时，有 B°°=B。这个几何定理可由分离超平面定理证明：在 B 外的点，总能找到一个内积限制将它排除。由于范数的单位球满足这些条件，双重对偶恢复原球，也恢复原范数。The polar replaces the original length constraint with inner-product constraints. Repeating the same operation gives the bidual. In finite dimensions, a closed convex B containing the origin satisfies B°°=B. Convex means that the segment between any two points stays in the set. This geometric theorem follows from hyperplane separation: a point outside B can be excluded by one of the inner-product constraints. A norm ball meets the assumptions, so biduality recovers its ball and hence its norm.

这段用到了后续凸集课里的分离定理。本章说明结论的来源和条件，不把 B°°=B 当成无需证明的代数恒等式。先前的 ℓ₁ 与 ℓ∞ 配对就是直观例子：菱形的对偶球是正方形，正方形再取对偶又回到菱形。This explanation invokes the separation theorem from the later convex-set material. It states the theorem’s role and assumptions rather than treating B°°=B as an algebraic identity. The ℓ₁/ℓ∞ pairing gives a concrete picture: the diamond’s dual ball is the square, whose dual ball returns to the diamond.

深入In depth

把向量 x 和一个实数 t 配成 (x,t)，要求 ‖x‖≤t，就得到范数锥 K。若原范数是 ℓ₂，这个集合叫 。t 是允许的长度；由于长度非负，可行点自动满足 t≥0。 K* 定义为所有与 K 中每个点内积都非负的 (z,s)，这里内积是 zᵀx+st。Pair x with a real number t and impose ‖x‖≤t to obtain a norm cone K. For the ℓ₂ norm this is the . The value t is the allowed length, and feasibility automatically gives t≥0. The K* consists of all pairs (z,s) having nonnegative inner product zᵀx+st with every point in K.

若 ‖z‖*≤s，通用内积界给 zᵀx≥−‖z‖*‖x‖。再使用 ‖x‖≤t 和 t≥0，就有 zᵀx+st≥−‖z‖*t+st≥0，因此 (z,s) 属于对偶锥。If ‖z‖*≤s, the general bound gives zᵀx≥−‖z‖*‖x‖. Using ‖x‖≤t and t≥0 then gives zᵀx+st≥−‖z‖*t+st≥0, so (z,s) belongs to the dual cone.

反过来，若 s<‖z‖*，就能在原单位球中选一个 u，使 zᵀu>s。取 (x,t)=(−u,1)，它满足 ‖x‖≤t，但内积等于 −zᵀu+s<0。因此这个 (z,s) 不在对偶锥中。两边合起来得到 K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}。Conversely, if s<‖z‖*, choose u in the primal unit ball with zᵀu>s. The pair (x,t)=(−u,1) satisfies ‖x‖≤t but has inner product −zᵀu+s<0. Thus (z,s) does not belong to the dual cone. Together the two directions give K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}.

欧氏范数自对偶，所以它的范数锥与对偶锥使用同一条长度条件，也就是自对偶。这一结论直接连接作业 5(b)。这里的 K* 是一个集合，前面的 ‖z‖* 是一个数，虽然都写星号，但定义的对象不同。Since the Euclidean norm is self-dual, its norm cone and dual cone use the same length condition: the is self-dual. This connects to HW1 5(b). The object K* is a set, whereas ‖z‖* is a number; their stars act on different objects.

深入In depth

第五讲的 定义为 。这里 x 遍历函数定义域。若 f(x)=‖x‖，目标是在内积收益里扣除长度代价。根据这两者谁占优势，上确界会出现两种结果。The in Lecture 5 is defined by , with x ranging over the function’s domain. For f(x)=‖x‖, the objective subtracts a length cost from an inner-product reward. Comparing the two produces two cases.

若 ‖z‖*≤1，内积界给 zᵀx−‖x‖≤(‖z‖*−1)‖x‖≤0。任何 x 都不能获得正收益，而 x=0 给收益 0，所以共轭值为 0。若 ‖z‖*>1，可以选 ‖u‖≤1 且 zᵀu>1；令 x=t u、t→+∞，收益变成 t(zᵀu−‖u‖)，括号严格为正，所以收益无界。If ‖z‖*≤1, the inner-product bound gives zᵀx−‖x‖≤(‖z‖*−1)‖x‖≤0. No x gives a positive reward, and x=0 gives zero, so the conjugate value is zero. If ‖z‖*>1, choose ‖u‖≤1 with zᵀu>1 and set x=t u as t→+∞. The reward becomes t(zᵀu−‖u‖), whose coefficient is positive, so it is unbounded.

在集合内取 0、集合外取 +∞ 的函数，凸分析中称为该集合的示性函数。此处的集合是对偶单位球。到这里可以分清三个记号：‖z‖* 给最大响应的数值，K* 给满足内积条件的集合，f*(z) 给扣除函数代价后的上确界函数。In convex analysis, a function that is zero on a set and +∞ outside it is that set’s indicator function. Here the set is the dual unit ball. We can now distinguish three objects: ‖z‖* is a maximum-response value, K* is a set satisfying inner-product constraints, and f*(z) is a function obtained by subtracting the function cost before taking a supremum.

11 · 内部、边界、闭集与上确界11 · Interior, boundary, closedness and extrema

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.18-20 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.2 · HW1 5(a)

学完应能：用球和收敛序列读定义；区分 supremum 与 maximum。Learning goal: explain interior, boundary, closedness and extrema and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

内点有一个完全位于集合内的小球；包含其所有极限点。上确界不要求取到，最大值要求取到。An has a small ball contained in the set. A closed set contains all its limit points. A supremum need not be attained; a maximum must be.

了解Understand

以区间 C=(0,1] 为例，1/2 是内点：取半径 1/4，附近区间仍在 C 中。1 虽属于 C，却不是内点，因为任意半径都会包含比 1 大的点。0 不属于 C，但可以由 1/k 这些集合内点逼近，所以 0 是闭包中的点。边界为 {0,1}；闭包为 [0,1]；内部为 (0,1)。For C=(0,1], one half is interior: radius one quarter stays inside. One belongs to C but is not interior, since every neighborhood includes numbers above one. Zero lies outside C yet is approached by 1/k, so it is in the closure. The boundary is {0,1}, closure [0,1], and interior (0,1).

为什么这些术语和优化有关？有限维里闭且有界的集合是紧集，连续函数在非空紧集上取得最大值和最小值。对偶范数的单位球具有这些条件，因而 sup 可以写成 max。开放区间则可能缺失最优点，例如在 (0,1) 上最大化 x，上确界为 1，但没有最大值。Why do these terms matter? A closed bounded set in finite dimensions is compact; a continuous function on a nonempty compact set attains both extrema. Norm unit balls have these properties, explaining max in the dual-norm definition. On the open interval (0,1), x has supremum one but no maximum.

二维中一条直线在整个平面没有内点，因为任何小圆盘都会伸出直线；在直线自身作为环境时却有相对内点。使用集合的仿射包作为环境，后面谈约束与分离时能避免把低维可行集误当成没有“内部空间”。A line has empty interior in the plane because every disk extends off it, but has within itself. Relative interior uses the affine hull as the ambient space and prevents low-dimensional feasible sets from being misread as having no usable interior.

掌握Mastery

证明闭球闭：若 xₖ 满足 ‖xₖ−a‖≤r 且 xₖ→x，三角不等式给 |‖xₖ−a‖−‖x−a‖|≤‖xₖ−x‖→0，故极限仍有 ‖x−a‖≤r。这里先证明长度的连续性，再把约束传到极限。To show the closed ball is closed, use |‖xₖ−a‖−‖x−a‖|≤‖xₖ−x‖→0. If each length is at most r, the limiting length is too. This proves norm continuity before passing the constraint to the limit.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

C={x∈R²:x₂=0} 的内部、相对内部分别是什么？Find the interior and relative interior of C={x∈R²:x₂=0}.

展开核对Check the answer

平面中的内部为空；以这条直线为仿射环境时，相对内部等于 C。The interior in the plane is empty, while the relative interior is C.

深入In depth

闭集上连续函数也可能无界，例如 f(x)=x 在 R 上。闭且有界针对可行集，连续针对目标，两类条件各有用途。A continuous function on a closed set may be unbounded, as x on R shows. Closedness and boundedness concern the feasible set; continuity concerns the objective.

核对原课件 · 18-20Check original slides · 18-20

12 · 定义域与连续性12 · Domains and continuity

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.22-23 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.3 · HW1 2,4,5(a)

学完应能：识别向量值映射与函数定义域；处理复合函数的定义域。Learning goal: explain domains and continuity and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

定义域记录函数可求值的位置；连续表示输入足够接近时输出也足够接近。The domain records where a function is defined. Continuity means sufficiently close inputs give sufficiently close outputs.

了解Understand

f(x)=−log x 的实数定义域是 x>0。写导数或判断凸性之前必须交代这个范围；负数没有这里的实对数，x=0 也不在定义域。f(x)=1/x 的定义域可为 R\{0}，但讨论凸性时通常单独限制到 (0,∞)。定义域本身也是函数信息的一部分。The real domain of −log x is x>0. State this before differentiating or checking convexity: negative inputs have no real logarithm here and zero is excluded. The reciprocal may be defined on R\{0}, but convexity is usually considered on (0,∞). The domain is part of the function specification.

连续性是局部性质。例如在 x=2 附近，1/x 的值平稳变化；靠近定义域的缺口 0 时它可以无限增大，仍不妨碍它在每一个非零点连续。序列判据只检验趋于定义域内给定点的输入，不能直接要求函数在定义域外也有有限值。Continuity is local. The reciprocal changes smoothly near two and may diverge near the excluded point zero, yet remains continuous at each nonzero point. The sequential test concerns convergence to a specified domain point, not finite behavior at excluded locations.

掌握Mastery

范数连续性由反向三角不等式 |‖x‖−‖y‖|≤‖x−y‖ 得到。它由 ‖x‖≤‖x−y‖+‖y‖ 及交换 x、y 后的式子合并而成。于是输入长度差趋于零时输出差也趋于零，后面可以用这一步证明球和范数锥闭。Norm continuity follows from the reverse triangle inequality |‖x‖−‖y‖|≤‖x−y‖, obtained by applying the triangle inequality in both directions. This bounds output change by input distance and will prove closedness of balls and norm cones.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

在 x>0 上连续的 1/x，一定取得最小值吗？Does the continuous reciprocal on x>0 attain its minimum?

展开核对Check the answer

它的下确界为 0，x→∞ 时逼近，但任意有限正 x 都有 1/x>0，因此不取得。Its infimum is zero approached as x→∞, but every finite positive x gives 1/x>0, so it is not attained.

深入In depth

扩展值函数会用 +∞ 标记禁止输入，方便把约束吸收进目标。此时不能把普通实函数连续性的说法机械套到 +∞ 上；第 31 节说明扩展值凸性。Extended-value functions mark forbidden inputs with +∞, allowing constraints to enter the objective. Ordinary real-valued continuity should not be applied mechanically at infinity; Section 31 explains extended-value convexity.
