13 · 导数、梯度与向量链式法则13 · Derivatives, gradients and the chain rule

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.25-37 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.4.1–A.4.2 · HW1 2(a)

学完应能：从线性近似理解导数；推导复合仿射函数和 Log-Sum-Exp 梯度。Learning goal: explain derivatives, gradients and the chain rule and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

梯度收集所有一阶偏导，方向 h 上的一阶变化为 ∇f(x)ᵀh。向量函数的导数用 矩阵表示。The gradient collects first partial derivatives; first-order change in direction h is ∇f(x)ᵀh. Vector derivatives use a Jacobian.

了解Understand

对标量函数 f:Rⁿ→R，梯度是 n 维列向量，其第 i 项为对 xᵢ 的偏导。f(x₁,x₂)=x₁²+3x₂² 在 (1,2) 处梯度为 (2,12)。向第一方向走 0.01，一阶预测变化约为 0.02；向第二方向走 0.01，约为 0.12。梯度既有方向，也有变化率大小。For f:Rⁿ→R, the gradient is an n-dimensional column with partial derivatives as entries. For x₁²+3x₂² at (1,2), it is (2,12). Moving 0.01 in the first coordinate predicts change 0.02; the same movement in the second predicts 0.12. The gradient records both direction and change rate.

若 g:Rⁿ→Rᵐ，Jacobian 的第 (i,j) 项为 ∂gᵢ/∂xⱼ，所以 Jg 是 m×n。复合 f(g(x)) 的梯度为 Jg(x)ᵀ∇f(g(x))，结果维数为 n。维数检查能帮助发现遗漏转置的错误；线性内层 g(x)=Ax+b 时 Jg=A。For g:Rⁿ→Rᵐ, its Jacobian entry (i,j) is ∂gᵢ/∂xⱼ, making Jg an m×n matrix. The composite gradient Jg(x)ᵀ∇f(g(x)) has dimension n. Checking dimensions exposes missing transposes; an affine inner map has Jg=A.

作业 2 的 ：令 sᵢ=aᵢᵀx+bᵢ，S=Σᵢexp(sᵢ)，pᵢ=exp(sᵢ)/S。这里 aᵢ∈Rⁿ，bᵢ 为常数，pᵢ>0 且和为 1。链式法则给梯度 Σᵢpᵢaᵢ，可理解为由当前指数权重决定的平均系数。若一项远大于其余项，它的 aᵢ 就主导局部变化。For HW1 2, set sᵢ=aᵢᵀx+bᵢ, S=Σᵢexp(sᵢ) and pᵢ=exp(sᵢ)/S. Vectors aᵢ lie in Rⁿ, bᵢ are constants, and positive pᵢ sum to one. The chain rule gives gradient Σᵢpᵢaᵢ, a coefficient average under current exponential weights. A dominant term makes its coefficient dominate local change.

一阶公式中的 o(‖h‖) 记号表示剩余误差除以 ‖h‖ 后，在 h→0 时趋于 0，所以步长越小，线性项越准确。例如 f(x)=x² 在 x=1 时，真实变化为 2h+h²，梯度给 2h，剩余 h²/|h|=|h|→0。可微要求这种近似对所有方向同时成立，只有各偏导存在还不足够。The notation o(‖h‖) means the remainder divided by ‖h‖ tends to zero as h→0, so smaller steps improve linear accuracy. For x² at x=1, the exact change is 2h+h², the derivative predicts 2h, and the remainder ratio is |h|→0. Differentiability requires the approximation uniformly across directions; existence of partial derivatives alone does not suffice.

掌握Mastery

逐项求导：∇S=Σᵢexp(sᵢ)aᵢ，∇log S=(1/S)∇S=Σᵢpᵢaᵢ。S 始终为正，所以除法合法。数值计算中取 c=maxᵢsᵢ，写 log S=c+log Σᵢexp(sᵢ−c)，避免很大指数溢出；这个改写只是提取公因子，不改变数学函数。Differentiate term by term: ∇S=Σᵢexp(sᵢ)aᵢ and ∇log S=∇S/S=Σᵢpᵢaᵢ. S is positive, so division is valid. Numerically use c=maxᵢsᵢ and log S=c+log Σᵢexp(sᵢ−c), factoring out exp(c) to avoid overflow without changing the function.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=log(exp(x)+exp(−x)) 在 x=0 的导数是多少？What is the derivative of log(exp(x)+exp(−x)) at zero?

展开核对Check the answer

两个权重各 1/2，系数为 1、−1，导数为 0。Weights are one half each and coefficients are 1 and −1, giving derivative zero.

深入In depth

对偶范数解释最陡方向：在 ‖h‖≤1 的预算下，最大一阶增长为 ‖∇f(x)‖*。欧氏预算下取梯度单位方向；其他范数下最陡方向可能具有完全不同的坐标结构。Dual norms explain steepest change: under ‖h‖≤1, the greatest first-order increase is ‖∇f(x)‖*. Euclidean budgets select the normalized gradient, while other norms can select different coordinate patterns.

14 · Hessian 与二阶链式法则14 · Hessians and the covariance of log-sum-exp

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.38-44 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.4.3–A.4.4 · HW1 2(b),2(c),4(a),4(b)

学完应能：展开 ；把 Log-Sum-Exp 写为加权协方差并识别零方向。Learning goal: explain hessians and the covariance of and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Hessian 收集二阶偏导，刻画局部曲率。log-sum-exp 的 Hessian 是加权协方差矩阵，必为半正定。The Hessian collects second derivatives and describes local curvature. Log-sum-exp has a weighted covariance Hessian, which is PSD.

了解Understand

梯度告诉我们一阶坡度，Hessian 告诉坡度怎样变化。对 f=x₁²+3x₂²，Hessian 为 diag(2,6)。沿 h 的二阶曲率是 hᵀHh；例如 h=(1,0) 得 2，h=(0,1) 得 6，说明第二方向弯得更强。二阶 Taylor 近似为 f(x+h)≈f(x)+∇f(x)ᵀh+½hᵀHh。The gradient gives first-order slope; the Hessian tells how slope changes. For x₁²+3x₂² it is diag(2,6). Curvature along h is hᵀHh: the coordinate directions give two and six, showing stronger bending in the second direction. Taylor’s quadratic approximation adds ½hᵀHh to the linear model.

作业中的 pᵢ 可以看成概率，aᵢ 是可能取到的向量值。减去加权均值 ā 后，Hessian 表示这些向量的离散程度。任意 v 的二次型是 Σᵢpᵢ(aᵢᵀv−āᵀv)²，所有项非负，所以 H⪰0。这既给出凸性，也说明零曲率来自哪个方向。View pᵢ as probabilities and aᵢ as possible vector values. Subtracting the weighted mean ā gives the spread, or covariance. For any v, the quadratic form is Σᵢpᵢ(aᵢᵀv−āᵀv)², a nonnegative sum. This proves H⪰0 and identifies directions with zero curvature.

所有 pᵢ 都严格为正，所以这个和为零恰好要求全部 aᵢᵀv 相同，等价于 (aᵢ−a₁)ᵀv=0 对每个 i 成立。例子 log(eˣ+e⁻ˣ) 在 0 处均值为 0，Hessian 为 1；若所有 aᵢ 都相同，函数只是一个仿射函数加常数，Hessian 处处为零。Every pᵢ is strictly positive, so the sum vanishes exactly when all aᵢᵀv agree, equivalently (aᵢ−a₁)ᵀv=0 for every i. For log(eˣ+e⁻ˣ), the mean at zero is zero and the Hessian is one. If all aᵢ coincide, the function is affine plus a constant and the Hessian vanishes everywhere.

掌握Mastery

由商法则 ∇pᵢ=pᵢ(aᵢ−ā)，对梯度 Σᵢpᵢaᵢ 再求导得 H=Σᵢpᵢaᵢ(aᵢ−ā)ᵀ=Σᵢpᵢaᵢaᵢᵀ−āāᵀ。把协方差表达展开，也得到相同式子，因为 Σpᵢ=1、Σpᵢaᵢ=ā。这完成作业 2(a)–(c) 的推导与零方向判定。The quotient rule gives ∇pᵢ=pᵢ(aᵢ−ā). Differentiating Σᵢpᵢaᵢ yields H=Σᵢpᵢaᵢaᵢᵀ−āāᵀ. Expanding the covariance form gives the same expression using Σpᵢ=1 and Σpᵢaᵢ=ā. This completes HW1 2(a)–(c), including the null directions.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

若 a₁=(1,0)、a₂=(0,1)，找所有 Hessian 的零方向。With a₁=(1,0) and a₂=(0,1), find every Hessian null direction.

展开核对Check the answer

条件为 v₁=v₂，所以零方向为 (t,t)。同时增加两个输入会给 log-sum-exp 增加一个线性量，不产生曲率。The condition is v₁=v₂, giving (t,t). Increasing both inputs together adds a linear amount to log-sum-exp, so no curvature arises.

深入In depth

一般复合 f(g(x)) 的 Hessian 有两部分：JgᵀHfJg+Σᵢ(∂f/∂yᵢ)Hgᵢ。只有内层仿射时第二部分为零，不能把仿射链式公式套给非线性内层。A general composite has Hessian JgᵀHfJg+Σᵢ(∂f/∂yᵢ)Hgᵢ. The second term vanishes for an affine inner map, but must be retained for nonlinear g.

15 · 值域与零空间15 · Range, nullspace and rank

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.46-47 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.1 · HW1 2(c)补充

学完应能：从 Ax 的像和 Ax=0 的解读两个子空间；连接最小二乘。Learning goal: explain range, and rank and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

列出 Ax 能到达的位置；零空间列出被 A 消去的输入。秩加零空间维数等于输入维数。The range contains outputs Ax; the nullspace contains inputs erased by A. Rank plus nullity equals the input dimension.

了解Understand

A=[[1,1],[0,0]] 把 (x₁,x₂) 变成 (x₁+x₂,0)。因此值域是水平轴，是 x₁+x₂=0 的直线。输入沿 (1,−1) 改变，输出不变。这个例子说明矩阵可能压掉一部分信息，也解释为什么最小二乘参数会不唯一。A=[[1,1],[0,0]] maps (x₁,x₂) to (x₁+x₂,0). Its range is the horizontal axis and its nullspace is the line x₁+x₂=0. Moving an input along (1,−1) changes no output. A matrix can erase information, explaining nonunique least-squares parameters.

Ax=b 可解恰好要求 b 在值域中。若一个解为 x₀，全部解是 x₀+N(A)：因为任意两个解的差被 A 消去，反过来给解加上零空间向量仍是解。满列秩意味着没有非零零空间方向，故可解时参数唯一；满行秩意味着每个输出 b 都可达到。Ax=b is solvable exactly when b lies in the range. If x₀ is one solution, all solutions are x₀+N(A): differences of solutions are erased, and adding an erased vector preserves the output. Full column rank ensures uniqueness when solvable; full row rank makes every output reachable.

掌握Mastery

N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥：若 Ax=0，x 与每一行的内积为零，所以与 Aᵀ 的列空间正交；反过来，与所有行正交就使 Ax 的每个分量为零。相同论证得到 R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥。的残差条件正好使用第二个关系。N(A)=R(Aᵀ)⊥ because Ax=0 means x is orthogonal to every row, and conversely. The parallel argument gives R(A)=N(Aᵀ)⊥, the relationship used by the least-squares residual condition.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

上述 A 对 b=(2,0) 的全部解是什么？b=(2,1) 呢？Find every solution for b=(2,0), and determine whether b=(2,1) is attainable.

展开核对Check the answer

第一种为 (t,2−t)；第二种没有解，因为输出第二分量恒为零。The first gives (t,2−t). The second has no solution since the second output is always zero.

深入In depth

数值秩需要结合容差判断：很小的奇异值在精确数学里可能非零，却会让逆问题极度敏感。第 17 节用看出这些方向。Numerical rank depends on tolerance: tiny singular values may be nonzero exactly but make inversion highly sensitive. SVD in Section 17 identifies these directions.

核对原课件 · 46-47Check original slides · 46-47

16 · 特征分解与正定、半正定16 · Eigenvalues and positive definiteness

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.48-52,55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.2 · HW1 1(a),2(c),4(b)

学完应能：使用二次型判定；说明及可逆性；避免混淆逐元素非负。Learning goal: explain eigenvalues and positive definiteness and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

实对称矩阵可正交对角化；二次型半正定恰好对应全部特征值非负。Real symmetric matrices admit orthogonal diagonalization. A quadratic form is PSD exactly when all eigenvalues are nonnegative.

了解Understand

特征方程 Pv=λv 说某个方向经过变换后仍沿原方向，只被缩放 λ 倍。对称矩阵可以选择一组互相正交的单位特征向量，把复杂坐标转到这些方向。在新坐标里 P 是对角矩阵，二次型就是带权平方和。The eigenvalue equation Pv=λv says a direction retains its orientation under the map, scaled by λ. A symmetric matrix has an orthonormal eigenbasis. Changing to these coordinates diagonalizes P, turning its quadratic form into a weighted sum of squares.

例如 P=[[2,1],[1,2]] 的特征方向为 (1,1)、(1,−1)，特征值为 3、1。沿第一方向二次型增长更快，椭球半径更小。两值都正，所以 P≻0。若把其中一个值换成 0，就会出现非零向量二次型为零；换成负数就会出现负二次型。For P=[[2,1],[1,2]], directions (1,1) and (1,−1) have eigenvalues three and one. The first direction has larger quadratic cost and a shorter ellipsoid radius. Both values are positive, so P≻0. Replacing one by zero permits a nonzero zero-cost vector; a negative value permits negative quadratic cost.

记 P⪰0 为半正定，P≻0 为正定，这些记号专门比较对称矩阵的二次型。P⪰Q 表示 P−Q 半正定，通常不能逐元素读成 Pᵢⱼ≥Qᵢⱼ。平方根 P½=Qdiag(√λᵢ)Qᵀ，在正定时也可逆。The symbols P⪰0 and P≻0 compare symmetric quadratic forms. P⪰Q means P−Q is PSD, generally not an entrywise inequality. The square root P½=Qdiag(√λᵢ)Qᵀ is invertible when P is positive definite.

掌握Mastery

如果全部 λᵢ≥0，带权平方和非负，故半正定。反过来取 x 为第 i 个单位特征向量，二次型就是 λᵢ，所以半正定要求每个 λᵢ≥0。严格版本同理。进一步，λmin‖x‖²≤xᵀPx≤λmax‖x‖²，由坐标平方和不变得出。Nonnegative eigenvalues make the weighted sum nonnegative. Conversely, the quadratic form at a unit eigenvector equals its eigenvalue, so PSD requires every λᵢ≥0. The strict version is analogous. Bounding every weight gives λmin‖x‖²≤xᵀPx≤λmax‖x‖².

先独立试一遍Try independently first

diag(0,2) 是否正定？它的平方根是什么？Is diag(0,2) positive definite, and what is its PSD square root?

展开核对Check the answer

它半正定但非正定，平方根是 diag(0,√2)。It is PSD but not positive definite; its PSD square root is diag(0,√2).

深入In depth

正定矩阵的行列式为正，但仅凭行列式为正不能推出正定，例如 diag(−1,−1)。需要特征值、二次型或完整的主子式条件。Positive definiteness implies a positive determinant, but the converse fails: diag(−1,−1) has positive determinant. Use eigenvalues, the quadratic form or appropriate complete minor conditions.

核对原课件 · 48-52,55Check original slides · 48-52,55

17 · 奇异值分解与伪逆17 · Singular values and the pseudoinverse

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.53-54,56 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：理解奇异值、谱范数与解；联系矩阵核范数。Learning goal: explain singular values and the and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

SVD 把线性映射分成旋转、沿正交方向缩放和旋转；伪逆只反转非零奇异值。SVD decomposes a map into orthogonal changes of coordinates and directional scaling. The pseudoinverse inverts only nonzero singular values.

了解Understand

一般矩阵可能非对称甚至不是方阵，特征分解不能统一处理。SVD 的 U、V 提供输出与输入的正交方向，Σ 的对角非负数为奇异值。先把输入转到 V 坐标，沿各轴缩放，再用 U 转回输出坐标，就得到 Ax。最大奇异值因此给欧氏长度最大放大率。A general matrix may be nonsymmetric or rectangular, so eigenvalue decomposition is not universal. SVD uses U and V for orthogonal output and input directions, with nonnegative singular values in Σ. Rotate input coordinates using V, scale, then rotate using U. The largest singular value is therefore the greatest Euclidean amplification.

对 A=diag(2,0)，只有第一坐标能被传递。伪逆为 diag(1/2,0)，不会把零奇异值变成无穷。若 b=(4,3)，最小二乘解要求 x₁=2，x₂ 任意；伪逆选 x=(2,0)，它在全部最小二乘解中欧氏长度最小。剩余残差 (0,−3) 是无法到达的输出部分。For A=diag(2,0), only the first coordinate is transmitted. Its pseudoinverse is diag(1/2,0), never infinity at a zero singular value. With b=(4,3), all least-squares solutions have x₁=2 and arbitrary x₂. The pseudoinverse chooses (2,0), the shortest among them. Residual (0,−3) is the unreachable output component.

掌握Mastery

在 SVD 坐标令 y=Vᵀx、c=Uᵀb。正交变换保持欧氏长度，目标变为 Σᵢ(σᵢyᵢ−cᵢ)² 加无法拟合的常数项。σᵢ>0 时取 yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ；零奇异值方向目标不依赖 yᵢ，最小长度选择 yᵢ=0。这就导出 A†b。Set y=Vᵀx and c=Uᵀb. Orthogonal transformations preserve Euclidean length, so least squares becomes Σᵢ(σᵢyᵢ−cᵢ)² plus unreachable constant terms. For positive σᵢ, take yᵢ=cᵢ/σᵢ. In zero directions the objective ignores yᵢ, and minimum length chooses zero, yielding A†b.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

A=diag(3,1,0)，求 A† 和谱范数。For A=diag(3,1,0), find A† and the spectral norm.

展开核对Check the answer

A†=diag(1/3,1,0)，谱范数为 3。The pseudoinverse is diag(1/3,1,0), and the spectral norm is three.

深入In depth

很小的 σᵢ 会把数据误差放大为误差/σᵢ。截断 SVD 或正则化能抑制这种放大，但会引入拟合偏差。这个权衡解释了为什么参数估计有时宁愿不做精确求逆。Tiny σᵢ amplify data error by 1/σᵢ. Truncated SVD or regularization limits amplification at the price of bias. This tradeoff explains why exact inversion may be undesirable in estimation.

核对原课件 · 53-54,56Check original slides · 53-54,56

18 · Schur 补与块矩阵18 · The Schur complement

Lecture 2 · PDF pp.57 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §A.5.5；C.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：通过配方或块消元读半正定条件；说明可逆块的前提。Learning goal: explain the schur complement and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

分块对称矩阵中可逆正定块可被消元；剩余二次型称 。A positive definite block in a symmetric block matrix can be eliminated; the remaining quadratic form is the .

了解Understand

A 是 k×k 对称正定块，C 是 l×l 对称块，B 是 k×l。把向量写成 (u,v)，二次型包含 uᵀAu+2uᵀBv+vᵀCv。由于 A 可逆，可以配方，把 u 与 v 的耦合吸收到一个平方中，剩余部分就是 C−BᵀA⁻¹B。Let A be k×k symmetric positive definite, C l×l symmetric and B k×l. For (u,v), the quadratic form is uᵀAu+2uᵀBv+vᵀCv. Invertibility of A permits completing the square, absorbing the coupling and leaving C−BᵀA⁻¹B.

最小例子 M=[[2,1],[1,c]]，A=2，Schur 补为 c−1/2。于是 M 半正定恰好要求 c≥1/2。取 c=1/2 时矩阵有零方向；取 c>1/2 时正定。这个工具把看似复杂的矩阵条件转换为较小维数的条件。For M=[[2,1],[1,c]], the Schur complement is c−1/2. Thus M is PSD exactly when c≥1/2, with a null direction at equality and positive definiteness for c>1/2. The tool reduces a matrix condition to a smaller one.

后面把 xᵀY⁻¹x≤t 改成 [[Y,x],[xᵀ,t]]⪰0，就使用这一等价式。它的重要性在于：矩阵逆出现在原表达式中，但分块矩阵的每个元素对变量都是仿射的，可以直接构造凸约束。Y≻0 的定义域仍需保留。Later, xᵀY⁻¹x≤t becomes [[Y,x],[xᵀ,t]]⪰0. The original expression contains an inverse, but every block entry in the new constraint is affine in the variables, giving a convex formulation. The domain condition Y≻0 remains essential.

掌握Mastery

精确配方为 (u+A⁻¹Bv)ᵀA(u+A⁻¹Bv)+vᵀ(C−BᵀA⁻¹B)v。若 Schur 补半正定，两项都非负。反过来若 M 半正定，令 u=−A⁻¹Bv 消去第一项，则所有 v 的剩余二次型必须非负。严格版本用非零向量检查，得到 M≻0 当且仅当补矩阵正定。Complete the square as (u+A⁻¹Bv)ᵀA(u+A⁻¹Bv)+vᵀ(C−BᵀA⁻¹B)v. A PSD complement makes both terms nonnegative. Conversely, choose u=−A⁻¹Bv so PSD of M forces the complement quadratic form nonnegative for every v. The strict version similarly characterizes positive definiteness.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

[[4,2],[2,t]] 半正定的最小 t 是多少？What is the smallest t making [[4,2],[2,t]] PSD?

展开核对Check the answer

Schur 补为 t−2²/4=t−1，所以最小 t=1。The complement is t−2²/4=t−1, so the smallest t is one.

深入In depth

若 A 仅半正定，A⁻¹ 不存在，需用伪逆并补充值域条件 (I−AA†)B=0，才能使用 C−BᵀA†B⪰0。直接把逆换成伪逆而不检查值域会得错误结论。For singular PSD A, use A† together with the range condition (I−AA†)B=0 and C−BᵀA†B⪰0. Merely replacing the inverse by a pseudoinverse without the range condition is invalid.

LECTURE 03

凸集与锥Convex sets and cones

19 · 仿射集与仿射包19 · Affine sets and affine combinations

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.4-8 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.1.1–2.1.3 · HW1 3(a)

学完应能：区别线性组合与仿射组合；证明线性方程解集仿射。Learning goal: explain s and affine combinations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

包含任意两点所在的整条直线；仿射组合的系数和为 1，但允许负系数。An affine set contains the entire line through any two of its points. Affine coefficients sum to one but may be negative.

了解Understand

两点之间的线段用 0≤θ≤1 表示，整条直线则允许 θ 为任意实数。取 x=(0,1)、y=(2,1)，θ=1/2 给中点 (1,1)，θ=2 给 (−2,1)。这些点都在水平线 x₂=1 上，所以这条线是仿射集。仿射性关心能否沿直线双向延伸，不限制在两点之间。A segment uses 0≤θ≤1; a whole line allows any real θ. With x=(0,1) and y=(2,1), θ=1/2 gives (1,1), while θ=2 gives (−2,1). Every such point lies on x₂=1, an affine set. Affineness permits extension in both directions beyond the endpoints.

线性子空间一定含原点；仿射集可以是子空间的平移。直线 x₂=1 不含原点，却等于 (0,1) 加上水平轴。一个非空仿射集可写成 x₀+V，其中 x₀ 为其中任一点，V 是所有允许的方向构成的子空间。仿射包 aff S 是包含 S 的最小仿射集。A linear subspace contains zero, whereas an affine set may be a translated subspace. The line x₂=1 is (0,1) plus the horizontal axis. Every nonempty affine set can be written x₀+V, with x₀ a point and V its direction subspace. The affine hull aff S is the smallest affine set containing S.

等式约束 Ax=b 自然给仿射集：混合两个解时，等式右侧也按系数混合，因为系数和为 1，结果仍为 b。这解释了凸优化标准形式为何特别使用仿射等式；一般非线性等式可能留下弯曲曲面，直线段会离开它。The equations Ax=b define an affine set: an affine combination of solutions still has right-hand side b because its coefficients sum to one. This explains affine equalities in convex standard form. Nonlinear equalities may produce curved surfaces whose connecting segments leave the surface.

掌握Mastery

作业 3(a)：若 Ax=b、Ay=b，则 A(θx+(1−θ)y)=θb+(1−θ)b=b，对全部实 θ 成立。因此解集仿射，取 θ∈[0,1] 又得到凸性。若方程无解，解集为空；按通常定义，空集的凸性也成立，因为没有违反定义的点对。For HW1 3(a), A(θx+(1−θ)y)=θb+(1−θ)b=b for every real θ. The solution set is affine and hence convex by restricting θ to [0,1]. If unsolvable, the set is empty and convexity holds vacuously.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

过 (1,0)、(0,1) 的仿射包是什么？原点在其中吗？Find the affine hull of (1,0) and (0,1). Does it contain zero?

展开核对Check the answer

它是 x₁+x₂=1，原点不满足等式，因此不在其中。It is x₁+x₂=1, which excludes zero.

深入In depth

仿射维数是方向子空间 V 的维数。一个二维平面中的线段，仿射包是一条一维直线；内部为空，但相对内部是去掉端点的线段。Affine dimension is dim V. A segment in a plane has a one-dimensional affine hull, empty ordinary interior and relative interior excluding its endpoints.

核对原课件 · 4-8Check original slides · 4-8

20 · 凸集、凸包、锥与锥包20 · Convex sets, hulls and cones

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.9-12 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.1.4–2.1.5 · HW1 3,5(a)

学完应能：按系数条件区分四种组合；直接从定义证明凸性。Learning goal: explain s, hulls and cones and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸集包含两点间的线段；包含全部有限凸组合；凸锥对非负线性组合封闭。A convex set contains every joining segment. Its consists of finite convex combinations. A convex cone is closed under nonnegative linear combinations.

了解Understand

把两种可行方案按比例混合仍可行，正是凸性的含义。二维三点的凸包是填满的三角形；仅画三条边会遗漏内部的凸组合。对点 (0,0)、(2,0)、(0,2)，权重 (1/2,1/4,1/4) 给点 (1/2,1/2)，说明三点组合可以直接到达内部。Convexity means proportional mixing preserves feasibility. The convex hull of three noncollinear planar points is the filled triangle, not only its edges. Weights (1/2,1/4,1/4) on (0,0), (2,0), (0,2) give (1/2,1/2), demonstrating an interior combination.

锥先要求非负缩放：x 可行则 tx 可行，t≥0。凸锥再要求加法封闭，因此任意非负组合都留在锥内。非负正交象限是凸锥；整条水平轴也是凸锥，却包含双向直线。之后“”的尖性条件会排除这样的直线。A cone allows nonnegative scaling: x∈C implies tx∈C for t≥0. A convex cone also permits addition, hence every nonnegative combination. The nonnegative orthant is a convex cone, and a full horizontal line is another, but the latter contains a two-sided direction. Pointedness later excludes such lines.

凸组合的权重和为 1，锥组合则没有这个限制。例如两个产量向量的凸组合表示保持规模的混合，锥组合允许总规模改变。仿射、凸、锥三种组合有不同系数限制，解题前先把限制写清楚。Convex coefficients sum to one; conic coefficients need not. A convex combination of production vectors mixes at fixed total scale, while a conic combination may change scale. Affine, convex and conic combinations impose different coefficient restrictions; state them before manipulating a set.

课件还提到无限和与积分形式的混合。它们需要收敛或可积性，不能把无限多个点直接当作有限代数式。若 C 闭凸，且有限凸组合序列收敛，极限仍在 C 中；这条“先用有限凸性、再用闭性传极限”的路线足以处理常见连续混合。The slides also discuss infinite sums and integral mixtures. Convergence or integrability must be checked rather than treating infinite expressions as finite algebra. For a closed convex C, convergent sequences of finite convex combinations remain in C in the limit. Finite convexity followed by closedness is a useful rigorous route.

掌握Mastery

有限凸组合可由两点定义归纳得到。把最后一项权重记 t；若 t=1，只剩该点；若 t<1，把其余项除以 1−t 得到一个凸组合，归纳假设保证它在集合内，再与最后一点按比例 1−t、t 混合。零权重可先删除，避免除零。Derive finite combinations by induction. Let the last weight be t. If t=1, only that point remains. Otherwise normalize the earlier weights by 1−t, apply the induction hypothesis, then mix with the final point. Zero weights may be removed to prevent division by zero.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

集合 {(0,0),(2,0)} 的凸包、仿射包、锥包分别是什么？Find the convex, affine and conic hulls of {(0,0),(2,0)}.

展开核对Check the answer

分别是水平线段 [0,2]×{0}、整条水平轴和非负水平射线。They are the segment [0,2]×{0}, the horizontal axis, and its nonnegative ray.

深入In depth

凸包给集合的凸松弛：原点集包含在凸包中，线性目标的下确界在两者上相同，但非线性目标可能在新增内部点得到更低值。A convex hull gives a convex relaxation. Linear objectives have the same infimum on the original set and its convex hull, but nonlinear objectives may improve at newly included interior points.

21 · 超平面、半空间、球与椭球21 · Hyperplanes, halfspaces, balls and ellipsoids

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.13-20 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.2.1–2.2.3 · HW1 3(b),3(c),5(a)

学完应能：用三角不等式证明球凸；展开距离平方得到。Learning goal: explain hyperplanes, s, balls and ellipsoids and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

超平面 aᵀx=b 的法向为 a≠0；半空间取其一侧。范数球和正定椭球都是凸集。A hyperplane aᵀx=b has nonzero normal a; a halfspace selects one side. Norm balls and positive definite ellipsoids are convex.

了解Understand

直线 2x₁+x₂=4 的法向为 (2,1)，沿法向移动会最快改变左侧的值。半空间 2x₁+x₂≤4 包含原点，边界属于集合。图中用阴影标出可行一侧；判断阴影方向时，代入一个测试点比凭直觉猜测更稳妥。The line 2x₁+x₂=4 has normal (2,1), the direction changing its left side fastest. The halfspace 2x₁+x₂≤4 contains zero and its boundary. The shaded side is feasible; plugging in a test point is a reliable way to determine which side to shade.

半径 r≥0、中心 c 的范数球记录离 c 不超过 r 的点。对两个球内点 x、y，混合点与 c 的差为 θ(x−c)+(1−θ)(y−c)，三角不等式把它的长度控制在 r 内。椭球是欧氏球的仿射像；A 可逆时各方向都有非零轴长，不可逆时会压成低维椭球。A norm ball of radius r≥0 about c contains points at distance at most r. The difference of a mixture from c is θ(x−c)+(1−θ)(y−c); the triangle inequality bounds its length by r. An ellipsoid is an affine image of a Euclidean ball, possibly lower dimensional when A is singular.

作业 3(c) 的“离 a 不比离 b 远”看似弯曲距离条件。平方两边后，xᵀx 消去，得到半空间 2(b−a)ᵀx≤‖b‖²−‖a‖²。例如 a=(0,0)、b=(2,0)，条件变成 x₁≤1，其边界就是垂直平分线。这也解释了 Voronoi 区域为什么由半空间组成。In HW1 3(c), being no farther from a than b appears to be a nonlinear distance constraint. Squaring cancels xᵀx and gives 2(b−a)ᵀx≤‖b‖²−‖a‖². With a=(0,0), b=(2,0), this is x₁≤1, bounded by the perpendicular bisector. The same mechanism gives halfspace descriptions of Voronoi cells.

掌握Mastery

作业 3(b)：‖θx+(1−θ)y−c‖≤θ‖x−c‖+(1−θ)‖y−c‖≤r，使用绝对齐次性与 θ∈[0,1]。r=0 时集合为单点，仍凸。3(c) 的平方操作合法，因为两侧距离非负；展开并消去相同项后得到上面的线性约束。a=b 时它变成 0≤0，集合是整个空间。For 3(b), homogeneity and the triangle inequality give ‖θx+(1−θ)y−c‖≤θ‖x−c‖+(1−θ)‖y−c‖≤r. At r=0 the singleton remains convex. For 3(c), squaring preserves the inequality because distances are nonnegative; expansion cancels matching terms. If a=b, it becomes 0≤0 and the whole space is feasible.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

离 a=(−1,0) 不比离 b=(1,0) 远的集合是什么？Which points are no farther from a=(−1,0) than from b=(1,0)?

展开核对Check the answer

展开得 4x₁≤0，即左半平面 x₁≤0。Expansion gives 4x₁≤0, the left halfplane.

深入In depth

P≻0 时 xᵀPx≤1 等价于 x=P⁻½u、‖u‖₂≤1。特征值 λ 的轴半径为 1/√λ；更大的权重对应更短的轴。With P≻0, xᵀPx≤1 is equivalent to x=P⁻½u with ‖u‖₂≤1. An eigenvalue λ gives radius 1/√λ: greater weight means a shorter axis.

22 · 多面体、单纯形与半正定锥22 · Polyhedra, simplices and the PSD cone

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.21-26 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.2.4–2.2.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：读懂线性不等式交与矩阵锥；给出例子及反例。Learning goal: explain polyhedra, simplices and the psd cone and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

多面体是有限个半空间与超平面的交；单纯形来自仿射独立顶点的凸包；组成凸锥。A intersects finitely many halfspaces and hyperplanes. A simplex is the hull of affinely independent vertices. PSD matrices form a convex cone.

了解Understand

二维的可以是三角形，也可以是无界区域，名称不保证有界。标准概率单纯形要求每个 θᵢ≥0 且总和为 1；其中的点是一组概率或混合权重。三项权重的单纯形在 R³ 中是三角形平面，维数为 2，而不是填满三维体积。A planar polyhedron may be a triangle or an unbounded region; the name does not imply boundedness. A probability simplex requires nonnegative θᵢ summing to one. With three weights, it is a two-dimensional triangular plane in R³, not a solid three-dimensional region.

PSD 锥位于对称矩阵空间。对任意 X、Y⪰0 和 α、β≥0，vᵀ(αX+βY)v=αvᵀXv+βvᵀYv≥0，所以非负组合仍半正定。这里矩阵空间也能当作向量空间，维数为 n(n+1)/2；后面矩阵不等式就是这个空间中的锥约束。The PSD cone lives in the vector space of symmetric matrices. For X,Y⪰0 and α,β≥0, the quadratic form of αX+βY is a nonnegative combination, so it stays PSD. Symmetric matrices form a vector space of dimension n(n+1)/2; matrix inequalities are cone constraints in this space.

二维对称矩阵 [[a,b],[b,c]] 半正定需要 a≥0、c≥0、ac≥b²。对角元素非负仍不够，例如 [[1,2],[2,1]] 的特征值为 3、−1。把半正定性误读成逐元素非负，会把这个矩阵错误地纳入 PSD 锥。For [[a,b],[b,c]], PSD requires a≥0, c≥0 and ac≥b². Nonnegative diagonal entries alone are insufficient: [[1,2],[2,1]] has eigenvalues three and −1. Reading PSD as entrywise nonnegativity would incorrectly include it.

掌握Mastery

多面体凸性逐条检查：Gx≤h、Gy≤h 意味着 G(θx+(1−θ)y)≤θh+(1−θ)h=h，等式同理。PSD 锥闭性也逐个 v 检查：若 Xₖ→X 且 Xₖ⪰0，连续性给 vᵀXv=lim vᵀXₖv≥0。它的内部是正定矩阵，边界含奇异半正定矩阵。For a polyhedron, combine each inequality and equality at x and y to preserve feasibility. For closedness of the PSD cone, if Xₖ→X then vᵀXv=lim vᵀXₖv≥0 for each v. Its interior consists of positive definite matrices, and singular PSD matrices lie on its boundary.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

[[1,b],[b,1]] 半正定时 b 可以取哪些值？For which b is [[1,b],[b,1]] PSD?

展开核对Check the answer

要求 1−b²≥0，所以 −1≤b≤1。The condition 1−b²≥0 gives −1≤b≤1.

深入In depth

无限个半空间的交仍凸，却不一定是多面体。欧氏单位球可以写成 uᵀx≤1 对所有单位方向 u 成立；在二维以上通常无法用有限条平面边界精确描述球。An infinite halfspace intersection is convex but need not be polyhedral. The Euclidean unit ball is given by uᵀx≤1 for every unit direction u, generally requiring infinitely many supporting directions in dimension at least two.

23 · 交、仿射像与仿射原像23 · Operations that preserve convexity

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.28-35 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.3.1–2.3.2 · HW1 3辅助

学完应能：用保凸运算拆复杂集合；区分像与。Learning goal: explain operations that preserve convexity and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

任意凸集的交、仿射像和仿射原像都是凸的；并集一般不保持凸性。Intersections, affine images and affine s preserve convexity. Unions generally do not.

了解Understand

“交”表示同时满足约束。若两点满足每一个凸约束集合，它们的线段也满足每一个，所以整个交集凸。二维中圆盘与半空间相交可能切掉一部分圆盘，但不会在剩余区域中挖出断开的间隙。并集则表示满足其中至少一个；两个分离的小圆盘的并集便不凸。An intersection means simultaneous constraints. A segment between two points satisfying every convex set remains in each, hence in the intersection. Cutting a disk with a halfspace preserves convexity. A union means satisfying at least one set; two separated disks show why convexity can fail.

仿射像是把所有可行输入送到输出，仿射原像是收集能送进指定可行输出的输入。这里 f⁻¹(D) 是集合原像记号，并不要求 A 可逆。例如 {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1} 是欧氏球的仿射原像，即使 A 是长方形矩阵，也可直接判定凸。An affine image sends feasible inputs to outputs; a preimage collects inputs whose outputs satisfy a given set. The notation f⁻¹(D) does not require an invertible matrix. For example {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1} is an affine preimage of a ball, even for rectangular A.

这类规则能减少重复证明。如果约束已经写成“已知凸集的仿射原像”，不必重新展开每个平方项。但应用规则前仍要识别内层是否仿射；x↦x² 的像与原像没有这种普遍保证。These rules avoid repeated algebra when a constraint is already an affine preimage of a known convex set. Check that the inner map is affine first: x↦x² has no general image or preimage guarantee.

课件 29–31 页的系数集合 S={x:|Σₖxₖcos(kt)|≤1，对所有 |t|≤π/3} 是重要例子。固定 t 后令 a(t)=(cos t,…,cos mt)，约束是 a(t)ᵀx≤1 与 −a(t)ᵀx≤1，两条半空间。因此 S 是无限多个半空间的交，凸性立刻成立。t 是约束编号，x 是优化变量；对 t 的三角函数不影响对 x 的线性结构。The coefficient set on slides 29–31 is S={x:|Σₖxₖcos(kt)|≤1 for every |t|≤π/3}. For fixed t, set a(t)=(cos t,…,cos mt). The constraint is two halfspaces a(t)ᵀx≤1 and −a(t)ᵀx≤1, so their infinite intersection is convex. Here t indexes constraints and x is the variable; trigonometric dependence on t does not alter linearity in x.

掌握Mastery

像的证明：令 u=Ax+b、v=Ay+b，混合输出等于 A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b，括号中的输入在 C 中。原像的证明：两个输入的输出在 D 中，混合输入的输出恰好等于这两个输出的混合，因 D 凸而仍可行。交集的证明对每一个成员集合单独应用凸性即可。For images, θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b)=A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b, with the inner input in C. For preimages, the output of the mixed input is the mixture of the outputs and thus lies in D. For intersections, apply convexity separately to every member set.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

集合 {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1, x≥0} 为何凸？Why is {x:‖Ax−b‖₂≤1, x≥0} convex?

展开核对Check the answer

第一约束是球的仿射原像，第二约束是非负正交象限，交集保持凸性。The first is an affine preimage of a ball, the second an orthant, and intersections preserve convexity.

深入In depth

Minkowski 和 C+D={x+y:x∈C,y∈D} 也是凸的；它是凸乘积集 C×D 在映射 (x,y)↦x+y 下的仿射像。这个证明展示如何组合规则。The Minkowski sum C+D is convex as the affine image of the convex product C×D under (x,y)↦x+y. This illustrates composing preservation rules.

24 · 透视映射与线性分式映射24 · Perspective and linear-fractional maps

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.36-40 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.3.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：追踪正分母条件与线段参数变化。Learning goal: explain perspective and linear-fractional maps and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

(z,t)↦z/t 在 t>0 上把凸集映为凸集；线性分式映射也要求分母在所讨论区域为正。The (z,t)↦z/t preserves convex images on t>0. Linear-fractional maps likewise require a positive denominator.

了解Understand

透视可以想成把不同高度 t 的点投影到高度 1。每个点的水平坐标都除以自己的高度，所以它不是仿射映射。虽然输入的中点通常不会变成输出中点，输出之间的每一个线段点仍能由输入的某个凸组合得到。要证明的是集合凸性，不要求保留相同混合权重。Perspective projects points at height t to height one by dividing their horizontal coordinates by t, so it is not affine. An input midpoint need not map to an output midpoint, yet every output segment point comes from some input convex combination. Convexity preservation does not require unchanged weights.

例子 (z₁,t₁)=(0,1)、(z₂,t₂)=(2,2)，输出是 0、1。输入中点 (1,1.5) 的输出为 2/3，偏向第二输出。高度不同改变了混合权重，但整个输入线段仍映到 [0,1]。图中射线与 t=1 的截面展示这个投影过程。For (z₁,t₁)=(0,1) and (z₂,t₂)=(2,2), outputs are zero and one. The input midpoint (1,1.5) maps to 2/3, closer to the second output. Different heights change the mixture weight, but the full segment still maps onto [0,1]. Rays meeting t=1 show the projection.

线性分式映射先做 x↦(Ax+b,cᵀx+d) 的仿射变换，再透视。正分母条件让有效权重保持非负，也能在不等式中安全交叉相乘。若区域跨过分母为零的位置，不能直接使用这些凸性规则。A linear-fractional map first applies the affine map x↦(Ax+b,cᵀx+d), then perspective. Positive denominators preserve nonnegative effective weights and permit safe multiplication of inequalities. A region crossing a zero denominator does not satisfy these rules.

掌握Mastery

要得到输出权重 θ，输入权重应取 α=(θ/t₁)/(θ/t₁+(1−θ)/t₂)。它位于 [0,1]，且 αt₁/(αt₁+(1−α)t₂)=θ。代入透视的分子、分母，输出恰好为 θz₁/t₁+(1−θ)z₂/t₂。这给出每个输出线段点的可行输入。To obtain output weight θ, choose input weight α=(θ/t₁)/(θ/t₁+(1−θ)/t₂). It lies in [0,1] and satisfies αt₁/(αt₁+(1−α)t₂)=θ. Substituting gives exactly θz₁/t₁+(1−θ)z₂/t₂, constructing a feasible input for every output segment point.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

在上面的例子中，输出中点 1/2 对应的输入权重 α 是多少？In the example, which input weight α produces output one half?

展开核对Check the answer

α=(1/2)/(1/2+1/4)=2/3；输入为 (2/3,4/3)，相除得到 1/2。α=(1/2)/(1/2+1/4)=2/3. The input is (2/3,4/3), whose ratio is one half.

深入In depth

仿射原像规则加上正分母交叉相乘，也能证明线性分式映射的凸原像性质。这是后面分式规划和优化的桥梁。Affine preimages and positive-denominator multiplication also establish convex preimages for linear-fractional maps, linking this section to fractional and optimization.

25 · proper cone 与广义不等式25 · Proper cones and generalized inequalities

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.42-46 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.4.1 · HW1 5(a),5(c)

学完应能：逐一检查凸、闭、实心、尖；直接证明锥诱导关系传递。Learning goal: explain s and generalized inequalities and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

正常锥是闭、凸、内部非空、尖的锥。x⪯K y 表示 y−x∈K，为向量定义偏序。A proper cone is closed, convex, solid and pointed. The order x⪯K y means y−x∈K.

了解Understand

实数的 ≤ 可以用“差非负”来定义。向量没有唯一自然的大小次序，于是选一个锥 K 表示“允许的非负变化”。K=Rⁿ₊ 时，就是逐分量比较；K 为 PSD 锥时，就是比较对称矩阵二次型。偏序允许两个对象无法比较，例如 (1,0) 与 (0,1) 在逐分量顺序下。Scalar order is defined by a nonnegative difference. Vectors have no unique natural order, so choose a cone K of acceptable nonnegative changes. The orthant gives componentwise order; the PSD cone orders quadratic forms. A partial order allows incomparability, such as (1,0) and (0,1) componentwise.

四个条件各有作用：凸锥保证相加和非负缩放；闭性保证极限不丢失；内部非空使严格不等式有空间；排除双向非零变化，保证若 x⪯K y 且 y⪯K x，就只能 x=y。严格顺序 x≺K y 定义为差在 int K 中，不能简单理解成不相等。Each requirement has a role: convex conicity gives addition and scaling, closedness keeps limits, nonempty interior supports strict inequalities, and excludes nonzero changes in both directions. Thus x⪯K y and y⪯K x imply equality. Strict order means the difference lies in int K, not merely that it is nonzero.

作业 5 的二阶锥 K={(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t} 中，t 是预算，x 是消耗。锥顶为原点；边界为预算恰好用完，内部要求 t>‖x‖₂。图中的二维截面是一个向上的 V 形区域；更高维时它是圆锥。For HW1 5, the second-order cone K={(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t} pairs consumption x with budget t. Zero is its vertex, the boundary exhausts the budget, and the interior requires t>‖x‖₂. A two-dimensional section is an upward V-shaped region; higher dimensions form a circular cone.

掌握Mastery

作业 5(a)：凸锥性由 ‖αx+βy‖≤α‖x‖+β‖y‖≤αt+βs 得出。闭性由范数连续性传极限。点 (0,1) 周围半径 r<1/√2 的欧氏球在锥内，因为 |δt|+‖δx‖≤√2‖(δx,δt)‖<1，所以 1+δt>‖δx‖。若 (x,t) 与 (−x,−t) 都在锥内，则 ‖x‖≤t 且 ‖x‖≤−t，迫使 x=0、t=0，证明尖性。For 5(a), conicity and convexity follow from ‖αx+βy‖≤α‖x‖+β‖y‖≤αt+βs. Norm continuity gives closedness. A ball of radius r<1/√2 around (0,1) stays inside because |δt|+‖δx‖≤√2‖(δx,δt)‖<1. Membership of both (x,t) and its negative forces ‖x‖≤t and ‖x‖≤−t, hence both are zero, proving pointedness.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

非负正交象限中，(0,1)≺(1,2) 吗？(0,1)≺(0,2) 呢？In the orthant order, is (0,1) strictly below (1,2)? What about (0,2)?

展开核对Check the answer

前者差为 (1,1)，在内部；后者差为 (0,1)，在边界，因此只有前者严格。The first difference (1,1) is interior. The second (0,1) is on the boundary, so only the first is strict.

深入In depth

PSD 锥也正常：正定矩阵形成内部，零矩阵是唯一同时半正定与半负定的矩阵。这使矩阵序能服务于协方差界、稳定性条件和 Schur 补模型。The PSD cone is proper as well: positive definite matrices form its interior, and only zero is both PSD and NSD. Its order is useful for covariance bounds, stability conditions and Schur-complement models.

核对原课件 · 42-46Check original slides · 42-46

26 · 最小元与极小元26 · Minimum elements and minimal elements

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.47-48 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.4.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用二维偏序图解释两者差别，理解可比较性的限制。Learning goal: explain s and minimal elements and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

不大于集合中每个元素；极小元素只要求没有另一个不同元素不大于它。A minimum element is below every element. A has no distinct element below it.

了解Understand

普通实数的全序常让这两个词看起来相同，向量偏序则明显不同。对 S={(0,1),(1,0)}，两个点都没有被另一点逐分量压低，因此都是；但没有一个同时不大于另一个，所以没有最小元素。多个目标互相牵制时，常得到一组极小方案。For scalar total order the terms may coincide, but partial orders distinguish them. In S={(0,1),(1,0)}, neither point is componentwise dominated by the other, so both are minimal. Neither is below the other, so there is no minimum. Competing objectives often produce many minimal choices.

若再加入 (0,0)，它不大于上述两点，于是成为最小元素，其他两点不再极小。最小元素存在时通常是我们能统一推荐的方案；只有极小元素时，还需说明使用者在不同目标间的偏好，不能单靠偏序挑出唯一答案。Adding (0,0) makes it the minimum, and the previous points cease to be minimal. A minimum gives a uniformly preferable choice; with only minimal elements, preferences among objectives are needed to select a single answer.

掌握Mastery

正常锥的序满足反对称性，因此最小元素若存在就唯一。若 x、y 都是最小元素，则 x⪯K y 且 y⪯K x，反对称性给 x=y。每个最小元素都是极小元素，但上面的两点例子说明反向不成立。A proper-cone order is antisymmetric, so a minimum, if present, is unique. Two minima would be below each other and hence equal. Every minimum is minimal, but the two-point example disproves the converse.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

S={(1,1),(1,2),(2,0)} 的逐分量极小元素有哪些？Find the componentwise minimal elements of S={(1,1),(1,2),(2,0)}.

展开核对Check the answer

为 (1,1)、(2,0)；(1,2) 被 (1,1) 支配，没有最小元素。They are (1,1) and (2,0). The point (1,2) is dominated by (1,1); there is no minimum.

深入In depth

非闭集合可能没有极小元素，例如正象限内部 (0,∞)²，任何点都可把两坐标减半再变好。存在性仍需结合集合条件检查。A nonclosed set may lack minimal elements: in (0,∞)², halving both coordinates improves every point. Existence requires separate set conditions.

核对原课件 · 47-48Check original slides · 47-48

27 · 分离超平面27 · Separating hyperplanes

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.50-55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.5.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：辨析分离与严格分离的假设；检查开集和距离条件。Learning goal: explain s and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

两个非空不相交凸集可由非零法向的超平面弱分离；严格分离需要额外条件。Two nonempty disjoint convex sets admit a weak separating hyperplane with nonzero normal. Strict separation needs further assumptions.

了解Understand

把两个集合放在两侧。二维画一条直线，高维则画超平面。这个定理把“两个集合不相交”的几何事实转成线性不等式证书：一个方向 a 能区分它们。优化对偶与最优性条件常依赖这样的证书。A separator places two sets on opposite sides of a line or hyperplane. The theorem turns disjointness into a linear certificate: a direction a distinguishes the sets. Such certificates underpin optimization duality and optimality conditions.

两个圆盘中心分别为 (−2,0)、(2,0)，半径都为 1，直线 x₁=0 严格分开它们。若改为 C={x₂>0}、D={x₂≤0}，只能把边界放在 x₂=0；两侧可以任意接近，所以无法保证固定正间隙。课件的弱分离允许某一侧取等，不能擅自换成严格符号。Disks of radius one centered at (−2,0) and (2,0) are strictly separated by x₁=0. For C={x₂>0} and D={x₂≤0}, separation occurs at x₂=0, but points approach the boundary arbitrarily closely, so no fixed positive gap exists. Weak separation permits equality and must not be silently strengthened.

一个点 z 在闭凸集 C 外时，可以找到离 z 最近的点 p，再用 z−p 作为法向。图中红线段从 p 指向 z，支撑线过 p，集合整体位于远离 z 的一侧。这个构造直接连接最小二乘投影与几何分离。For z outside a closed convex C, choose its nearest point p and use z−p as normal. The red segment points from p to z; the supporting line passes through p, with C on the opposite side. This connects nearest-point projection to separation.

反向命题也要小心：一条弱分离线不一定说明两个集合不相交，因为两者可能共享线上的点。若至少一侧严格，则不可能共享点；若两个集合的内部都非空，弱分离至少排除内部相交。凸集内部与外部都谈清楚，才能正确使用课件的分离反向结论。Be careful with converses: a weak separator does not force disjointness because sets may share points on the plane. Strictness on at least one side excludes common points. With nonempty interiors, weak separation excludes overlapping interiors. State which kind of intersection is being ruled out.

掌握Mastery

令 v=z−p。对任意 x∈C，点 p+t(x−p) 在 C 中，距离平方在 t=0 达到最小，所以右导数 −2vᵀ(x−p)≥0，得 vᵀx≤vᵀp。而 vᵀz=vᵀp+‖v‖²>vᵀp，因 z∉C 保证 v≠0。因此超平面严格把外点和集合分开。一般两集合定理可在差集合上运用凸分离理论，超出这个投影构造时不假定最近点一定存在。For v=z−p and x∈C, p+t(x−p) stays feasible. The right derivative of squared distance at t=0 is −2vᵀ(x−p)≥0, giving vᵀx≤vᵀp. But vᵀz=vᵀp+‖v‖²>vᵀp since v≠0. This strictly separates the external point. General set separation needs convex separation theory; nearest pairs need not always exist.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

单位圆盘 C 与点 z=(2,0)，写一个严格分离式。Give a strict separator between the unit disk and z=(2,0).

展开核对Check the answer

C 上 x₁≤1，而 z₁=2，可以取直线 x₁=1.5，把两者严格分开。On C, x₁≤1, while z₁=2. The line x₁=1.5 strictly separates them.

深入In depth

若一个集合紧且另一个闭，二者非空、凸、不相交，则距离取得正值，可得到带正间隙的严格分离。两个都仅闭而无界时，距离可能为零。If one nonempty convex set is compact and the other closed, disjointness gives an attained positive distance and a strict positive gap. Two closed unbounded sets can instead have distance zero.

核对原课件 · 50-55Check original slides · 50-55

28 · 支撑超平面28 · Supporting hyperplanes

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.56-58 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.5.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：理解边界点的支撑方向及凸性假设。Learning goal: explain s and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

边界点处的通过该点，并把整个凸集放在同一侧。A supporting hyperplane passes through a boundary point and places the entire convex set on one side.

了解Understand

圆盘最右端 (1,0) 的支撑线是 x₁=1；它接触集合却不穿过内部。支撑不要求接触唯一点，正方形的一整条边都可以在同一条支撑线上。对偶范数中把直线推到单位球最后接触处，正是在寻找支撑超平面。At (1,0) on the unit disk, x₁=1 supports the set without cutting its interior. Contact need not be unique: a whole square edge can lie on a supporting line. Pushing a line to last contact with a norm ball, as in dual norms, is precisely finding support.

对于非空凸集，每个属于集合的边界点都有至少一个支撑超平面；法向可能不唯一。光滑圆周点有一个法向，方形角点有一组法向。边界的尖角因此对应多种线性目标都选择同一个最优点。Every boundary point belonging to a nonempty convex set admits at least one supporting hyperplane, but normals may be nonunique. A smooth circle point has one normal direction, while a square corner has many. Many linear objectives may therefore select the same corner.

掌握Mastery

圆盘点 x₀ 满足 ‖x₀‖₂=1。对任意球内 x，Cauchy–Schwarz 给 x₀ᵀx≤‖x‖₂≤1=x₀ᵀx₀，因此取法向 a=x₀ 就得到支撑线。对一般椭球 xᵀPx≤1，边界点的法向为 Px₀，可由换元到欧氏球证明。For a unit boundary point x₀, Cauchy–Schwarz gives x₀ᵀx≤‖x‖₂≤1=x₀ᵀx₀ for every disk point. Thus a=x₀ is a supporting normal. For xᵀPx≤1, the normal at x₀ is Px₀, as follows by transforming to a Euclidean ball.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

正方形 [−1,1]² 在角点 (1,1) 处给出两个不同法向。Give two different supporting normals at (1,1) for [−1,1]².

展开核对Check the answer

可取 (1,0)、(0,1)，也可取 (1,1)。它们分别支撑右边、上边和该角点。Use (1,0), (0,1), or (1,1), supporting the right edge, top edge, or the corner.

深入In depth

函数的凸性会产生 epigraph 的支撑超平面。可微时切平面 z=f(x₀)+∇f(x₀)ᵀ(x−x₀) 全局位于函数下方；第 32 节把集合支撑变成函数的一阶条件。Convex functions produce supporting hyperplanes to their s. When differentiable, the tangent plane lies globally below the function. Section 32 turns geometric support into a first-order characterization.

核对原课件 · 56-58Check original slides · 56-58

29 · 对偶锥与二阶锥的自对偶29 · Dual cones and self-duality of the second-order cone

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.60-65 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.6.1 · HW1 5(b)

学完应能：做包含关系的双向证明；构造违约向量；用对偶范数解释范数锥。Learning goal: explain dual cones and self-duality of the second-order cone and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

对偶锥由与原锥所有向量内积都非负的向量组成。二阶锥在标准内积下自对偶。A dual cone consists of vectors with nonnegative inner product against every primal-cone vector. The second-order cone is self-dual under the standard inner product.

了解Understand

为什么引入对偶锥？原锥描述哪些变化可接受，对偶锥描述哪些线性评分会给这些变化非负分。若 x⪯K y 且 λ∈K*，则 λᵀx≤λᵀy。因此一个向量顺序可以转成许多标量顺序，便于构造最优性证书与多目标权重。Why introduce a dual cone? The primal cone specifies acceptable changes; the dual cone specifies linear scores assigning them nonnegative value. If x⪯K y and λ∈K*, then λᵀx≤λᵀy. Vector order becomes a family of scalar comparisons, useful for certificates and multiobjective weights.

非负正交象限自对偶：权重每项非负时与所有非负向量内积非负；若某权重为负，挑选对应坐标单位向量就会得到负值。二阶锥也自对偶，但证明需用欧氏内积界。自对偶依赖所选内积，不能只凭锥的外形下结论。The nonnegative orthant is self-dual: nonnegative weights pair nonnegatively with all nonnegative vectors, and a negative weight is exposed by its coordinate unit vector. The SOC is also self-dual, using the Euclidean inner-product bound. Self-duality depends on the chosen inner product, not just visual shape.

对偶锥定义使用 ≥0；对偶范数使用单位球上的上确界；则最大化线性项减函数值。三个星号对象不同，虽然都用内积把变量与线性评分联系起来，仍必须从各自定义出发计算。Dual cones use ≥0 for every cone point; dual norms optimize over unit balls; s maximize a linear term minus a function. These star notations act on different objects. Their shared inner-product language does not replace their individual definitions.

子空间 V 的对偶锥是 V⊥：因为 v 与 −v 都在 V，非负内积必须同时满足 yᵀv≥0、−yᵀv≥0，因而等于零。对偶锥总是闭凸，因为它是闭半空间的交；若 K₁⊂K₂，则 K₂*⊂K₁*，更大的原锥带来更多检验条件。正常锥的对偶也是正常锥；一般锥的双对偶是其闭凸锥包。A subspace V has dual cone V⊥: pairing nonnegatively with both v and −v forces zero. A dual cone is closed and convex as an intersection of closed halfspaces. Inclusion reverses: K₁⊂K₂ implies K₂*⊂K₁*, since a larger primal cone imposes more tests. Proper cones have proper duals; general cones biconjugate to their closed convex conic hull.

掌握Mastery

作业 5(b)，先证 K⊂K*。若 (x,t)、(y,s)∈K，则 xᵀy+ts≥−‖x‖‖y‖+ts≥0。再证反向：若 (y,s)∉K，s<0 时与 (0,1) 的内积为负；s≥0 但 ‖y‖>s 时，取 (x,t)=(−y/‖y‖,1)∈K，内积 s−‖y‖<0。两种情况都排除其属于 K*，故 K*=K。For HW1 5(b), if both (x,t) and (y,s) are in K, then xᵀy+ts≥−‖x‖‖y‖+ts≥0, proving K⊂K*. Conversely, outside K, if s<0 use (0,1) to get a negative pairing. If s≥0 but ‖y‖>s, use (−y/‖y‖,1), obtaining s−‖y‖<0. This proves K*=K.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

点 (y,s)=(2,1) 不在二维二阶锥内，找一个锥内点与它内积为负。Find a cone point pairing negatively with (y,s)=(2,1).

展开核对Check the answer

取 (x,t)=(−1,1)，内积为 −2+1=−1。Choose (−1,1), giving −2+1=−1.

深入In depth

PSD 锥在迹内积下自对偶。若 X,Y⪰0，则 tr(XY)=tr(X½YX½)≥0；若对称 Y 有负特征向量 v，取 X=vvᵀ，内积为 vᵀYv<0。这是同一“上界/证据向量”思路在矩阵空间的版本。The PSD cone is self-dual under pairing: for PSD X,Y, tr(XY)=tr(X½YX½)≥0. A symmetric Y with negative eigenvector v is exposed by X=vvᵀ, giving vᵀYv<0. This is the same certificate-vector strategy in matrix space.

30 · 偏序的对偶刻画与 Pareto 前沿30 · Dual weights, order tests and Pareto frontiers

Lecture 3 · PDF pp.66-74 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §2.6.2–2.6.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用正权重标量化理解最小元、极小元及生产前沿。Learning goal: explain dual weights, order tests and pareto frontiers and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

正常锥的顺序可用所有对偶权重检验。正的标量化权重能排除被支配方案，得到 Pareto 极小点。For a proper cone, all dual weights test its order. Strictly positive scalarization weights exclude dominated solutions and yield Pareto-minimal points.

了解Understand

当目标为向量 f(x)=(费用,误差) 时，两个方案可能分别擅长一项。一个方案被另一个方案支配，表示全部目标都不更好且至少一项更差；没有被支配的方案构成 。前沿让使用者看到真实权衡，随后再选偏好。For vector objectives such as (cost,error), one plan may be better on cost and another on accuracy. A plan is dominated if another is no worse in every objective and strictly better in at least one. The undominated set is the , displaying the tradeoff before preferences are chosen.

可以选权重 λ₁、λ₂>0，最小化 λ₁费用+λ₂误差。若某最优点还被另一点支配，加权值就会严格下降，产生矛盾。因此正权重最优点一定 Pareto 极小。零权重会忽略某一目标，可能留下在那一项可改进的点。Choose λ₁,λ₂>0 and minimize their weighted objective sum. A dominated optimizer would have a strictly better weighted value, a contradiction. Positive-weight optimizers are therefore Pareto minimal. A zero weight ignores an objective and may allow an avoidable deterioration in it.

作业 5(c) 的二阶锥顺序，把 (x,t)⪯K(y,s) 读为 ‖y−x‖≤s−t。从一个状态到另一个状态的空间变化不能超过预算增加量。它让标量“预算随时间积累”的直觉扩展到空间与预算联合的偏序。For HW1 5(c), (x,t)⪯K(y,s) means ‖y−x‖≤s−t. The spatial change must not exceed the budget increase. This extends scalar budget accumulation to a joint spatial-budget order.

最小元素的对偶刻画要求同一个点对全部 λ∈K* 都最小化 λᵀx。极小元素只需某些权重提供证书：若 λ∈int K*，加权最优点必极小；凸集合中的极小点可由某个非零 λ∈K* 支撑，但该 λ 不一定在内部，也不保证加权解唯一。严格序 x≺K y 恰好使全部非零对偶权重满足 λᵀx<λᵀy；必须排除零权重，否则严格不等式显然不可能。A minimum must minimize λᵀx for every λ∈K* at the same point. Minimality uses weaker certificates: an interior-dual-weight optimizer is minimal; a minimal point of a convex set can be supported by some nonzero dual weight, not necessarily interior or giving uniqueness. Strict order makes every nonzero dual pairing strict; zero weight must be excluded.

掌握Mastery

传递性：若 ‖y−x‖≤s−t、‖z−y‖≤r−s，三角不等式给 ‖z−x‖≤‖z−y‖+‖y−x‖≤r−t，所以 (x,t)⪯K(z,r)。一般正常锥的双对偶 K**=K，由闭凸锥分离定理得到，因此若所有对偶权重都判定 y−x 非负，它就必须属于 K。For transitivity, combine ‖y−x‖≤s−t and ‖z−y‖≤r−s with the triangle inequality to get ‖z−x‖≤r−t. For a proper cone, K**=K follows from closed-convex-cone separation; hence passing every dual-weight test forces y−x∈K.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

方案 (1,4)、(2,2)、(4,1)、(3,3) 中哪些被支配？Which of (1,4), (2,2), (4,1), (3,3) are dominated?

展开核对Check the answer

(3,3) 被 (2,2) 支配，另外三个互相不可比较。Only (3,3) is dominated, by (2,2). The other three are incomparable.

深入In depth

加权和可以找出一部分前沿点，但一般非凸目标像中的 Pareto 点可能无法用任何正权重暴露出来。凸目标像时分离理论给更强联系；仍要区分弱 Pareto、Pareto 与严格正权重条件。Weighted sums find supported frontier points, but a nonconvex objective image can contain Pareto points unrecoverable by any positive weighting. Convexity gives stronger separation-based connections, with distinctions among weak Pareto, Pareto and strictly positive weights.

LECTURE 04

凸函数与保持规则Convex functions and preservation

31 · 凸函数、严格凸与扩展值31 · Convex functions and extended values

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.4-9 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.1–3.1.2 · HW1 4基础

学完应能：同时检查定义域凸性与函数不等式；解释域外 +∞。Learning goal: explain s and extended values and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸函数的定义域必须凸，图像不高于连接两点的弦。严格凸要求不同点和内部混合权重下严格小于。A convex function has a convex domain and lies below every chord. Strict convexity requires strict inequality for distinct points and interior weights.

了解Understand

对 f(x)=x²，取 x=−1、y=3、中点为 1。中点函数值是 1，而两端函数值平均为 (1+9)/2=5，图像位于弦下方。这里比较的是“先混合输入再算函数”和“先算函数再混合结果”。这两种操作的顺序差别，就是凸性不等式的核心。For f(x)=x² with endpoints −1 and 3, the midpoint is one. Its value is one, below the endpoint average (1+9)/2=5. Convexity compares mixing inputs before evaluation with mixing values after evaluation. The order of these operations is its central meaning.

仿射函数取等，因此既凸又凹，却不严格凸。严格凸函数在凸可行集上至多有一个最优点：两个不同最优点的中点会更好。但“至多一个”并未保证存在；例如 eˣ 在整个 R 上严格凸，最小值仍不取得。Affine functions give equality, making them both convex and concave but not strictly convex. A strictly convex function on a convex feasible set has at most one optimizer because two distinct optimizers would have a better midpoint. Existence is separate: eˣ is strictly convex on R but does not attain its infimum.

扩展值约定把定义域外设为 +∞。例如 −log x 在 x≤0 处设为 +∞；集合 C 的 δC 在 C 内为 0，在外为 +∞。于是带约束 min f(x), x∈C 可以写成无显式约束的 min(f+δC)。这个约定使用 +∞ 排除禁止点，和取 0、1 的概率指示函数不同。The extended-value convention sets forbidden inputs to +∞. Extend −log x this way for x≤0; the convex indicator δC is zero inside C and +∞ outside. Then constrained minimization becomes minimization of f+δC. This exclusion convention differs from a zero-one probability indicator.

掌握Mastery

若 x、y 都是不同最优点，且目标值为 p*，严格凸性给 f((x+y)/2)<p*，而凸可行集保证中点可行，矛盾。另一方面 δC 凸恰好要求 C 凸：两端在 C 内时右侧为零，中间必须也在 C 内，否则左侧为 +∞。Distinct optimizers with value p* would give a feasible midpoint with value below p*, contradicting optimality. Also δC is convex exactly when C is convex: mixing two zero-valued points must not yield +∞.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=|x| 是严格凸函数吗？Is |x| strictly convex?

展开核对Check the answer

它凸，但在正半轴上为仿射。例如 x=1、y=3 时中点与平均函数值都为 2，所以非严格凸。It is convex but affine on the positive halfline. For 1 and 3, both midpoint value and averaged value are two, violating strictness.

深入In depth

凹函数定义为 −f 凸，适合最大化收益问题。将凹目标最大化等价于将负目标最小化。定义域仍要一起说明，不能只翻转函数表达式。A function is concave when −f is convex, useful for maximizing utility. Maximizing a concave objective is minimizing its negative, with the same specified domain.

核对原课件 · 4-9Check original slides · 4-9

32 · 一阶条件：切线是全局下界32 · First-order characterization and optimality

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.10-15 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：推导一阶判定的两个方向；解释导数存在的前提。Learning goal: explain first-order characterization and optimality and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

可微凸函数的每个切平面都在图像下方。无约束内点处梯度为零即可保证全局最优。Every tangent plane of a differentiable convex function lies below its graph. A zero gradient at an unconstrained interior point guarantees global optimality.

了解Understand

凸性定义比较两点及其中间点，一阶条件改用一个点的梯度。对 f(x)=x²，x=1 的切线是 1+2(y−1)=2y−1。两者之差 y²−(2y−1)=(y−1)²≥0，所以切线在整个定义域内都不越过曲线。图中蓝线是函数，红线是切线；把切点移开，观察全局下界仍成立。The definition uses endpoints and mixtures; the first-order condition uses one point’s gradient. For x² at x=1, the tangent is 2y−1. The difference y²−(2y−1)=(y−1)²≥0 makes it a global lower bound. The blue function and red tangent in the diagram retain this relation as the contact point moves.

若 ∇f(x*)=0，一阶下界变成 f(y)≥f(x*)，直接比较全部 y，得到全局最优。若有约束，最优点的梯度可能不为零，例如在 x≥1 上最小化 x²，最优点为 1，导数为 2；它指向的下降方向会离开可行区域。When ∇f(x*)=0, the lower bound becomes f(y)≥f(x*) for every y, proving global optimality. With constraints the optimizer may have nonzero gradient: minimizing x² on x≥1 gives x*=1 and derivative two, while the descent direction leaves the feasible set.

凸可行集 C 上的可微凸问题，最优性可写为 ∇f(x*)ᵀ(y−x*)≥0 对所有 y∈C 成立。它要求每一个可行移动方向的一阶变化非负，和支撑超平面的几何对应。这个判断必须针对全部可行点，挑几个方向检查并不充分。On a convex feasible set C, differentiable convex optimality is ∇f(x*)ᵀ(y−x*)≥0 for every y∈C. Every feasible direction must have nonnegative first-order change, matching supporting geometry. Checking only a few selected directions is insufficient.

掌握Mastery

从凸性取 x+t(y−x)，得到 [f(x+t(y−x))−f(x)]/t≤f(y)−f(x)。令 t↓0，左侧趋于 ∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)，得切平面下界。反过来在 z=θx+(1−θ)y 处分别对 x、y 使用下界，再按 θ、1−θ 相加，梯度项相消，得凸性定义。Apply convexity at x+t(y−x), divide by t>0, and let t↓0 to obtain the tangent lower bound. Conversely, apply lower bounds to x and y from z=θx+(1−θ)y; multiply by the two weights and add. Gradient terms cancel, yielding the convexity inequality.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=(x−3)² 的梯度在哪一点为零？如何仅用一阶条件证明最优？Where is the gradient of (x−3)² zero, and how does the first-order condition prove optimality?

展开核对Check the answer

在 x=3 为零。凸性下界给 f(y)≥f(3)=0，因此它全局最优。It vanishes at three; the convex lower bound gives f(y)≥f(3)=0 for all y.

深入In depth

不可微凸函数仍有支撑斜率，称 g，满足 f(y)≥f(x)+gᵀ(y−x)。例如 |x| 在 0 的次梯度集合为 [−1,1]。后续算法可以用这些全局下界代替普通切线。Nondifferentiable convex functions may have s g satisfying the same global affine lower bound. At zero, |x| has subgradient set [−1,1]. Later algorithms use these supports in place of ordinary tangents.

33 · 二阶条件与基本函数33 · Second-order tests and standard examples

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.16-24 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.4–3.1.5 · HW1 4(a),4(b),2(c)

学完应能：算指数、负对数、熵项与二次函数的二阶导；辨析严格凸的充分条件。Learning goal: explain second-order tests and standard examples and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

在凸的开放定义域内，二次可微函数凸当且仅当 Hessian 处处半正定。Hessian 处处正定可保证严格凸。On an open convex domain, a twice differentiable function is convex iff its Hessian is PSD everywhere. Positive definiteness everywhere implies strict convexity.

了解Understand

沿任意方向把多变量函数限制到一条线，得到一元函数 g(t)=f(x+tv)。它的二阶导数为 vᵀ∇²f(x+tv)v。若所有方向的曲率都非负，所有线段上的图像都向上弯，于是函数凸。只检查 Hessian 的对角元素不足够，交叉项也可能制造负方向。Restrict f to a line: g(t)=f(x+tv), with g″(t)=vᵀ∇²f(x+tv)v. Nonnegative curvature in every direction makes every line restriction convex and thus f convex. Nonnegative diagonal entries alone cannot exclude negative curvature caused by cross terms.

作业 4(a)：exp(ax) 的二阶导数为 a²exp(ax)≥0，a=0 时为常数；−log x 在 x>0 上二阶导数为 1/x²>0；x log x 在 x>0 上二阶导数为 1/x>0。后两者严格凸。x log x 在 x=0 可连续补值 0，扩展到闭半轴后仍凸。For HW1 4(a), exp(ax) has second derivative a²exp(ax)≥0 and is constant when a=0. On x>0, −log x has second derivative 1/x² and x log x has 1/x, both positive. The latter extends continuously to zero with value zero and remains convex on the closed halfline.

作业 4(b)：平方最小二乘 Hessian 为 2AᵀA，因为 vᵀ2AᵀAv=2‖Av‖²≥0，所以始终凸。只有 A 满列秩时二次型对所有非零 v 都正，得到严格凸。缺列秩时目标沿某个零空间方向不变，无法严格凸。For HW1 4(b), least-squares Hessian is 2AᵀA and its quadratic form is 2‖Av‖²≥0, giving convexity. Full column rank makes it positive for every nonzero v, giving strict convexity. With a nullspace direction the objective is constant along a line and cannot be strictly convex.

范数的凸性不靠二阶导数：三角不等式与非负齐次性直接给 ‖θx+(1−θ)y‖≤θ‖x‖+(1−θ)‖y‖。|x|ᵖ 在 p≥1 时凸，可由 |x| 的凸性和 u↦uᵖ 在 u≥0 上凸且非减得到。函数 maxᵢxᵢ 是凸的，因为每个混合分量都不超过两端最大分量的加权平均。Norm convexity does not require second derivatives: the triangle inequality and nonnegative homogeneity give it directly. The function |x|ᵖ is convex for p≥1 by composing |x| with the convex increasing power on nonnegative inputs. The coordinate maximum is convex because each mixed coordinate is bounded by the weighted endpoint maxima.

掌握Mastery

一元二阶导数非负意味着导数单调非减，积分得 f(y)−f(x)≥f′(x)(y−x)。对每条线应用这一结论，再用第 32 节的一阶充要条件即可证明多元版本。逆向由凸一元限制函数的二阶导数非负得到 vᵀHv≥0。严格凸不要求 Hessian 每点正定：x⁴ 在 0 的二阶导数为零，仍严格凸。In one dimension, nonnegative second derivative makes the first derivative nondecreasing; integrating yields the tangent lower bound. Apply this along every line and use Section 32. Conversely, convex line restrictions have nonnegative second derivatives, giving vᵀHv≥0. Strict convexity does not require pointwise PD Hessians: x⁴ is strictly convex despite f″(0)=0.

几何平均 G(x)=(∏ᵢxᵢ)^(1/n) 在正象限凹。其方向二阶导数为 G/n²[(Σᵢvᵢ/xᵢ)²−nΣᵢ(vᵢ/xᵢ)²]≤0，最后一步用 Cauchy–Schwarz。log det X 的凹性也可沿直线证明：令 W=X⁻½HX⁻½，特征值为 λᵢ，log det(X+tH)=log det X+Σᵢlog(1+tλᵢ)，二阶导数为 −Σᵢλᵢ²/(1+tλᵢ)²≤0，定义域要求 X+tH≻0。The geometric mean G(x)=(∏ᵢxᵢ)^(1/n) is concave on the positive orthant. Its second directional derivative is G/n²[(Σᵢvᵢ/xᵢ)²−nΣᵢ(vᵢ/xᵢ)²]≤0 by Cauchy–Schwarz. For logdet, let W=X⁻½HX⁻½ have eigenvalues λᵢ. Along X+tH≻0, logdet equals logdet X+Σᵢlog(1+tλᵢ), whose second derivative is −Σᵢλᵢ²/(1+tλᵢ)²≤0.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

H=[[1,2],[2,1]] 对角元素都正。取什么方向可以说明它非半正定？Find a direction showing that H=[[1,2],[2,1]] is not PSD despite its positive diagonal.

展开核对Check the answer

v=(1,−1)，vᵀHv=−2<0。Take v=(1,−1), giving vᵀHv=−2<0.

深入In depth

其他常见例子：xᵖ 在 x>0 上由 p(p−1)xᵖ⁻² 判曲率，p≤0 或 p≥1 时凸，0≤p≤1 时凹；负熵 Σxᵢlog xᵢ 在正象限凸。−log det X 在 X≻0 上二阶方向导数为 tr(X⁻¹HX⁻¹H)≥0，矩阵平方范数说明其非负。Other examples: xᵖ on x>0 has curvature p(p−1)xᵖ⁻², convex for p≤0 or p≥1 and concave for 0≤p≤1. Negative entropy Σxᵢlog xᵢ is convex on the positive orthant. For −log det X, the second directional derivative tr(X⁻¹HX⁻¹H) is nonnegative as a squared matrix norm.

34 · 下水平集与上图34 · Sublevel sets and epigraphs

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.25-27 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.6–3.1.7 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：画图理解 epigraph；区别下水平集凸与函数凸。Learning goal: explain s and epigraphs and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸函数的次水平集凸；函数凸当且仅当其凸。所有次水平集凸只能保证拟凸。Convex functions have convex sublevel sets. A function is convex iff its epigraph is convex. Convex sublevel sets alone give quasiconvexity.

了解Understand

把费用门槛 α 固定，找费用不超过门槛的所有方案。对 x²，α=4 时是 [−2,2]，α<0 时为空。上图集多加一个竖直变量 t，包含函数图像及上方全部点；它把“函数弯曲”问题变成“集合线段是否可行”问题。A sublevel set fixes a cost threshold α and collects plans costing at most that amount. For x², α=4 gives [−2,2], while α<0 gives the empty set. An epigraph adds a vertical variable t and includes the graph and everything above it, turning functional curvature into set convexity.

图中蓝色抛物线为 t=x²，浅色区域是 t≥x²。在区域内取两点，它们的连线仍在区域内，就体现函数凸性。把目标 min f(x) 改为 min t、f(x)≤t，正是使用上图集；前面的最大值辅助变量也是这种构造。The blue parabola t=x² bounds the shaded epigraph t≥x². Segments between epigraph points stay shaded, visualizing convexity. Replacing min f(x) by min t subject to f(x)≤t uses this set; the earlier maximum auxiliary variable does the same.

所有次水平集都凸仍不足以推出凸函数。例如 x³ 在 R 上严格递增，每个次水平集是一个左半轴，因此拟凸；但负半轴二阶导数 6x<0，所以不是凸函数。次水平集记录可接受区域，却不比较不同高度之间的平均值。Convex sublevel sets do not imply convexity. The increasing function x³ has left-halfline sublevel sets and is quasiconvex, yet its second derivative 6x is negative on the negative halfline. Sublevels describe acceptable regions without comparing averages across different heights.

掌握Mastery

若 f 凸且 f(x),f(y)≤α，凸性给混合值≤α，故次水平集凸。上图集的正向证明把 t、s 也混合；反向取图像点 (x,f(x))、(y,f(y))，集合凸性让它们的混合仍在上图集中，直接得到函数凸性不等式。Sublevel convexity follows by bounding the mixture by an average no greater than α. For the epigraph, mix heights t and s as well. Conversely, combine graph points (x,f(x)) and (y,f(y)); epigraph membership of their mixture yields the convexity inequality.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=|x| 的上图集可用哪些线性不等式表示？Which linear inequalities describe the epigraph of |x|?

展开核对Check the answer

t≥x、t≥−x，二维中是向上张开的 V 形区域。Use t≥x and t≥−x, an upward V-shaped region.

深入In depth

凹函数用下图集 hypo f={(x,t):t≤f(x)}，凸性与凹性的几何方向相反。标注区域时先看不等号，避免把 epigraph 画到曲线下方。Concave functions use the hypograph {(x,t):t≤f(x)}. Its geometry reverses the epigraph direction; inspect the inequality before shading.

核对原课件 · 25-27Check original slides · 25-27

35 · 矩阵分式函数与上图应用35 · Matrix-fractional functions and LMIs

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.28-32 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.5；3.1.7；A.5.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用 Schur 补把矩阵分式函数上图写为半正定约束。Learning goal: explain matrix-fractional functions and lmis and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

xᵀY⁻¹x 在 x、Y≻0 上联合凸；Schur 补把它的上图集写成。The function xᵀY⁻¹x is jointly convex for Y≻0. A Schur complement expresses its epigraph as a linear matrix inequality.

了解Understand

标量版本是 x²/y，y>0。虽然固定 y 时像普通平方函数，我们需要更强的“联合凸”：同时混合 x 和 y 仍满足凸性。直接计算矩阵二阶导数会繁琐，上图集提供更短而完整的证明路线。The scalar case is x²/y with y>0. Convexity in x for fixed y is insufficient; joint convexity mixes x and y simultaneously. Matrix second derivatives are cumbersome, so the epigraph gives a shorter complete route.

块矩阵每个位置都对 (x,Y,t) 仿射，PSD 锥凸，因此 PSD 条件定义凸集。再与 Y≻0 的凸定义域相交，得到凸上图集，函数联合凸。这里求逆条件靠正定域保证，不能忘掉 Y≻0 后把奇异矩阵也当成原函数的输入。Every block entry is affine in (x,Y,t), so the PSD constraint defines a convex set. Intersecting with the convex domain Y≻0 yields a convex epigraph and hence joint convexity. Positive definiteness makes the inverse meaningful; singular matrices cannot silently be admitted to the original function.

数值检查：取 (x,y)=(1,1) 与 (3,3)，函数值分别为 1、3；中点 (2,2) 的值为 2，恰好取等。若第二点改为 (3,1)，中点值为 4，端点平均为 5，严格低于弦。不同分母改变资源尺度，联合判断要一起混合。At (x,y)=(1,1) and (3,3), values are one and three; the midpoint (2,2) gives two, attaining equality. Replacing the second point by (3,1) gives midpoint value four below the endpoint average five. Joint reasoning must mix numerator and denominator together.

掌握Mastery

线性矩阵不等式 LMI 的全称是 Linear Matrix Inequality：A₀+ΣᵢxᵢAᵢ⪰0，各 Aᵢ 固定对称。它是 PSD 锥的仿射原像，所以凸。Schur 补消元证明已经在第 18 节逐步给出，代入 A=Y、B=x、C=t，立即得到本节等价式；结合上图集充要条件完成证明。LMI means : A₀+ΣᵢxᵢAᵢ⪰0 for fixed symmetric Aᵢ. It is an affine preimage of the PSD cone. Substitute A=Y, B=x, C=t into Section 18’s completed-square argument, then apply the epigraph characterization to finish the proof.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

写出 x²/y≤4、y>0 的 2×2 矩阵约束。Write x²/y≤4, y>0 as a 2×2 matrix constraint.

展开核对Check the answer

[[y,x],[x,4]]⪰0，并保留 y>0。Use [[y,x],[x,4]]⪰0 together with y>0.

深入In depth

意义旁注：矩阵不等式可以表达整个方向族的限制，而无需枚举每一个方向。这是半正定优化处理协方差、椭球与控制问题的原因之一；关于 LMI 在控制中的发展，文末链接 Boyd 等人的历史论文页面。Significance: a matrix inequality constrains an entire family of directions without enumerating them. This is one reason semidefinite optimization handles covariance, ellipsoids and control. The source list links Boyd and colleagues’ historical paper on LMIs in control.
