36 · Jensen 不等式：从两点到有限点36 · Jensen’s inequality and the homework checkpoint

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.33-34 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.1.8 · HW1 4(c)

学完应能：按总权重分组归纳；单独处理分组权重为零的情况。Learning goal: explain jensen’s inequality and the homework checkpoint and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Jensen 把两点凸性推广到有限个点或随机变量的平均：先平均输入的函数值不高于函数值的平均。Jensen extends two-point convexity to finite mixtures or expectations: evaluating at an average is no greater than averaging evaluations.

了解Understand

对平方函数，观测为 1、3，权重各 1/2，均值为 2，均值平方为 4，平方均值为 5。差 1 来自波动。更一般地 E[X²]−(E[X])² 是方差，因此 Jensen 也解释了为什么平均误差的平方可能远低于逐项误差平方的平均。For values one and three with equal weights, the mean is two, its square four, and the average square five. The gap measures variability. In general E[X²]−(E[X])² is variance, explaining why squaring an averaged error can hide individual variation.

权重必须非负且总和为 1，所有点应在凸定义域中。随机变量版本 f(E X)≤E f(X) 还需期望有意义；不能把发散表达式当成普通实数计算。有限组合版本已足够处理作业 4(c)。Weights must be nonnegative and sum to one, and all points lie in the convex domain. The expectation version additionally requires meaningful expectations; divergent expressions cannot be manipulated as ordinary real numbers. The finite version suffices for HW1 4(c).

作业知识检查点：到这里已经讲齐作业 1–5 所需的基础，包括二次对偶范数、诱导范数、log-sum-exp、三个凸集合、三个一元函数与最小二乘凸性、Jensen、二阶锥正常性/自对偶/传递性。先尝试独立写作业，再回到各节核对条件。第五讲仍有完整课程内容，不能因作业覆盖完成而跳过。Homework checkpoint: the prerequisites for HW1 1–5 have now appeared: quadratic dual norms, induced norms, log-sum-exp, three convex sets, scalar and least-squares convexity, Jensen, and SOC properness, self-duality and transitivity. Attempt the homework independently and revisit assumptions afterward. Lecture 5 remains part of the course despite this coverage checkpoint.

掌握Mastery

作业 4(c) 用归纳。两点情形就是定义。设 k−1 点结论成立，记 α=Σᵢ₌₁ᵏ⁻¹θᵢ。如果 α=0，只有最后一点有非零权重，直接取等。如果 α>0，把前 k−1 项归一化为 θᵢ/α，先用归纳结论，再用两点凸性混合“前面均值”和 xₖ，得到所需结论。这也覆盖 θₖ=0 的端点。For 4(c), use induction. Two points are the definition. Let α be the total weight of the first k−1 points. If α=0 only the last point remains. Otherwise normalize the earlier weights by α, apply induction, then mix their average with xₖ using the two-point definition. This includes the endpoint θₖ=0.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

权重 (1/4,3/4)、数据 (0,4)，计算平方函数的 Jensen 两边。Compute both sides for the square function with weights (1/4,3/4) and data (0,4).

展开核对Check the answer

均值为 3，左边 9；右边 (1/4)0²+(3/4)4²=12，差为 3。The mean is three, giving nine on the left and twelve on the right, with gap three.

深入In depth

严格凸时，正权重点若并非全部相同，有限 Jensen 为严格不等式；零权重点不影响等号条件。凹函数把不等号方向反转，例如 log(E X)≥E log X 对正随机变量成立。For strict convexity, finite Jensen is strict unless all positively weighted points coincide. Zero-weight points do not affect equality. Concavity reverses the inequality, as in log(E X)≥E log X for suitable positive random variables.

核对原课件 · 33-34Check original slides · 33-34

37 · 非负加权和与仿射复合37 · Nonnegative sums and affine composition

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.36-38 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.1–3.2.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：逐条检查权重符号与复合的维数、定义域。Learning goal: explain nonnegative sums and affine composition and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸函数的非负加权和仍凸，仿射复合仍凸；负系数可能破坏结论。Nonnegative weighted sums and affine compositions preserve convexity; negative coefficients may invalidate the conclusion.

了解Understand

若每个惩罚项都凸，可以把它们用非负权重组合成综合费用。例如 ‖Ax−b‖²+λ‖x‖₁，λ≥0，把拟合误差与参数大小相加。共同定义域是各项定义域的交，仍需凸且允许求值。权重越大，该项在目标中越重要。Nonnegative weights combine convex penalties into a total cost. For example ‖Ax−b‖²+λ‖x‖₁ with λ≥0 balances fit and parameter size. Its common domain is the intersection of the component domains and must permit evaluation. Increasing a weight increases that penalty’s influence.

仿射复合表示先改变坐标再计费。f(z)=‖z‖₂ 凸，所以 ‖Ax+b‖₂ 凸，即使 A 不可逆或非方阵也成立。仿射变换精确保留混合关系，f 的凸性可直接作用于混合后的两个输出。Affine composition changes coordinates before measuring cost. Since the Euclidean norm is convex, ‖Ax+b‖₂ is convex even for singular or rectangular A. Affine maps preserve mixtures exactly, allowing the outer convexity inequality to apply directly.

负权重不能直接沿用这条规则：−x² 是凹函数。若某项本来仿射，它乘负系数仍仿射，所以“非负”是一般凸项的充分条件。应用规则时应说明每项性质，不把所有代数加法都视作保持凸性。Negative weights are unsafe for general convex terms: −x² is concave. An affine term remains affine with a negative coefficient, so nonnegativity is a sufficient condition for arbitrary convex terms. State each component’s property rather than treating every sum as automatically convex.

掌握Mastery

将每个 fᵢ 的凸性不等式乘 αᵢ≥0，再相加，不等号方向保持。仿射复合用 A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b)，代入 f 的凸性即可。内层原像域也凸，由第 23 节保证。Multiply each convexity inequality by αᵢ≥0 and add without reversing signs. For affine composition, use A(θx+(1−θ)y)+b=θ(Ax+b)+(1−θ)(Ay+b) and apply f. Section 23 gives convexity of the preimage domain.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=(2x−1)²+3|x| 是否凸？用规则说明。Is (2x−1)²+3|x| convex? Explain using rules.

展开核对Check the answer

平方的仿射复合凸，绝对值凸，非负加权和凸。The affine composition of a square is convex, absolute value is convex, and their nonnegative weighted sum is convex.

深入In depth

参数 λ 是模型数据时这条规则直接成立。若把 λ 和 x 同时作为变量，λ‖x‖ 通常不联合凸；对“固定参数凸”与“所有变量联合凸”要分开判断。The rule applies when λ is model data. If λ and x are both variables, λ‖x‖ is generally not jointly convex. Distinguish convexity for fixed parameters from joint convexity.

核对原课件 · 36-38Check original slides · 36-38

38 · 逐点最大、上确界与支撑函数38 · Pointwise maxima, suprema and support functions

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.39-44 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：读 max 与 sup；解释最大特征值凸性和仿射下界表示。Learning goal: explain pointwise maxima, suprema and support functions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

凸函数族的逐点最大值或上确界仍凸，即使函数族无限；其有限值定义域需说明。Pointwise maxima or suprema of convex functions are convex, including infinite families, with the finite domain specified.

了解Understand

“逐点”指固定同一个 x，再比较多个函数值。max(x²,(x−2)²) 在 x<1 时第二项主导，x>1 时第一项主导，x=1 处切换。最大值函数可以在切换点不可微，但凸性不需要可微。这正是最坏情形设计常出现的形状。Pointwise means fixing the same x before comparing values. In max(x²,(x−2)²), the second term dominates for x<1, the first for x>1, and they switch at one. The maximum may be nondifferentiable there, but convexity does not require differentiability. Such shapes occur in worst-case design.

支撑函数 hC(z) 在每个方向 z 求集合中线性响应的上确界。对固定 x，z↦zᵀx 仿射，所以上确界对 z 凸，甚至不要求 C 凸。单位球的支撑函数就是对偶范数。对称矩阵的最大特征值也可写成 λmax(X)=sup‖v‖=1 vᵀXv，每个 v 对 X 给出线性函数，所以 λmax 凸。The support function optimizes linear response in each direction z. For fixed x, zᵀx is affine in z, so the supremum is convex even if C is not. Norm-ball support is a dual norm. Likewise λmax(X)=sup‖v‖=1 vᵀXv is convex in symmetric X because each fixed v gives a linear function.

最小值一般不保持凸性。min((x−1)²,(x+1)²) 在 ±1 都取零，在中点 0 取 1，违反凸性。不要把 max 与 min 的保持规则对称记忆；它们的几何操作不同。Minima generally fail: min((x−1)²,(x+1)²) is zero at ±1 but one at their midpoint, violating convexity. Maximum and minimum operations have different geometry and should not be memorized as symmetric rules.

掌握Mastery

对任意 α，fα(θx+(1−θ)y)≤θfα(x)+(1−θ)fα(y)≤θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y)。右侧不依赖 α，再对 α 取上确界，得 g 的凸性。或者上图集 epi g=∩α epi fα，是凸集的交。两种证明都允许无限函数族。For each α, bound fα at the mixture by its endpoint average and then by θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y). Taking the supremum over α proves convexity. Alternatively epi g=∩α epi fα is an intersection of convex sets. Both arguments allow infinite families.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

C=[−2,3] 的支撑函数是什么？Find the support function of C=[−2,3].

展开核对Check the answer

z≥0 时取 x=3，值为 3z；z<0 时取 x=−2，值为 −2z，即 max(3z,−2z)。For z≥0 choose three, giving 3z; for z<0 choose −2, giving −2z. Thus hC(z)=max(3z,−2z).

深入In depth

闭凸集合由全部支撑半空间重建：C={x:zᵀx≤hC(z) 对所有 z}，非空闭凸条件由分离定理提供反向包含。这说明支撑函数完整编码凸集合。A nonempty closed convex set is reconstructed by all its support inequalities, C={x:zᵀx≤hC(z) for every z}; separation gives the reverse inclusion. Thus support functions encode closed convex sets completely.

核对原课件 · 39-44Check original slides · 39-44

39 · 标量与向量复合规则39 · Composition rules and their domain conditions

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.45-55 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：同时检查外函数凸性、单调性和扩展值定义域。Learning goal: explain composition rules and their domain conditions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

外层凸且非减、内层凸时复合凸；外层凸且非增、内层凹时也凸。多变量外层逐坐标检查单调方向。Convex nondecreasing outer functions compose with convex inner functions; convex nonincreasing outer functions compose with concave inner functions. For vector inners, check each coordinate.

了解Understand

先理解规则为什么需要单调性。内层凸给 g(混合点)≤混合后的 g 值；外层非减才能保持这个比较方向。然后外层自己的凸性再次给上界。若外层下降，第一步的方向会翻转，因此要把内层改成凹函数。Monotonicity is needed because convex g gives an upper bound at a mixture. A nondecreasing outer function preserves that comparison before its own convexity gives the second bound. A decreasing outer function reverses the first step, so a concave inner function is needed instead.

例如 exp(‖x‖₂) 凸：范数凸，exp 凸且非减。−log g(x) 在正的凹函数 g 上凸：−log 凸且非增。平方函数并不在整个 R 上非减，但在非负区域上非减，所以 ‖x‖² 凸可以合法应用这一受限规则。反例 (x²−1)² 则暴露“凸套凸”不够。Examples: exp(‖x‖₂) is convex because exp is convex and increasing. For positive concave g, −log g is convex because −log is convex and decreasing. A square is increasing only on nonnegative inputs, allowing ‖x‖², but (x²−1)² shows that convex-after-convex alone is insufficient.

定义域必须同时兼容。教材用扩展值外层来检查整体单调性，防止内层凸比较产生的中间值走出允许范围。多变量 h(g₁,…,gₖ) 中，每个外层非减坐标配凸内层，每个非增坐标配凹内层；若某坐标内层仿射，两个比较方向都可使用。Domain compatibility is essential. The textbook uses extended-value outer functions to ensure monotonicity remains valid when intermediate values arise. For h(g₁,…,gₖ), pair nondecreasing coordinates with convex inners and nonincreasing coordinates with concave inners; affine inners work in either direction.

其余课件组合例子也按两步规则判断：正凹 g 的 log g 凹、1/g 凸；非负凸 g 的 gᵖ 在 p≥1 时凸；正凸 g 的倒数没有一般保证。对非负凸分量 gᵢ，(Σgᵢᵖ)^(1/p) 在 p≥1 时凸。对非负凹分量，在 0<p≤1 时该表达式凹；p=0 的展示公式不能直接代入，应另用归一化幂平均的极限解释。Other slide compositions follow the same two-step rule: for positive concave g, log g is concave and 1/g convex; for nonnegative convex g, gᵖ is convex when p≥1. A reciprocal of positive convex g has no general guarantee. Nonnegative convex components give a convex p-aggregation for p≥1; nonnegative concave components give a concave aggregation for 0<p≤1. The displayed formula cannot be directly evaluated at p=0; a normalized power-mean limit needs separate treatment.

掌握Mastery

标量证明写出两步：h(g(θx+(1−θ)y))≤h(θg(x)+(1−θ)g(y))≤θh(g(x))+(1−θ)h(g(y))。第一步用内层凸与外层非减，第二步用外层凸。光滑版本有 f″=h″(g)(g′)²+h′(g)g″，同样显示符号要求；但定义证明还覆盖不可微情形。Write both bounds explicitly. The first uses inner convexity and outer nondecreasing behavior; the second uses outer convexity. In the smooth scalar case, f″=h″(g)(g′)²+h′(g)g″ shows the same sign requirements, but the definition proof also handles nondifferentiability.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

−log(1−x²) 在 −1<x<1 是否凸？Is −log(1−x²) convex on −1<x<1?

展开核对Check the answer

内层 1−x² 为正且凹，外层 −log 凸且非增，因此凸；定义域区间也凸。The inner function is positive and concave, and −log is convex and decreasing. The interval domain is convex, so the composition is convex.

深入In depth

log-sum-exp 的外层对每个坐标非减且联合凸，故 log Σexp(gᵢ(x)) 在全部 gᵢ 凸时凸。max 外层也逐坐标非减，恢复第 38 节规则。Log-sum-exp is jointly convex and nondecreasing in each input, so log Σexp(gᵢ(x)) is convex when every gᵢ is convex. The maximum outer function is also coordinatewise nondecreasing, recovering Section 38.

核对原课件 · 45-55Check original slides · 45-55

40 · 部分最小化与函数透视40 · Partial minimization and function perspective

Lecture 4 · PDF pp.56-63 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.2.5–3.2.6 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：区分联合凸与分别凸；追踪 t>0；解释距离函数与二次透视。Learning goal: explain and function perspective and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

联合凸函数对部分变量取下确界仍凸，需凸的共同约束；凸函数的透视 t f(x/t) 在 t>0 上联合凸。Partial infima of jointly convex functions over convex common constraints are convex. The perspective t f(x/t) is jointly convex for t>0.

了解Understand

表示保留决策 x，允许另一个决策 y 先被最佳调整。例如 f(x,y)=(x−y)²+y²，固定 x 对 y 求导得 y*=x/2，代回 g(x)=x²/2，仍凸。它常表示隐藏变量已经被消元后的有效费用。必须要求 f 对 (x,y) 联合凸，分别凸还不够。Partial minimization keeps x while adjusting y optimally. For (x−y)²+y², fixing x gives y*=x/2 and g(x)=x²/2, still convex. This models effective cost after eliminating a hidden decision. Joint convexity is essential; separate convexity alone is insufficient.

函数透视与第 24 节的集合透视相关，但公式多一个 t。若 f(u)=u²，透视为 x²/t，正好恢复二次除以线性。若 f(u)=−log u，透视为 −t log(x/t)，可用于相对熵表达。t 像总规模，x/t 像单位规模状态，t f(x/t) 是总费用。Function perspective relates to the set perspective but includes a factor t. For f(u)=u² it gives x²/t; for f(u)=−log u it gives −t log(x/t), useful in relative-entropy expressions. Interpret t as scale, x/t as per-unit state, and t f(x/t) as total cost.

例如同样误差 x 分配给更长的时间 t，平方能量费用 x²/t 会降低；将两项任务一起混合，其费用不超过各自费用的加权平均。这个直觉提供建模意义，凸性仍由下面的权重计算严格保证。For the same deviation x spread over longer time t, quadratic energy x²/t decreases. Mixing two tasks costs no more than their weighted average. This gives modeling intuition; the weight calculation below supplies the proof.

到非空凸集 S 的距离 dist(x,S)=infᵧ∈S‖x−y‖ 凸，因为内层对 (x,y) 联合凸；不要求最近点取得。到集合的最远距离 supᵧ∈S‖x−y‖ 也凸，甚至不要求 S 凸，但可能为 +∞。若 h 凸，g(x)=inf{h(y):Ay=x} 也凸，把仿射关系 Ay−x=0 作为联合约束即可。Distance to a nonempty convex set, infᵧ∈S‖x−y‖, is convex by joint convexity and partial minimization, even without attainment. Farthest distance supᵧ∈S‖x−y‖ is convex even for nonconvex S, but may be +∞. If h is convex, inf{h(y):Ay=x} is convex by treating Ay−x=0 as a joint affine constraint.

掌握Mastery

部分最小化不假定最优 y 一定存在。对 x₁、x₂，选 ε-近似最优 y₁、y₂，使 f(xᵢ,yᵢ)≤g(xᵢ)+ε。混合 y 可行，联合凸性给 g(混合 x)≤混合 g 值+ε；令 ε↓0。透视证明令 T=θt₁+(1−θ)t₂，α=θt₁/T，写混合 x/T=αx₁/t₁+(1−α)x₂/t₂，再用 f 凸并乘 T。这里 t₁,t₂>0 保证所有除法合法。No minimizing y need exist: choose ε-optimal y₁,y₂, mix them feasibly, apply joint convexity and let ε↓0. For perspective set T=θt₁+(1−θ)t₂ and α=θt₁/T. The normalized mixed x is αx₁/t₁+(1−α)x₂/t₂. Apply convexity and multiply by T; positive t values validate the divisions.

课件的分块二次型若 [[A,B],[Bᵀ,C]]⪰0，则对 y 消元得到 xᵀ(A−BC†Bᵀ)x。半正定条件已经蕴含 B 的相容值域条件，所以可以用伪逆 C†。C≻0 时直接配方：最优 y=−C⁻¹Bᵀx。欧氏平方的透视再与仿射式复合，得到 ‖Ax+b‖₂²/(cᵀx+d) 在正分母域上凸；整个分式的分子、分母必须一并进入透视规则。For a PSD block quadratic [[A,B],[Bᵀ,C]], eliminating y gives xᵀ(A−BC†Bᵀ)x. PSD already entails the needed range compatibility, permitting C†. For C≻0, completion of squares gives y*=−C⁻¹Bᵀx. Composing the squared-norm perspective with affine inputs proves ‖Ax+b‖₂²/(cᵀx+d) convex on the positive-denominator domain.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x,y)=(x−y)²+4y² 对 y 消元，得到什么凸函数？Eliminate y from (x−y)²+4y².

展开核对Check the answer

导数为 −2x+10y，故 y*=x/5，代回为 4x²/5。The derivative is −2x+10y, giving y*=x/5 and minimum 4x²/5.

深入In depth

若下确界为 −∞，需用扩展值讨论，不能把它当作普通有限函数。实际建模中常另查下界与存在性；透视在 t=0 的闭扩展也需要极限分析。If an infimum is −∞, extended-value treatment is required rather than ordinary finite-function algebra. Modeling often separately checks boundedness and attainment. Closing a perspective at t=0 also requires limit analysis.

核对原课件 · 56-63Check original slides · 56-63

LECTURE 05

共轭与广义凸性Conjugacy and generalized convexity

41 · 共轭函数的定义与几何41 · Conjugate functions: describe a curve by slopes

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.4-5 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：把共轭看成最紧仿射下界的截距；解释上确界和有效域。Learning goal: explain conjugate functions: describe a curve by slopes and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

共轭函数固定线性斜率 y，求 yᵀx−f(x) 的最大间隙；即使 f 不凸，f* 也凸。The conjugate fixes a slope y and maximizes yᵀx−f(x). Even when f is not convex, f* is convex.

了解Understand

为什么想到用共轭描述函数？凸函数能由它的仿射下界刻画。固定斜率 y，寻找一条不越过 f 的最高直线 yᵀx−c。它必须满足 c≥yᵀx−f(x) 对全部 x 成立，因此最小可行 c 就是 f*(y)。共轭把原来的“输入位置”描述转成“支撑斜率”描述。Why describe a function by conjugacy? A convex function can be characterized by affine lower bounds. Fix slope y and seek the highest line yᵀx−c below f. We need c≥yᵀx−f(x) for every x, so the smallest valid c is f*(y). Conjugacy changes from an input-location description to a supporting-slope description.

例子 f(x)=x²/2。对固定 y，yx−x²/2=−(x−y)²/2+y²/2，在 x=y 取得最大值 y²/2。斜率 y=2 对应支撑线 2x−2，接触点 x=2。图中把斜率逐渐改变，观察切点移动和截距变化：共轭记录的是这些线的截距成本。For f(x)=x²/2, complete the square: yx−x²/2=−(x−y)²/2+y²/2, maximized at x=y. Slope two gives support 2x−2 touching at x=2. Changing slope moves contact and intercept; the conjugate records the intercept cost of each supporting line.

对每个固定 x，yᵀx−f(x) 对 y 仿射，所以 f* 是仿射函数族的上确界，必凸。共轭可能取 +∞，这表示该斜率的线性收益可以超过函数惩罚而无限增长。星号没有表示普通倒数，也没有保证每个 y 都有最大化点。For fixed x, yᵀx−f(x) is affine in y, so its supremum f* is convex. A value +∞ means linear reward can overwhelm the penalty without bound. The star is not a reciprocal, and a maximizing point need not exist for every y.

掌握Mastery

从定义直接得到 yᵀx−f(x)≤f*(y)，移项得到仿射下界 f(x)≥yᵀx−f*(y)。若可微凸 f 的某点满足 ∇f(x*)=y，一阶下界保证 x* 最大化 yᵀx−f(x)，所以 f*(y)=yᵀx*−f(x*)。先证明最优性，再代回数值，避免只求驻点就下结论。The definition gives yᵀx−f(x)≤f*(y), hence the affine lower bound. If differentiable convex f satisfies ∇f(x*)=y, its first-order bound proves x* maximizes yᵀx−f(x), giving f*(y)=yᵀx*−f(x*). Establish optimality before substituting a stationary point.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x²，求 f*(y) 并写出斜率 y=4 的支撑线。For f(x)=x², find f*(y) and the support with slope four.

展开核对Check the answer

最大化点为 x=y/2，共轭为 y²/4；斜率 4 时支撑线为 4x−4，接触 x=2。The maximizing point is y/2, giving f*(y)=y²/4. Slope four gives 4x−4, touching at x=2.

深入In depth

可微严格凸函数有时可通过梯度反演把位置与斜率互换；这与 Legendre 变换相关。本讲使用 Fenchel 的上确界定义，能同时处理不可微、受限定义域与无限值，不需假定梯度处处可逆。For some smooth strictly convex functions, gradient inversion exchanges location and slope, related to the Legendre transform. This lecture uses the supremum-based Fenchel definition, also handling nondifferentiability, restricted domains and infinite values without assuming an invertible gradient everywhere.

核对原课件 · 4-5Check original slides · 4-5

42 · 共轭函数的典型计算42 · Compute conjugates, including boundary cases

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.6-11 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：算仿射、负对数、指数、负熵、倒数、严格凸二次函数、负 log-det、示性/支撑函数与范数及范数平方的共轭；每例先检查定义域。Learning goal: explain compute conjugates, including boundary cases and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

共轭计算先查定义域，再求候选点、验证最大值，并单独检查端点与无界情形。Compute conjugates by checking domains, identifying candidates, verifying maximality and separately handling boundaries and unbounded cases.

了解Understand

计算统一从 supₓ(yᵀx−f(x)) 出发。对 f(x)=ax+b，若 y=a，目标恒为 −b；若 y≠a，沿适当方向令 x→±∞，目标无界，故共轭为 +∞。这个例子说明共轭的定义域可能只有一个点。对 −log x、x>0，目标为 yx+log x：y<0 时驻点 x=−1/y，值为 −1−log(−y)；y≥0 时令 x→∞，得到 +∞。Always start from supₓ(yᵀx−f(x)). For ax+b, y=a gives constant −b; otherwise choose the direction x→±∞ to obtain +∞, so the conjugate domain may be a single point. For −log x on x>0, yx+log x is maximized at x=−1/y for y<0, with value −1−log(−y). For y≥0 it diverges as x→∞.

指数函数 eˣ 的共轭在 y>0 时为 y log y−y，取 x=log y；y=0 时下限方向 x→−∞ 给上确界 0，却不取得；y<0 时同一方向令 yx→+∞。负熵 x log x、x≥0 并约定 0 log0=0，其共轭为 exp(y−1)，取 x=exp(y−1)>0。两者互相关联，但指数共轭的端点必须补上。For eˣ, positive y gives y log y−y at x=log y. At y=0 the supremum zero is approached as x→−∞ without attainment; y<0 gives unbounded reward in that direction. Negative entropy x log x on x≥0, with 0 log0=0, has conjugate exp(y−1), attained at positive x. The connection does not remove the exponential conjugate’s boundary case.

正倒数 f(x)=1/x、x>0，目标 yx−1/x：y<0 时 x=1/√(−y)，值为 −2√(−y)；y=0 时上确界为 0，不取得；y>0 时 +∞。课件这里是正倒数。对于正定二次函数，配方给共轭二次型里的权重 P⁻¹，和二次对偶范数的权重反转呼应。For the positive reciprocal 1/x on x>0, y<0 gives x=1/√(−y) and value −2√(−y). At zero the unattained supremum is zero; positive y gives +∞. This slide concerns a positive reciprocal. Positive definite quadratic conjugates invert P, echoing the weight reversal in quadratic dual norms.

矩阵 f(X)=−log det X、X≻0，迹内积下只有 Y≺0 时共轭有限，为 −n−log det(−Y)，最大化点 X=−Y⁻¹。集合示性函数 δC 的共轭是支撑函数 hC；闭凸非空 C 的支撑函数共轭回到 δC。一般非凸 C 会先被闭凸化，不能直接声称回到原集合。For −log det X on X≻0 under trace pairing, the conjugate is finite only for Y≺0: −n−log det(−Y), attained at X=−Y⁻¹. An indicator δC conjugates to support hC; for nonempty closed convex C, support conjugates back to δC. A general nonconvex set is instead closed-convexified.

范数 ‖x‖ 的共轭是对偶单位球的示性函数；½‖x‖² 的共轭是 ½‖y‖*²。前者的线性惩罚可被足够大斜率冲破，后者的平方惩罚最终增长更快，所以每个有限 y 都有有限共轭。下面给出从对偶定义出发的完整论证。A norm conjugates to the indicator of the dual unit ball; half its square conjugates to half the squared dual norm. Linear penalties can be overwhelmed by large slopes, whereas quadratic growth eventually dominates, giving a finite conjugate for every finite y. The proof below derives this from duality.

掌握Mastery

令 d=‖y‖*。内积界给 yᵀx−½‖x‖²≤d r−r²/2，其中 r=‖x‖≥0；配方得最大值 d²/2，在 r=d 取得。y≠0 时选 ‖u‖=1、yᵀu=d（有限维单位球紧致），再取 x=du，达到全部上界；y=0 时取 x=0。对范数本身，d≤1 时目标≤0 且 x=0 取等；d>1 时同一单位方向 u 上令 x=tu，目标 t(d−1)→∞。Let d=‖y‖*. The inner-product bound gives yᵀx−½‖x‖²≤dr−r²/2 for r=‖x‖≥0, bounded by d²/2 at r=d. For nonzero y choose unit u attaining yᵀu=d and x=du; for y=0 choose zero. For the unsquared norm, d≤1 gives maximum zero at x=0; d>1 gives unbounded t(d−1) along x=tu.

矩阵负 logdet 的候选点由 Y+X⁻¹=0 得到。Y 有正特征方向时沿该方向增大 X 使线性项无界；有零特征方向时增大 X 使 logdet 无界。Y≺0 时目标严格凹，候选点全局最优。For negative logdet, stationarity gives Y+X⁻¹=0. A positive eigenvalue of Y permits unbounded linear growth; a zero eigenvalue permits unbounded logdet growth. For Y≺0 the objective is strictly concave and the candidate is globally optimal.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=2x² 的共轭是什么？eˣ 在 y=0 的共轭是否有最大化点？Find the conjugate of 2x². Does the conjugate of eˣ at y=0 have a maximizing point?

展开核对Check the answer

前者驻点 x=y/4，值 y²/8。后者值为 0，但任何有限 x 都使 −eˣ<0，因此不取得。The first gives x=y/4 and value y²/8. The second has value zero, unattained because −eˣ<0 at every finite x.

深入In depth

共轭表用于后续对偶问题与近端算法，但记表前应能重建至少一个计算。维度、½ 系数、定义域和端点是最常见错误来源；每次都从定义检查一次。Conjugate tables support later dual problems and proximal algorithms. Before memorizing them, reconstruct at least one derivation. Dimensions, factors of one half, domains and endpoints are common sources of error; check them against the definition.

核对原课件 · 6-11Check original slides · 6-11

43 · Fenchel 不等式与变换规则43 · Fenchel’s inequality and conjugate transformations

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.12-14 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.3.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：由定义推 ；解释可微取等和变换的前提。Learning goal: explain fenchel’s inequality and conjugate transformations and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

Fenchel 不等式是 f(x)+f*(y)≥yᵀx；闭、真凸函数满足 f**=f。Fenchel’s inequality is f(x)+f*(y)≥yᵀx. Closed proper convex functions satisfy f**=f.

了解Understand

Fenchel 不等式直接来自上确界定义：f*(y) 至少不小于在当前 x 处的目标 yᵀx−f(x)。它把两个函数值合成对内积的界。平方函数对应的情形给 ½‖x‖²+½‖y‖²≥yᵀx，正是 ‖x−y‖²≥0。Fenchel’s inequality follows because the supremum f*(y) is at least its value at the chosen x. It bounds the inner product by two function values. For Euclidean quadratic conjugates it says ½‖x‖²+½‖y‖²≥yᵀx, equivalent to ‖x−y‖²≥0.

等号恰好表示当前 x 已最大化共轭定义中的目标。可微凸时条件为 y=∇f(x)；一般凸时为 y∈∂f(x)。双共轭把所有仿射下界取上确界，闭凸函数由这些下界恢复。若 f 不闭或不凸，一般只能得到 f**≤f，恢复的对象是适当的闭凸包。Equality means the chosen x maximizes the conjugate objective. For differentiable convex f this is y=∇f(x); generally it is y∈∂f(x). The biconjugate takes the supremum of affine lower bounds and recovers closed proper convex f. Without those conditions, one generally gets f**≤f and an appropriate closed convex envelope.

变换规则可以减少重复计算。若 g(x)=f(Ax+b)，A 是 n×n 可逆矩阵，令 u=Ax+b，可得 g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)−yᵀA⁻¹b。若 g(x)=f₁(x₁)+f₂(x₂)，两变量独立，上确界可分开，g*(y₁,y₂)=f₁*(y₁)+f₂*(y₂)。这条独立变量规则不能当成同一变量上的和直接拆分。Transformation rules reduce repeated work. For g(x)=f(Ax+b) with invertible square A, substituting u=Ax+b gives g*(y)=f*(A⁻ᵀy)−yᵀA⁻¹b. If g uses independent variables f₁(x₁)+f₂(x₂), its conjugate separates into f₁*(y₁)+f₂*(y₂). A sum sharing the same variable does not split this way.

掌握Mastery

缩放规则把 supₓ(yᵀx−af(x)) 写成 a supₓ((y/a)ᵀx−f(x))，a>0 才能把上确界保持为上确界。仿射变换代入 x=A⁻¹(u−b)，分离出常数 −yᵀA⁻¹b，剩余斜率为 A⁻ᵀy。独立变量分别选近似最大化点，可证明联合上确界等于两者之和。For positive a, factor a outside the supremum to obtain the scaling rule; negative scaling would reverse maximization. Substitute x=A⁻¹(u−b) for the affine rule, separating the constant and transformed slope. Independent near-maximizers establish separation of the independent-variable supremum.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

g(x)=½(x−2)²，求共轭，并检查 Fenchel 等号条件。Find the conjugate of ½(x−2)² and its Fenchel equality condition.

展开核对Check the answer

令 u=x−2，得到 g*(y)=½y²+2y。等号条件为 y=x−2。Set u=x−2 to get g*(y)=½y²+2y. Equality holds when y=x−2.

深入In depth

“真”指函数不取 −∞ 且不恒为 +∞，“闭”在这里指上图集闭或等价的下半连续性。双共轭定理依赖这些条件；涉及历史人物的名称只帮助识别理论，不代替定理前提。Proper means never −∞ and not identically +∞; closed here means a closed epigraph, or lower semicontinuity. The biconjugate theorem needs these assumptions. Named terminology identifies theory without replacing its hypotheses.

44 · 拟凸函数与保拟凸运算44 · Quasiconvexity: convex acceptability regions

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.16-25 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.4 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：用下水平集判断；辨析一阶必要条件与充分条件的假设。Learning goal: explain quasiconvexity: convex acceptability regions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

拟凸要求每个次水平集凸，等价于混合点函数值不超过两端最大值。Quasiconvexity requires convex sublevel sets, equivalently a mixture value no greater than the larger endpoint value.

了解Understand

凸性比较加权平均，拟凸只比较两端较大值，所以它弱一些。单调递增的一元函数都拟凸，因为每个次水平集是左侧区间；x³ 是例子。拟凹要求超水平集凸，同时拟凸拟凹的函数称拟线性。定义域仍应凸。Convexity compares against a weighted average; quasiconvexity compares only against the larger endpoint and is weaker. Every increasing scalar function is quasiconvex since its sublevels are left intervals, such as x³. Quasiconcavity uses superlevels; having both is quasilinearity. The domain remains convex.

正分母线性分式 f(x)=(aᵀx+b)/(cᵀx+d) 是典型拟线性函数。固定门槛 α，f(x)≤α 等价于 (a−αc)ᵀx≤αd−b，再与正分母半空间相交，次水平集凸。这里 α 固定；若同时优化 α 与 x，乘积 αcᵀx 不能当成仿射。A linear-fractional function with positive denominator is quasilinear. Fixing α, its sublevel inequality becomes (a−αc)ᵀx≤αd−b, intersected with the positive-denominator halfspace. This is convex. The threshold is fixed; varying α and x jointly introduces the product αcᵀx.

可微拟凸函数在 f(y)≤f(x) 时满足 ∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0：朝向一个不更差的点，起步不能向上。二阶必要条件只约束与梯度正交的方向：vᵀ∇²f(x)v≥0 对满足 ∇f(x)ᵀv=0 的 v 成立。它们不能随便升级成无条件充要判据。A differentiable quasiconvex function satisfies ∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0 when f(y)≤f(x): movement toward a no-worse point cannot initially ascend. A second-order necessary condition requires nonnegative curvature only in directions orthogonal to the gradient. These must not be promoted to unconditional sufficient tests.

拟凸优化常用门槛二分：问是否存在 f(x)≤α 的可行点。门槛低时可能不可行，高时可行；每次解一个凸可行性问题，逐步缩小最优值区间。这需要有限的初始上下界和可靠的可行性判断。拟凸函数的驻点不一定最优：x³ 在 0 的导数为零。Quasiconvex optimization often bisects a threshold, asking whether any feasible x satisfies f(x)≤α. Each test is a convex feasibility problem, narrowing an initially bounded value interval. Reliable feasibility decisions are needed. Stationarity alone is insufficient: x³ has zero derivative at zero.

补齐课件例子：log x 在 x>0 上凹且拟线性；取整上界函数 ceil(x) 虽然不连续，仍单调，所以拟线性。一元连续拟凸函数的形状是单调，或先非增后非减的单谷形；检验多变量拟凸性也可逐条线检查，前提是整体定义域凸。Additional slide examples: log x on x>0 is concave and quasilinear. The ceiling function is discontinuous but monotone, hence quasilinear. Continuous scalar quasiconvex functions are monotone or decrease then increase, forming one valley. Multivariate quasiconvexity can be checked on line restrictions, with a convex overall domain.

在凸的开放定义域上，可微拟凸的一阶条件“f(y)≤f(x)⇒∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0”实际是充要条件。关键是对每一对 x、y 检查，某一点的梯度为零只让这个点的测试变成 0≤0。二阶非负条件一般只必要；若每个非零梯度正交方向都满足严格正曲率，则为拟凸的充分条件。尤其在一维梯度为零处要检查二阶导数严格为正，x³ 的零点不满足它。On an open convex domain, the differentiable condition f(y)≤f(x)⇒∇f(x)ᵀ(y−x)≤0 is necessary and sufficient. It must hold for every pair; a zero gradient at one point merely makes that point’s test 0≤0. The nonnegative second-order test is generally only necessary. Strictly positive curvature in every nonzero gradient-orthogonal direction is sufficient. At a one-dimensional stationary point this demands positive second derivative, which x³ at zero fails.

拟凸保持规则还包括仿射复合、正分母线性分式复合，以及联合拟凸函数在凸约束下的部分最小化。部分最小化可选任意高于下确界的共同门槛，再用近似可行点证明。若内层只对各变量分别拟凸，联合结论没有保证。Further preservation rules include affine and positive-denominator linear-fractional composition, and partial minimization of jointly quasiconvex functions over convex constraints. For the infimum, choose a common threshold above both endpoint infima, use approximate feasible points, then pass to the limiting threshold. Separate quasiconvexity does not suffice.

掌握Mastery

等价性：若次水平集凸，令 α=max(f(x),f(y))，两端都在该次水平集内，混合点也在，得到定义。反过来若混合值不超过端点最大值，两端都≤α 就推出混合值≤α。拟凸函数的逐点上确界仍拟凸，因为次水平集是各项次水平集的交；非减复合也保持拟凸，非负加法一般没有保证。For equivalence, put α=max(f(x),f(y)) and apply convexity of that sublevel. Conversely, endpoints below α give a mixture below α. Pointwise suprema remain quasiconvex because sublevels intersect. Nondecreasing composition also preserves quasiconvexity, while nonnegative addition generally does not.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x³ 的次水平集是什么？它为何拟线性却不凸？What are the sublevels of x³, and why is it quasilinear but not convex?

展开核对Check the answer

次水平集是 x≤α^(1/3)，超水平集也是半轴，均凸；但负 x 处二阶导数为负。Sublevels are x≤α^(1/3), and superlevels are opposite halflines, all convex. Negative x has negative second derivative.

深入In depth

极小化凸函数的全局保证不能全部照搬到拟凸函数。非严格的平坦区域可能产生非全局局部极小点；严格下降方向和最优性条件还需更多假设。Convex global guarantees do not all transfer to quasiconvexity. Flat regions can create nonglobal local minima; stronger descent and optimality claims need additional assumptions.

核对原课件 · 16-25Check original slides · 16-25

45 · 对数凸与对数凹45 · Log-convex and log-concave functions

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.27-29 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.5 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：先检查正性，再取对数；比较与普通凸凹的关系。Learning goal: explain and log-concave functions and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

正函数表示 log f 凸；对数凹表示 log f 凹。它们把乘法结构变成加法结构。A positive function is log-convex or when its logarithm is convex or concave. Logarithms convert multiplicative structure to addition.

了解Understand

若费用随变量乘法变化，直接相加的凸性未必最自然。对数凸把平均值比较换成加权几何平均。eˣ 的对数是 x，故它既对数凸又；正仿射函数 aᵀx+b 的对数凹，在它为正的域上可由二阶导数或 log 的凹复合规则证明。Multiplicative variation is often more naturally described by logarithms. Log-convexity compares against a weighted geometric mean. Since log eˣ=x, eˣ is both log-convex and log-concave. A positive affine function is log-concave on its positive domain, using curvature or concave composition with log.

高斯形状 f(x)=exp(−x²/2) 对数为 −x²/2，所以对数凹，但 f 本身并不在整个 R 上凹。其超水平集为中心区间，说明对数凹蕴含拟凹。对数凸函数则一定凸：先用几何平均界，再用加权算术—几何平均不等式。The Gaussian-shaped exp(−x²/2) has concave logarithm −x²/2 but is not itself globally concave. Its superlevel sets are centered intervals, illustrating that log-concavity implies quasiconcavity. Log-convexity implies convexity by bounding the weighted geometric mean with the weighted arithmetic mean.

正对数凸函数的乘积仍对数凸，因为对数变成凸函数之和；正对数凹函数的乘积同理。非负加权和保持对数凸，可用 log-sum-exp 的复合规则；对数凹函数的和一般不保持对数凹。两个相距很远的高斯峰相加就可能出现双峰。Products of positive log-convex functions remain log-convex because logarithms add convex terms; the same holds for log-concave products. Nonnegative weighted sums preserve log-convexity via log-sum-exp composition. Sums of log-concave functions need not be log-concave: separated Gaussian peaks may become bimodal.

幂函数 xᵃ 在 x>0 上，其对数 a log x 的二阶导数为 −a/x²，所以 a≤0 时对数凸，a≥0 时对数凹。高斯累积分布 Φ(x) 也对数凹：令 φ 为标准高斯密度、r=φ/Φ，则 (log Φ)″=−r(x)(x+r(x))。x≥0 时显然非正；x<0 时 φ(x)=∫₋∞ˣ(−u)φ(u)du>−xΦ(x)，故 x+r(x)>0。For xᵃ on x>0, the logarithm a log x has second derivative −a/x², giving log-convexity for a≤0 and log-concavity for a≥0. The Gaussian CDF Φ is log-concave too. With density φ and r=φ/Φ, its log curvature is −r(x)(x+r(x)). For x≥0 it is nonpositive; for x<0, φ(x)=∫₋∞ˣ(−u)φ(u)du>−xΦ(x), so x+r(x)>0.

掌握Mastery

二次可微正函数满足 (log f)″=(f f″−(f′)²)/f²。多变量版本为 ∇²log f=(f∇²f−∇f∇fᵀ)/f²，由此可检查半正定或半负定。例如 f=eˣ 时分子为零，log f 仿射。对数凸到凸也可用 f=exp(log f)，外层 exp 凸且非减。For positive smooth scalar f, (log f)″=(f f″−(f′)²)/f². In several variables the numerator is f∇²f−∇f∇fᵀ. Its sign tests log-convexity or log-concavity. For eˣ the numerator vanishes. Alternatively exp composed with convex log f proves ordinary convexity.

Gamma 函数 Γ(x)=∫₀∞u^(x−1)e^(−u)du 在 x>0 上对数凸：混合参数对应被积函数的加权几何平均，再用 Hölder 的积分形式得到 Γ(θx+(1−θ)y)≤Γ(x)^θΓ(y)^(1−θ)。det X 对数凹来自 logdet 凹；det X/tr X 也对数凹。后一结论沿方向 H 的对数曲率为 −tr(W²)+(tr H)²/(tr X)²≤0，其中 W=X⁻½HX⁻½；迹 Cauchy–Schwarz 与 tr(X²)≤(tr X)² 给最后的界。The Gamma function Γ(x)=∫₀∞u^(x−1)e^(−u)du is log-convex for x>0: mixed parameters give a geometric mixture of integrands and integral Hölder bounds the integral by Γ(x)^θΓ(y)^(1−θ). Determinant is log-concave because logdet is concave. So is det X/tr X: its log directional curvature is −tr(W²)+(tr H)²/(tr X)²≤0, where W=X⁻½HX⁻½, using trace Cauchy–Schwarz and tr(X²)≤(tr X)².

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=x 在 x>0 上是对数凸还是对数凹？Is f(x)=x on x>0 log-convex or log-concave?

展开核对Check the answer

log x 的二阶导数为 −1/x²，因此对数凹；f 自身仿射，仍凸且凹。Log x has second derivative −1/x², so f is log-concave. The function itself is affine, hence both convex and concave.

深入In depth

零值情形常用 log f=−∞ 的扩展约定来讨论对数凹密度；首次学习先在正值域证明，再检查零点与支撑集合。概率密度的乘积、似然函数与几何规划都使用这些结构。Zero values may be handled using log f=−∞ in log-concavity. First prove statements on the positive domain, then inspect zeros and support. Density products, likelihoods and geometric programming use these structures.

46 · 广义不等式下的凸性46 · Convexity with values in an ordered vector space

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.31-36 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.6.2 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：把标量不等式推广到向量和矩阵；用锥及标量化判定。Learning goal: explain convexity with values in an ordered vector space and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

K-凸函数把标量凸性中的 ≤ 替换为正常锥序；对所有对偶权重标量化后均凸。 replaces scalar order by proper-cone order. Scalarizing with every dual-cone weight gives convex functions.

了解Understand

若 f 输出多个费用，单个标量不够描述比较。K=Rᵐ₊ 时，K-凸恰好表示每个分量都凸。若输出是对称矩阵，则可以用 PSD 序比较；要求混合函数值不大于端点平均矩阵，含义是每个方向的二次型都不超过相应平均。Vector-valued costs need an order beyond a single scalar. For K=Rᵐ₊, K-convexity means every component is convex. For symmetric-matrix outputs, PSD order compares all directional quadratic forms against their endpoint averages.

例子 F(x)=xxᵀ，x∈Rⁿ，输出为 n×n 矩阵。它在 PSD 序下凸，因为 θxxᵀ+(1−θ)yyᵀ−zzᵀ=θ(1−θ)(x−y)(x−y)ᵀ⪰0，其中 z=θx+(1−θ)y。矩阵条目中 xᵢxⱼ 未必分别凸，但整体矩阵序仍能给出凸性。For F(x)=xxᵀ, PSD-order convexity follows from θxxᵀ+(1−θ)yyᵀ−zzᵀ=θ(1−θ)(x−y)(x−y)ᵀ⪰0, where z is the mixture. Individual entries xᵢxⱼ need not be convex; the matrix order still gives a valid convexity statement.

对 λ∈K*，λᵀf 是标量费用。若 f K-凸，配对 λ 保持序，故 λᵀf 凸。反过来所有对偶配对都凸，由 K**=K 得到矩阵或向量差属于 K。这把前面的对偶锥从集合几何连接到函数判定。For λ∈K*, λᵀf is a scalar cost. Pairing a K-convex inequality with λ preserves order, making it convex. Conversely, convexity of every such pairing and K**=K force the difference into K, connecting dual-cone geometry with function tests.

课件中的矩阵例子同样可对 X∈Rᵐˣⁿ 取 F(X)=XXᵀ，差矩阵为 θ(1−θ)(X−Y)(X−Y)ᵀ⪰0。正定矩阵的幂 Xᵖ 在 −1≤p≤0、1≤p≤2 时矩阵凸，在 0≤p≤1 时矩阵凹；这是比标量幂函数更强的算子性质，不能把标量范围直接搬来。p=−1 的逆映射可由矩阵分式与对偶方向检验解释，一般幂范围需要更进一步的矩阵分析。The matrix example extends to F(X)=XXᵀ for rectangular X, with mixture gap θ(1−θ)(X−Y)(X−Y)ᵀ⪰0. Positive definite powers Xᵖ are matrix-convex for −1≤p≤0 or 1≤p≤2, and matrix-concave for 0≤p≤1. These stronger operator properties have different ranges from scalar powers. The inverse case follows from matrix-fractional directional tests; general power ranges require further matrix analysis.

广义复合把第 39 节推广到锥序：内层 g K-凸，外层 h 凸且扩展值版本 K-非减，则 h∘g 凸。课件例子 g(X)=XᵀAX+BᵀX+XᵀB+C，A⪰0，矩阵凸；h(Y)=−logdet(−Y) 在 Y≺0 上凸且按 PSD 序非减。于是 −logdet(−g(X)) 在 g(X)≺0 上凸。域也凸：混合 g 值不大于两个负定矩阵的平均，仍负定。Generalized composition extends Section 39: K-convex g with convex, extended-value K-nondecreasing h gives convex h∘g. The slide example g(X)=XᵀAX+BᵀX+XᵀB+C is matrix-convex for A⪰0. The function h(Y)=−logdet(−Y) on Y≺0 is convex and PSD-order nondecreasing. Thus −logdet(−g(X)) is convex on g(X)≺0; that domain is convex because the mixture lies below a negative definite average.

掌握Mastery

可微时一阶条件为 f(y)⪰K f(x)+Df(x)(y−x)，Df 是 Jacobian。沿直线求方向导数，或对所有 λ 标量化后应用第 32 节即可证明。二次可微时，对任意方向 v，二阶方向输出 D²f(x)[v,v] 必须在 K 中；分量 Hessian 组成的向量要整体按锥序检查。The differentiable condition is f(y)⪰K f(x)+Df(x)(y−x), with the Jacobian Df. Prove it along lines or scalarize and apply Section 32. In the twice differentiable case, every second directional output D²f(x)[v,v] must belong to K; the Hessian components are checked using the output cone.

上面的广义复合例子中，X、B 为 m×n，A 为 m×m 对称半正定，C 为 n×n 对称，输出 g(X) 为 n×n 对称矩阵。混合差为 θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0，证明内层矩阵凸；线性项在差中相消。外层单调性可以沿 PSD 增量 H 检查：h 的方向导数为 tr((−Y)⁻¹H)≥0。正定逆与半正定增量配对非负，解释了复合规则所需的方向。In the generalized composition example, X and B are m×n, A is m×m symmetric PSD, and C is n×n symmetric, giving a symmetric n×n output. The mixture gap is θ(1−θ)(X−Y)ᵀA(X−Y)⪰0, while affine terms cancel. Outer monotonicity follows along PSD increments H from directional derivative tr((−Y)⁻¹H)≥0. Pairing a positive definite inverse with a PSD increment explains the required order direction.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

f(x)=(x²,eˣ) 在正交象限序下凸吗？给一个标量化。Is f(x)=(x²,eˣ) orthant-convex? Give a scalarization.

展开核对Check the answer

两分量都凸，故是；例如权重 (1,2) 给 x²+2eˣ，仍凸。Both components are convex. Weights (1,2) give the convex scalarization x²+2eˣ.

深入In depth

广义上图集 {(x,t):f(x)⪯K t} 凸当且仅当 f K-凸，完全平行于标量 epigraph。广义极小化仍可能有多个 Pareto 方案，需要选择对偶权重或目标偏好。The generalized epigraph {(x,t):f(x)⪯K t} is convex iff f is K-convex, paralleling the scalar result. Generalized minimization can still have multiple Pareto choices, requiring dual weights or preferences.

核对原课件 · 31-36Check original slides · 31-36

47 · 广义单调性47 · Generalized monotonicity and the course connections

Lecture 5 · PDF pp.37 · Boyd & Vandenberghe §3.6.1 · HW1 拓展

学完应能：说明输入、输出锥与定义域；与广义凸性建立联系。Learning goal: explain and the course connections and justify the assumptions and calculations in this unit.

速通Quick

按输入锥和输出锥比较：x⪯K y 时 f(x)⪯L f(y)。可微时 Jacobian 应把 K 中方向送入 L。Generalized monotonicity compares input and output cone orders: x⪯K y implies f(x)⪯L f(y). A differentiable map’s Jacobian should send K-directions into L.

了解Understand

一元非减函数只比较实数输入输出。多变量函数需要先指定哪种输入变化算“增加”、哪种输出变化算“增加”。正交象限序下，所有偏导非负可保证各分量非减；矩阵序下则要检查整个矩阵方向，逐元素符号一般不足够。Scalar monotonicity compares real inputs and outputs. Multivariate maps first need specified input and output orders. Under orthant orders, nonnegative partial derivatives ensure componentwise monotonicity. Matrix order instead requires full directional matrix conditions rather than entrywise signs.

例如 f(x₁,x₂)=x₁+2x₂，任意逐分量增加都会使输出不减，Jacobian 为 (1,2)，把非负向量送到非负数。g(x₁,x₂)=x₁−x₂ 则不满足；沿 (0,1) 增加，输出下降。这个判断也解释向量复合规则为什么逐坐标要求单调。For f(x₁,x₂)=x₁+2x₂, componentwise increases never decrease the output; its Jacobian (1,2) maps nonnegative vectors to nonnegative numbers. The map x₁−x₂ fails along (0,1). This explains the coordinatewise monotonicity requirements in vector composition.

五讲连接起来形成一条路线：内积描述线性响应，范数与对偶范数控制预算；凸集与锥描述可行变化；支撑与分离提供线性证书；凸函数与上图集描述费用；共轭、广义凸性与单调性把这些证书用于更复杂输出。学完应能先识别对象与定义域，再选择证明工具。The five lectures form a connected route: inner products express response; norms and dual norms control budgets; convex sets and cones describe feasible changes; support and separation give linear certificates; convex functions and epigraphs describe cost; conjugates and generalized orders extend those tools. Begin each problem by identifying its objects and domains, then choose a proof tool.

掌握Mastery

在开放凸定义域内，若 Df(x)K⊂L 且 L 闭凸，令 y−x=v∈K。沿线段积分 f(y)−f(x)=∫₀¹Df(x+tv)v dt；每个被积向量在 L，凸锥与闭性保证积分也在 L，得单调性。必要性则在允许的小步方向取差商并传极限。边界点需用定义域内可行方向或额外连续性处理。On an open convex domain, if Df(x)K⊂L with closed convex L, integrate along v=y−x∈K: f(y)−f(x)=∫₀¹Df(x+tv)v dt. The integral remains in L, proving monotonicity. Necessity follows by taking feasible directional difference quotients and limits. Boundary points need feasible directions or additional continuity.

先独立试一遍Try independently first

线性映射 f(x)=Ax 在正交象限序下单调的充要条件是什么？What characterizes orthant-monotonicity of the linear map Ax?

展开核对Check the answer

A 每个元素都非负。充分性由非负向量相乘得到；必要性取输入方向为每个坐标单位向量，要求 A 的每一列都非负。Every entry of A must be nonnegative. Sufficiency follows by multiplication; necessity follows by testing each coordinate unit vector and hence every column.

深入In depth

下一阶段会用这些知识写凸优化标准形式、构造 Lagrange 对偶、理解 KKT 条件与算法。此处只建立连接，不把尚未讲授的 KKT 条件当成已经掌握的前置工具。Later topics use this foundation for standard convex formulations, Lagrange duality, KKT conditions and algorithms. These are connections rather than assumed prerequisites already taught here.

中文Chinese英文English符号Symbol解释Meaning位置Context
norm‖x‖范数把一个向量变成一个非负数，用这个数表示它的长度。它要求：只有零向量的长度为零；向量乘以 t 后，长度乘以 |t|；两段路接起来的长度不超过各段长度之和。选用不同范数，相当于采用不同的长度规则。A norm assigns a nonnegative length to each vector. Only the zero vector has length zero; multiplying a vector by t multiplies its length by |t|; and the length of a sum is at most the sum of the lengths. Different norms use different rules for measuring length.前往讲解Read
unit ballB所有长度不超过 1 的向量；本章使用闭单位球。The set of vectors whose norm is at most one; the closed unit ball is used here.前往讲解Read
inner productzᵀx这里用标准内积：对应分量乘积之和。Here the standard inner product is the sum of componentwise products.前往讲解Read
supremumsupsup 是 supremum 的缩写。上确界是能够挡住所有可能数值的最小上界；它可以存在而没有任何点实际达到它。例如 x∈(0,1) 时，x 的上确界是 1，但没有最大值。The abbreviation sup stands for supremum. A supremum is the least upper bound on all possible values, and it may exist without being attained. For x∈(0,1), the supremum of x is one, but there is no maximum.前往讲解Read
maximummaxmax 是 maximum 的缩写。说一个数是最大值，需要找到一个可行点实际取得这个数，还需要说明其他可行点都不超过它。本章的有限维闭单位球上，线性目标可以取得最大值。The abbreviation max stands for maximum. A maximum is both attained by a feasible point and at least as large as every other feasible value. The linear objective in this chapter attains a maximum on the finite-dimensional closed unit ball.前往讲解Read
dual norm‖z‖*先选定一个原范数，再固定向量 z。让 x 在原范数的单位球中移动，计算每个可行 x 的 zᵀx。所有这些内积的最大值，就是 z 的对偶范数。它的数值取决于原范数使用的长度规则。Choose a primal norm and fix a vector z. Let x vary over the primal unit ball and evaluate zᵀx at every feasible x. The largest value is the dual norm of z. Its value depends on the length rule used by the primal norm.前往讲解Read
support functionh_B(z)给定集合 B 和方向 z，取 sup{x∈B} zᵀx。For a set B and direction z, the supremum of zᵀx over B.前往讲解Read
Hölder inequality1/p+1/q=1共轭指数对应的内积界：|zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q。An inner-product bound for conjugate exponents: |zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q.前往讲解Read
Cauchy–Schwarz inequality|uᵀv|≤‖u‖₂‖v‖₂这个不等式给欧氏内积一个长度上界。两个非零向量同向时，uᵀv 等于长度的乘积；方向偏离时，内积会变小。本章用它先找上界，再沿正确方向构造达到上界的向量。This inequality bounds a Euclidean inner product by the product of the vector lengths. For nonzero vectors pointing in the same direction, uᵀv equals that product; changing their relative direction reduces the inner product. We use it to find a bound and then construct an attaining vector.前往讲解Read
positive definite matrixP≻0 / PDPD = Positive Definite，正定。这里 P 必须是实对称矩阵；对每个非零向量 x，都有 xᵀPx>0。这个条件让每一个非零方向都有正的长度代价，并保证 P 可以求逆。PD = Positive Definite（正定）. Here P is real and symmetric, and xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero vector x. Every nonzero direction therefore has a positive length cost, and P is invertible.前往讲解Read
positive semidefinite matrixP⪰0 / PSDPSD = Positive Semidefinite，半正定。对实对称矩阵 P，要求所有 x 满足 xᵀPx≥0；允许某个非零向量的二次型为零。因此 P 可能不可逆，√(xᵀPx) 也可能不满足范数“非零向量长度为正”的要求。PSD = Positive Semidefinite（半正定）. For a real symmetric P, xᵀPx≥0 for every x, but the quadratic form can vanish at a nonzero vector. P may be singular, and √(xᵀPx) may fail the definiteness requirement of a norm.前往讲解Read
quadratic norm‖x‖P由正定矩阵 P 定义的 √(xᵀPx)。The norm √(xᵀPx) defined by a positive definite matrix P.前往讲解Read
matrix square rootP½对正定 P，P½ 表示一个正定矩阵 S，使得 S²=P。它通常不能通过对每个矩阵元素分别开平方得到。利用正交特征分解，把正特征值逐个开平方，可以构造这个 S。For positive definite P, P½ denotes a positive definite matrix S satisfying S²=P. It is generally not obtained by taking square roots of individual matrix entries. An orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition constructs S by taking square roots of the positive eigenvalues.前往讲解Read
maximizerx* / argmax最大化点是一个可行向量：把它代入目标后，目标实际达到最大值。本章 x* 上的星号标记我们选出的最大化点。x* 是向量，最大值是一个数；这两种对象需要分清。A maximizer is a feasible vector at which the objective attains its maximum. The star on x* marks such a chosen vector. A maximizer is a vector, while the maximum value is a number; they are different kinds of objects.前往讲解Read
ellipsoidxᵀPx≤1正定二次型的单位球；在二维是椭圆及内部。The unit ball of a positive definite quadratic form; an ellipse with its interior in two dimensions.前往讲解Read
polar setB°B°={z: zᵀx≤1 对所有 x∈B}；对偶单位球等于原单位球的极集。B°={z: zᵀx≤1 for all x∈B}; the dual unit ball is the polar of the primal ball.前往讲解Read

spectral norm‖Z‖₂矩阵的最大奇异值；等于由欧氏范数诱导的算子范数。The largest singular value of a matrix; the operator norm induced by Euclidean norms.前往讲解Read

Singular Value DecompositionSVDSVD = Singular Value Decomposition，奇异值分解；矩阵写成 UΣVᵀ。SVD = Singular Value Decomposition（奇异值分解）; a matrix is written UΣVᵀ.前往讲解Read
second-order coneSOCSOC = Second-Order Cone，二阶锥；{(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}。SOC = Second-Order Cone（二阶锥）; the set {(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}.前往讲解Read
sign functionsgnsgn 是 sign 的惯用缩写。符号函数对正数返回 1，对负数返回 −1，对零返回 0。取 xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) 可以让乘积 zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|。The notation sgn is a conventional abbreviation of sign. The sign function returns one for a positive number, minus one for a negative number and zero at zero. Choosing xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) makes zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|.前往讲解Read

minimal elementPareto没有另一个不同元素按偏序不大于它的点。A point with no distinct element below it under the order.前往讲解Read
separating hyperplaneaᵀx=b将两个集合置于相反两侧的超平面，弱分离允许边界取等。A hyperplane placing two sets on opposite sides, with boundary equality allowed in weak separation.前往讲解Read
supporting hyperplaneaᵀx≤aᵀx₀通过边界点并将整个集合留在同一侧的超平面。A hyperplane through a boundary point with the entire set on one side.前往讲解Read
dual coneK*与原锥所有点内积非负的向量组成的锥。The cone of vectors pairing nonnegatively with every primal-cone point.前往讲解Read
Pareto frontierf(x)多目标比较下未被其他方案支配的目标点集合。The set of objective points undominated by other plans.前往讲解Read
convex functionf在凸定义域上，混合输入的函数值不超过输出的加权平均。A function on a convex domain whose mixture value is at most the weighted average of endpoint values.前往讲解Read
convex indicator functionδC在集合内取 0，在集合外取 +∞，用来编码约束。A function equal to zero inside a set and +∞ outside, encoding a constraint.前往讲解Read
subgradient∂f给出全局仿射下界的斜率，适用于不可微凸函数。A slope defining a global affine lower bound, including at nondifferentiable convex points.前往讲解Read
epigraphepi f包含函数图像及上方所有点的集合。The set consisting of the graph and all points above it.前往讲解Read
sublevel setf≤α函数值不超过固定门槛的输入集合。The inputs whose function values are no greater than a fixed threshold.前往讲解Read
Linear Matrix InequalityLMI变量以仿射方式出现在对称矩阵中，并要求该矩阵半正定。A PSD constraint on a symmetric matrix depending affinely on the variables.前往讲解Read
Jensen inequalityf(E X)≤E f(X)凸函数在平均输入处的值不超过输出的平均。Evaluation of a convex function at an average is no greater than averaging its values.前往讲解Read
partial minimizationinf_y消去部分决策变量，保留其可取得的最佳费用。Eliminating some decision variables while retaining their best attainable cost or infimum.前往讲解Read
Fenchel inequalityf+f*≥〈x,y〉由共轭定义得到的内积上界，取等表示共轭最大化。The inner-product bound from conjugacy, with equality at a conjugate maximizer.前往讲解Read
quasiconvexf(mix)≤max所有次水平集凸，混合点不超过两端较大值。Having convex sublevel sets, or mixture values no greater than the larger endpoint value.前往讲解Read
log-convexlog f convex正函数的对数为凸函数。A positive function with convex logarithm.前往讲解Read
log-concavelog f concave正函数的对数为凹函数。A positive function with concave logarithm.前往讲解Read
K-convexity⪯K用锥序代替标量不等式的向量值函数凸性。Convexity of a vector-valued function using cone order in place of scalar order.前往讲解Read
generalized monotonicityDf K⊂L输入按指定锥序增加时，输出也按其锥序增加。Preservation of specified input and output cone orders.前往讲解Read
